tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mchog zhing 'dir byon te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/dam pa'i chos rim gyis 'phel zhing dar ba'i gnas skab
༄༅/ /bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mchog zhing 'dir byon te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/dam pa'i chos rim gyis 'phel zhing dar ba'i gnas skab

tei:div.tei:p: VENERABLE THRANGU RINPOCHEsngon brjod/

༄༅/ /bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mchog zhing 'dir byon te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ dam pa'i chos rim gyis 'phel zhing dar ba'i gnas skabs su nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad byung zhing*/ de dag kyang rim pas 'phel 'grib kyis gnas brtan sde pa dang*/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba ste rtsa ba'i sde pa gnyis dang*/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba las gyes pa'i chos srung sde pa ste/ da lta'i skabs 'dir sde pa gsum kho na bzhugs shing*/ de las gnas brtan sde pa ni sing ga la/ bhar ma sogs lho phyogs kyi yul gru khag la dar te/ deng gi dus yongs grags la theg pa chung ngu zhes nyan thos kyi theg par ngos 'dzin byed pa dang*/ de dag gis 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la brten cing*/ phyi dro'i kha zas mi bzhes pa sogs ston pa zhal bzhugs pa'i gnas skabs lta bu'i 'dul ba'i phyag len dang ba 'dren pa gnang bzhin bzhugs yod/ de bzhin chos srung sde yi sdom rgyun kha che nas li yul brgyud rgya nag dang*/ nyi hong sogs la dar te/ deng dus yongs grags su theg pa chen po'i lugs su ngos 'dzin byed cing*/ de dag gis kyang dmar zas gtan du mi bzhes pa dang*/ gzhan don la shin tu brtson pa bcas byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang mthun pa'i phyag len gnang bzhin bzhugs yod/ 'on kyang de gnyis las gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sdom rgyun 'dzin pa po rnams ni khyad par du thon pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig ste/ spyir sdom rgyun de bod dang sog po sogs la dar zhing*/ yongs grags su rdo rje theg pa zhes ngos 'dzin byed bzhin ltar gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gnang gi yod mod/ 'on kyang gsang sngags kyi nyams len rkyang pa ma yin par sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ mchog gnyis sogs bzhugs pa'i skabs bzhin/ dpal nālan+dā dang*/

bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang sogs kyi phyag len ma nyams par phyi so thar/ nang byang sems/ gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa ste/ sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam cha tshang bar nyams len gnang bas/ mkhas la grub cing*/ grub la btsun pa'i skyes chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa yin pa'i phyir/ rjes su 'jug pa'i slob tshogs rnams kyis kyang de ltar sdom gsum chig dril du nyams su len pa gal che bas/ thog ma nas sdom gsum gyi bstan bcos la 'chad nyan phun sum tshogs pa zhig gnang dgos nges shing*/ sdom gsum bstan pa'i bstan bcos kyang sngon dus dang*/ phyis byon gyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung mang du bzhugs pa las/ deng gi dus rgyu mtshan gnyis la rten nas phyis byon mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung gal che bar 'dzin dgos te/ rgyu mtshan dang po/ spyir ming tshig yi ge rnams lo rabs dang dus rabs kyi dbang gis 'pho 'gyur 'byung ba ni chos nyid la/ de'i phyir da lta'i dus rabs 'dir skyes pa'i skye bo rnams kyis sngon gyi bstan bcos rnying pa khag las/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mjug dang*/ nyi shu pa'i nang du byon pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung tshig dang don gyi cha gnyis kar go bde zhing shes sla ba zhig yong gi yod pa dang*/ de bzhin rgyu mtshan gnyis pa/ sngon byon mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung khyab brdal du 'phel zin cing par skrun sogs zhus zin par brten/ dpe rgyun dang bshad rgyun chad pa'i nyen kha dang bral ba zhig la/ phyis byon gyi bstan bcos khag ni khyab brdal du spel ma grub pa'i gong*/ dus 'gyur byung bas dpe rgyun sogs chad nyen la brten myur skyob bya rgyu gal che bas/ da lam rje dbon karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i ¿sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang ¿'di nyid par skrun zhus pa yin la/ de skabs gang spyir gra 'grigs gnang mkhan rang dgon gyi bshad grwa'i dpe khrid pa tshe ring dang*/

thon gsar rig mdzod du bcug mkhan 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dang*/ zhu dag pa bstan 'dzin shes rab bcas thams cad kyis phya ra gru 'degs gnang ste/ wā rā ṇa sī badz+ra bid+yā'i dpe mdzod khang nas phyi lo 2010 lor par skrun zhu rgyu'i go skabs thob pas thams cad la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ sngar 'di nas par skrun zhus pa'i phyag dpe khag gcig rin med du phul yang*/ phyag dpe thugs mkho che bar yod med shan ma phye pa dang*/ phyag dpe nges par mkho gal gnang ba khag cig gis dngos su bka' gnang ma bde ba lta bu 'ong gi 'dug par brten/ da lam stabs bde ba'i phyir dpe rin phran bu zhus nas 'grems spel zhus pa yin pas phyag dpe thugs mkho yod rigs nas thad kar bka' gsal gnang grub zhu rgyu dang*/ chad lhag nor 'khrul gang byung la bzod gsol snying thag pa nas zhu ba lags/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/par skrun gleng brjod/ dbon karma nges legs bstan 'dzin ni/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas la dbon gsum byung ba ste dbon bsam gtan 'phel dang*/ dbon karma nges legs/ dbon bsam gtan bcas si tu chos 'byung dang 'khrul yul gcig pa mdo khams sde dge'i char gtogs a lo ding ring sgang du sku 'khrungs/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis sāts+tsha dgon pa'i bla ma sku skye'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang*/ chung ngu nas rgyal dbang karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje dang*/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs mkhas grub du mar bsten nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur te/ spyi lo 1732 lor rtsis gzhung nyer mkho bum bzang brtsams/ de nas sman slob tshul khrims 'od gsal gyis bskul te/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi sogs gso ba rig pa'i bka' bstan man ngag kun gyi gnad bsdus phan bde'i bsil zer 'phro ba'i zla ba gsar pa zhes pa'am ming gzhan sman bsdus e waṃ zhes pa'i pod gnyis rtsom 'bri mdzad de/

mthar dgung lo so bzhi par sku mya ngan las 'das par grags so/ /slob ma grags che ba ni/ rdo rje grags pa dang*/ rta mgrin mgon po/ sman slob 'tsho byed tshul khrims 'od gsal sogs yin/ gsung rtsom ni/ sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang*/ gtsug lag rtsis rigs tshang ma'i lag len 'khrul med mun sel nyi ma nyer mkho'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i bum bzang*/ rtsis kyi lag len nyer mkho'i bum bzang zhes bya ba'i nag rtsis kyi rab tu byed pa/ rnam 'dren bla ma mchog gi rnam thar snyan par brjod pa snyan ngag yid 'ong lcug phran gzhon nu/ dus tha ma'i cho ga'i bya ba nyer mkho phan bde rab ster/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi sogs gso ba rig pa'i bka' bstan man ngag kun gyi gnad bsdus phan bde'i bsil zer 'phro ba'i zla ba gsar pa zhes pa'am ming gzhan sman bsdus e waṃ sogs mang du bzhugs so// gzhung 'di'i bsdus don rnam gzhag/ sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang zhes bya ba'i gzhung 'di ni/ ming ma gsal ba'i sprul sku+u zhig dang*/ nang chen pa karma mtha' yas kyis bskul ba dang*/ grwa pa gzhan 'ga' zhig la'ang nye bar mkho ba'i rkyen gyis mdo smad dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du rtsom 'bri mdzad cing*/ gzhung 'di la le'u bzhi yod de/ le'u dang po so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i skabs/ le'u gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i skabs/ le'u gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'i skabs/ le'u bzhi pa sdom pa gsum gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ldan tshul gyi skabs bcas so//le'u dang po so so thar pa'i sdom pa la bzhi/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa/ dge slong gi sdom pa bcas so/ /dge slong gi sdom pa la/ ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang*/ thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'o/ /sdom pa ma thob pa thob byed kyi cho ga la mngon gyur bcu/

gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i thabs la/ spyir gnas kyi bla ma brten tshul sogs dang*/ dgag sgrub bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dgag sgrub bye brag tu bshad pa la/ dgag pa'i bslab bya dang*/ bsgrub pa'i bslab bya'o/ /dgag pa'i bslab bya la ltung ba sde lnga ste/ pham pa'i sde/ lhag ma'i sde/ ltung byed/ sor bshags/ nyes byas bcas so/ /bsgrub pa'i bslab bya la lnga/ bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi/ bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen gyi gzhi/ cho ga khyad 'brel las kyi gzhi/ nyes pa dag byed phyir bcos gzhi/ mtha' gnyis spangs pa gnas mal gyi gzhi'o/ /dang po bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi la/ gso sbyong*/ dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye'o/ /gnyis pa bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen la/ bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen gos dang*/ sman no/ /gos la gsum/ sra brkyang gi gzhi/ gos kyi gzhi/ ko lpags kyi gzhi'o/ /gsum pa cho ga khyad 'brel las kyi gzhi la/ gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las nyer bzhi/ gsol gnyis kyi las zhe bdun/ gsol bzhi'i las sum cu'o/ /bzhi pa nyes pa dag byed phyir bcos kyi gzhi la/ ltung ba phyir bcos dang*/ rtsod pa phyir bcos so/ /le'u dang po so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i skor 'di'i gcig tu bstar ba'i go rim ha lam pa ni 'brug pa kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i sdom gsum ltar te pad dkar gyi so thar 'di 'thus che zhing 'tshams la/ tshig legs pa zhig snang ba bcas dang*/ yang the tshom dogs gnas rnams ni rje karma pa brgyad pa'i mdo rtsa'i 'grel chen nyid las thag bcad de mdzad do//le'u gnyis pa byang chub sems kyi sdom pa ni/ dpa' bo btsug lag phreng ba'i spyod 'jug 'grel chen gyi spyi don las/ rgyu dang ngo bo dbye ba dang*/ /cho ga bslab bya phan yon dang*/ /nyams pa'i nyes dmigs phyir bcos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar don brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad pa ste/ de yang skye ba'i rgyu/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/

dbye ba/ cho ga /bslab bya/ phan yon/ nyams pa'i nyes dmigs/ phyir bcos bcas so/ /cho ga la/ zab mo lta rgyud kyi lugs dang*/ rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi lugs gnyis/ rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi lugs la/ smon pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /bslab bya la/ smon pa'i bslab bya dang*/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya'o/ /'jug pa'i bslab bya la/ dgag pa'i bslab bya dang*/ sgrub pa'i bslab bya gnyis/ bsgrub pa'i bslab bya la bsdus don rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gnyis ni/ thar rgyan las/ grangs nges go rim nges pa dang*/ /mtshan nyid dang ni nges tshig dang*/ /rab tu dbye dang bsdu ba ste/ /drug gis pha rol phyin pa bsdus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar don drug gi sgo nas rgyas par bshad do/ /mdor na byang chub sems kyi sdom pa ni/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i spyod 'jug 'grel chen gyi spyi don dang*/ thar rgyan gnyis las legs par btus te mdzad pa zhig yin no//le'u gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa ni/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi gsung dang*/ dpal khang lo tsā ba'i karma shing rta las gsungs pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus te bstan pa dang*/ rje rang byung rdo rje'i dam tshig rgya mtsho'i gzhung 'grel pa dang bcas pa las gsungs pa'i brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa dang*/ de dag gi go rim dang*/ ltung ba'i tshul rnam par dbye ba bcas bstan/ brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ bsrung bya lnga/ mi bya ba lnga/ mi bsnun pa lnga/ mi 'khu ba lnga/ mi zhen pa lnga'o/ /rigs lnga'i sdom pa la/ theg chen spyi dang thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa bla med kyi sdom pa'o/ /ltung ba'i tshul rnam par dbye ba la/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad/ phrin las sgrub pa la brten pa'i ltung ba bco lnga/ de las yan lag tu gyur pa bdun/ de rnams nyes pa che chung gi rim pa bcas rgyas par bstan to//le'u bzhi pa sdom pa gsum gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ji ltar gnas pa dang*/

bsrung ba'i tshul la/ slob dpon a bh+ya kā ra dang*/ paṇa chen bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra dang*/ dpal ldan sa skya pa/ dge ldan pa/ gsang sngags rnying ma pa bcas kyi 'dod pa bkod de/ 'thad mi 'thad kyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa ni karma pa chos grags rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i sdom gsum gnad kyi zin bris su lta bar bya zhes kha 'phangs shing*/ rang lugs ni rje sgam po pa'i gsungs las/ ngo bo tha dad dang*/ srung na chol par srung*/ 'dom thug na gong ma gtso/ 'og ma'i skyon zil gyis gnon/ yon tan yar ldan yin zhes 'byung ba ltar 'dod pa'o//gzhung 'di'i ma dpe ni dpal spungs dgon du bzhugs pa'i shing par la gtso bor byas shing*/ 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog gi phyag dpe bris ma zhig yod pa de la yang phan tshun bsdur te zhu sgrig byed pa dang*/ gzhung 'di'i rtsa ba logs su kho bo cag gi lag tu ma thob par brten/ 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog gis bka' slob lam ston gnang don ltar/ 'grel pa'i nang du gsal ba'i rtsa ba rnams zur du bton te sa bcad yang mnyam sbyar zhus yod/ phyag dpe 'di dpe rgyun shin tu dkon rigs su mngon te/ 'di ga wa ṇā badz+ra bid+yā dpe mdzod khang nas kyang lo ltar bka' brgyud pa'i gzhung dkon rigs rnams par skrun zhus dang zhu 'char ltar/ da lam gzhung 'di nyid 'jam dbyangs bkra shis lags nas glog klad nang du bcug pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin shes rab sogs nas zhu dag gnang ste deb grangs gcig stong tham pa badz+ra bid+yā dpe mdzod khang gis gron 'gron btang te par skrun 'grems spel zhus pa lags pas/ gong gsal phya ra gru 'degs gnang mkhan thams cad la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ chad lhag nor 'khrul gang byung la bzod gsol snying thag pa nas zhu ba lags/dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i phyogs su sdom gsum rnam gzhag ston pa'i bstan bcos byung rim/

de yang mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i phyogs su sdom gsum rnam gzhag ston pa'i bstan bcos byung rim mdor bsdus pa'i tshul du smos na/ thog mar rje sgam po pas tshogs chos bkra shis phun tshogs las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la sdom pa gsum dang ldan dgos gsung*/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan dgos par ga nas bshad snyam na/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo nas/ byang chub sems 'dzin gyur nas ni/ /lha gzhan la ni mi mos pas/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang*/ /de la gzhol zhing 'bab pa yin/ /gsod dang rku dang 'khrig pa dang*/ /brdzun dang chang ni rnam par spang*/ /khyim pa'i tshul du gnas na ni/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rab tu sgrub/ /gal te de ni rab byung na/ /sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya/ /so so thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'o/ /gnyis po rig 'dzin rten yin te/ /yang na rig 'dzin nang du 'dus/ /zhes sdom pa gsum dang ldan dgos pa yid ches pa'i lung gis sgrub pa ma zad/ sdom pa gsum gyi ngo bo yang rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud kyi lung drangs te ngos 'dzin mdzad/ de yang rten gyi gang zag la sdom pa gsum po de gnas na ji ltar gnas/ bsrung na ji ltar bsrung*/ ldan na ji ltar ldan/ phyir bcos na ji ltar 'chos/ mi 'gal bar bsrung na ji ltar bsrung tshul rgyas par gsungs pa'i sdom gsum skor dang*/ de'i dgongs 'grel rgyas bshad du phyis su bkra shis zur mang nas bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje zhes pa zhig gis karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho la bskul ma gnang ste/ rgya gar ba'i lugs kyi sdom pa gsum gyi bshad srol bod du byung ba/ bod gzhan gyi lugs/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i bshad srol bcas dang*/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i bshad srol la/ mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu'i gsung 'bum gyi nang du 'byung ba'i sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag las/
sdom pa gsum ngo bo tha dad/ bsrung na 'chol bar

bsrung*/ 'dom thug byung na gong ma gtso che/ yon tan yar ldan yin/ gtong thob tha dad ces sogs gsungs pa ni gsung rab thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi thugs bzhed yin no zhes sdom pa gsum gyi ngos 'dzin/ so so'i thob tshul/ sdom pa'i ngo bo gcig dang tha dad dpyad pa'i bstan bcos sdom gsum gnad kyi zin bris zhes pa mdzad/ sdom gsum gzhung 'di nyid rjes su grags che bar gyur te/ ngo gro bla ma sgron mdog 'bum pas rje btsun karma phrin las la sdom gsum ngo bo gcig mi gcig gi dris lan drang nges don gyi snang byed yang sdom gsum gnad kyi zin bris rtsa bar bzung ste mdzad pa zhig yin/ 'bri gung dkon mchog rin chen gyis kyang sdom gsum gnad kyi zin bris nang ma gsal ba'i 'bri gung skyob pa mgon po'i bzhed pa 'ga' zhig kha skong gnang ste sdom pa gsum gyi zin thun mdor bsdus dbang brtul yid kyi dga' ston zhes pa zhig mdzad do// rje sgam po pa'i dngos slob bde gshegs phag mo gru pas sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ rtsa ltung rnam bshad don gsal sgron me bcas mdzad/ phyis su karma'i mkhan po rin chen dar rgyas kyis phag gru'i sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa rtsa bar bzung zhing rgya ston pa'i don 'grel bcas bstun te sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel chung don gsal snying po zhes pa mdzad/ bde gshegs phag gru'i slob ma 'bri gung skyob pa mgon po mchog nas phyi sdom gsum gnad gcig /nang sdom gsum gnad gcig /gsang ba sdom gsum gnad gcig /yang gsang sdom gsum gnad gcig /de kho na nyid sdom gsum gnad gcig dang*/ dgongs gcig sdom gsum skor bcas mdzad do/ /skyob pa'i slob ma spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyis sdom pa nyi shu pa'i yig sna mdzad/ sgam po chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rtsa ltung rnam bshad bzhin gsal me long mdzad/

karma pa rang byung rdo rjes dam tshig rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa rnam par snang bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba mdzad/ dam tshig rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa rnam par snang bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i snying po la phyis su zhwa dmar lnga pa dkon mchog yan lag gis 'grel pa rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam zhes pa mdzad/ karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes so so thar pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa rin chen 'byung gnas mdzad/ karma'i mkhan po rin chen dar rgyas kyis so so thar pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa snying po nor bu'i shing rta mdzad/ karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i dbon mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rin chen rnam rgyal chos kyi grags pa la dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i bshad pa rgyas par gnang ba'i skabs dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas/ so thar gnad bsdus kyi tshoms kyi zin bris/ byang sems sdom pa'i tshoms kyi zin bris/ sngags sdom gyi tshoms kyi zin bris sogs mdzad de bka' 'bum nang du bzhugs/ 'brug pa kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos sdom gsum gyi snying po bstan pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi rgyan ces bya ba'i bstan bcos/ sdom pa gsum gyi rgyan ces bya ba'i rgya cher 'grel bcas mdor na sdom gsum gzhung rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i tshul du mdzad/ /sdom gsum rgyan la phyis su rje dge 'dun rin chen gyi mchan 'grel pad dkar zhal lung dang*/ rje a dbyangs kyi sdom gsum rgyan gyi mchan 'grel shin tu bsdus pa bcas bzhugs/ kun mkhyen pad dkar gyi sdom gsum rgyan gyi rgya cher 'grel ni bka' brgyud pa'i phyogs su sdom gsum gzhung rgyas shos shig yin snyam/ sdom gsum rgyan gyi rgya cher 'grel la brten nas phyis su stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis sdom gsum rgyas pa bstan pa'i ku mud gsal bar byed pa'i zla shel/ 'bring po rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa/

bsdus pa zhal gdams tshigs su bcad pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyi phreng ba sdom gsum gsal byed nyi ma'i snying po bcas mdzad/ gzhan yang karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyi sdom gsum nyer mkho'i bum bzang kyang sdom gsum rgyan gyi rgya cher 'grel las nyams len gyi gnad rnams nyung ngur bsdu zhing*/ brda' chad rnams kyang yul skad du byas te mdzad do//zhwa dmar drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis gdams pa tshigs su bcad pa nyer lnga pa dang de'i rang 'grel bcas mdzad/ gzhung 'di ni chos thams cad kyi gzhi ma skyabs 'gro/ so thar thams cad kyi rtsa ba lus ngag gi spong ba bdun/ byang sems kyi rtsa ba smon 'jug don dam gsum/ sngags kyi dam tshig gi bsrung bya gtso che ba rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ste/ de rnams la zhog re dam 'cha'/ nyin mo de ltar du byed/ nyal khar bsam gzhig byed tshul gyi gdams ngag tshigs su bcad pa nyer lngar bsdus te mdzad pa zhig yin/ zhwa dmar drug pa'i slob ma mkhas grub karma chags med kyis sdom pa gsum gyi srung tshul mun sel nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mdzad/ rje 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gi thar par 'jug pa'i gru bo'i sdom gsum gyi nyams len rin po che'i sde mig/ rje dkon mchog rin chen gyis so thar byang sems sngags dbang dang bcas pa'i rnam bshad mdor bsdus bdud rtsi'i dga' ston mdzad/ karma'i mkhan chen rin chen dar rgyas kyis sdom gsum mdzes rgyan 'dul ba'i gleng gzhi rab gsal lung gi rol mo mdzad/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas dgung lo lnga bcu pa spyi lo 1862 lor khong gi dngos slob li thang mkhan po karma nges don nas sdom gsum gyi bstan bcos shig mdzad dgos par bskul ma zhus te shes bya kun khyab mdzod kyi sdom gsum rtsa 'grel mdzad/ li thang mkhan po karma nges don nas sdom gsum snying bsdus dang*/ de'i bsdus don sa bcad/ sdom gsum rnam nges la 'grel pa 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i zhal lung bcas mdzad/

karma bkra shis chos 'phel gyis sdom gsum snying bsdus kyi tshig 'grel mdor bsdus gzhan phan nyi ma'i snang ba zhes pa mdzad/ gzhan yang karma nges don bstan rgyas kyi sdom gsum rags bsdus byang chub mchog gi myu gu/ sdom gsum rags bsdus byang chub mchog gi myu gu'i tshig don 'dus gsal du bkral ba lam mchog sgron me/ karma sangs rgyas chos 'phel gyi sdom gsum zur rgyan la sogs pa du ma bzhugs kyang de tsam gyis 'thus par byas so zhes bal bod kyi sa mtshams/ shar sba khang don grub sdings kyi btsun pa tshe ring shar pas/ 'phags yul grong khyer chen po wā rā ṇa sī'i nye 'dabs su gnas pa'i badz+ra bid+yā gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du phyi lo 2010 zla 7 tshes 25 nyin sbyar ba'o//dkar chag ka sngon brjod/ iii kha par skrun gsal bshad/ xi ga gzhung dngos gzhi/sdom gsum nyer mkho'i bum bzang gi sdom tshig 1-25 le'u dang po so so thar pa'i skabs/ 27 le'u gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i skabs/ 151 le'u gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'i skabs/ 187 le'u bzhi pa sdom pa gsum gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ldan tshul gyi skabs/ 239 nga gzhung yongs rdzogs kyi sa bcad/le'u dang po so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i skabs kyi sa bcad/ 245 le'u gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i skabs kyi sa bcad/ 258 le'u gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'i skabs kyi sa bcad/ 260 ༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang bzhugs so// bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid//skyabs gnas bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad+mo//spyi bor mchod nas sdom gsum rnam gzhag ni//gsung rab rgya mtsho'i snying po 'dir bstan bya//de ltar mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas 'dir bstan par bya ba ni/ de'ang sdom du brjod na/ sdom pa gsum ni so thar dang*/ /byang sdom sngags kyi sdom pa'o/

/de las so so thar pa ni/ /rang rkang theg dman 'dul ba'i don/ /'on kyang sdom pa thams cad dang*/ /bsam gtan la sogs yon tan tshogs/ /du ma'i rten du 'gyur bar bshad/ /byang sdom zhes bya theg chen ni/ /pha rol phyin pa'i sdom pa ste/ /sngags sdom dbang bskur las byung ba/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig go//de las sdom pa dang po ni/ /nges 'byung bsam pas blangs pa yi/ /spong bdun 'khor bcas tshul khrims dang*/ /gnyis pa nyes spyod kun spong gi/ /tshul khrims gzhan phan bdag nyid can/ /de steng thabs shes rtsis zin pa/ /gsang sngags sdom pa'i khyad chos yin/ /sdom pa gsum po 'di dag gi/ /bslab pa'i cha shas ma lus pa/ /rdzogs par slob pa'i nang du ni/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad 'dus//so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni/ /ngo bo rnam par rig byed dang*/ /rig byed min ( 'di ni bye brag smra ba'i 'dod pa ste/ mdo sde pas sems byung sems par 'dod cing*/ sems tsam pas sems pa sa bon dang bcas par 'dod do mchan/ ) pa'i gzugs can te/ /mtshan nyid chos lugs 'di pa yi// 'dod khams spyod pa'i tshul khrims so/ /de la dbye na bsnyen gnas dang*/ /dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis dang ni/ /de bzhin dge tshul pha ma gnyis/ /dge slob ma gcig dge slong gnyis/ /de phyir ming gi sgo nas brgyad/ /rdzas su dbye na bsnyen gnas dang*/ /dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong bzhi'o//so so thar pa'i sgra don ni/ /gang zag so so 'khor ba las/ /thar pa'i phyir na de skad brjod/ /tshul khrims dang ni legs spyad dang*/ /las dang sdom pa zhes kyang grags/ /bsnyen gnas zhag gcig sdom pa ste/ /bsrung bya yan lag brgyad nyid do/ / dge bsnyen ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar/ /bsrung bar bya ba'i sdom pa ste/ /sna gcig spyod dang phal cher spyod/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen sogs/ /bsrung bya'i dbye bas sna tshogs yod/ /dge tshul gyi ni sdom pa dag

/ma thob thob par byed pa'i thabs/ /phal cher bsnyen par rdzogs dang mtshungs/ /bslab bya yan lag bcu ru 'dus//de yang pham 'dra'i nyes byas dang*/ /bshags bya'i nyes byas gnyis su 'dus/ / dge slong sdom pa thob byed rgyu/ /mngon du gyur pa bcu dgos te/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bzhugs pa la/ /ston pa mngon gyur zhes su brjod/ /smrar ba ma nyams lung gi chos// sgrub pa ma nyams rtogs pa'i chos/ /'bras chos mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /bsgrub byas de shes chos mngon gyur/ /de bzhin mkhan po slob dpon dang*/ /gsang ston sogs kyang rang rang gi/ /mtshan nyid legs par tshang ba ste/ /kun kyang kha skong chos dang ldan/ / mi mthun gnyis dang bral ba dang*/ /mkhan po la ni khyad par du/ /brtan mkhas yan lag gnyis ldan dgos/ /bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod mngon gyur ni/ /gang zag tshogs su ma langs pa/ /tshigs gsum rim chags nges 'byung can/ /nges pa lnga dang bral ba sogs/ /lus bsam rnam par dag dgos so//chos gos gsum dang gding ba dang*/ /lhung bzed chu tshags rgyu rung zhing*/ /byin brlabs yo byad mngon gyur ro/ /skye gnas mdzes pa'i bar chad sogs/ /med na yongs dag mngon gyur te/ /thog mar las gral de nyid dam/ /yang na dge slong so so yi/ /gnas nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ /gsol ba mngon du gyur pa'o/ /las chog tshang zhing ma nor ba/ /de la las mngon gyur par smra// dge slong gi sdom pa la gnyis/ ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang*/ thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'o/ /gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i thabs la gnyis/ spyir gnas kyi bla ma brten tshul sogs dang*/ dgag sgrub bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar bsnyen par rdzogs thob nas/ /de nyid nyams pa med pa'i phyir/ /'dul ba rgya mtshor mkhas par bya/ /de bas gnas kyi bla ma la/ /bya ba che phra kun zhu bzhin/ /lo bcu'i bar du brten par bya/ /bla ma de la rje sa dang*/

/gus pas rim gro ci nus bsgrub/ /bla ma des kyang 'dul ba dang*/ /mthun par rjes su sgrub byed de/ /chos dang zang zing dag gis kyang*/ /phan 'dogs skyo ngal med par bya/ /gnas pa gnas bcas kun gyis kyang*/ /skra bzhar ba dang khrus dang ni/ /bsro khang brten pa'i bya ba dang*/ /lhung bzed tshul dang nad g.yog sogs/ /'dul ba rgya mtshor bshad bzhin slobs// gnyis pa dgag sgrub bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis/ dgag pa'i bslab bya bshad pa dang*/ bsgrub pa'i bslab bya bshad pa'o/ /dang po la ltung ba sde lnga ste/ pham pa'i sde/ lhag ma'i sde/ ltung byed/ sor bshags/ nyes byas so/ /dang po ni/ khyad par dgag pa'i bslab bya ni/ /mi tshangs spyod dang ma byin len/ /srog gcod rdzun du smrar bzhi la/ /re re la'ang gzhi dang ni/ /bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug gi/ /yan lag tshang na pham pa zhes/ /dge slong sdom pa nyams par 'gyur/ /gal te yan lag ma tshang na/ /pham pa'i sbom po zhes bya ba/ /pham pa dngos las yang ba dang*/ /gzhan yang de las yang ba sogs/ /dbye ba sna tshogs phyed kyang 'tshal// gnyis pa lhag ma bcu gsum ste/ khu+u ba 'byin dang reg pa dang*/ /'khrig tshig smra dang bsnyen bkur bsngags/ /gnyen kha byed dang khang pa dang*/ /khang chen dang ni gzhi med dang*/ /gzhi ni bag tsam yod pa dang*/ /dge 'dun dbyen dang de rjes phyogs/ /khyim pa sun 'byin nyid dang ni/ /bka' blo mi bde zhes pa ste/ /bcu gsum dge 'dun lhag ma'i sde/ /de dag spyad na sdom pa yi/ /lhag ma cung zad lus tsam dang*/ /'di la'ang lhag ma'i sbom po sogs/ /zas gtsang sras pos bka' bstsal to// gsum pa ltung byed kyi sde la dbye na/ spang ltung dang*/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po la bcu tshan gsum las/ bcu tshan dang po ni/ ( lung las/ )'chang dang 'bral dang 'jog pa dang*/ /khrur 'jug pa dang len pa dang*//slong dang stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang*/ /rin thang so sor bskur ba'o//

bcu tshan gnyis pa ni/ srin bal 'ba' zhig cha gnyis dang*/ /drug dang mtho gang lam dang ni//'khru ba dang ni gser dngul dang*/ /mngon mtshan can dang nyo tshong ngo*// bcu tshan gsum pa ni/ lhung bzed gnyis dang tha ga gnyis/ /byin 'phrog ston zla tha chung dang*//dgon pa ba dang ras chen dang*/ /bsngos pa dang ni bsog 'jog go/ gnyis pa ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa la bcu tshan dgu las/ dang po ni/ rdzun skyon dge slong phra ma dang*/ /skyo sngogs byed dang ston pa dang*//'don dang gnas ngan len dang chos/ /bshes ngor byed dang khyad du gsod// bcu tshan gnyis pa ni/ sa bon 'phya ba bsgo ba dang*/ khri dang gding dang skrod pa dang*//phyis gnon dbyung ba 'debs pa dang*/ /rim pa gnyis su brtsigs pa'o// bcu tshan gsum pa ni/ ma bskos nyi ma nub pa dang*/ /zas dang chos gos gnyis dag dang*//don mthun gru dang dben pa gnyis/ /dge slong ma yis sbyor bcug pa'o// bcu tshan bzhi pa ni/ yang yang dang ni 'dug gnas gcig /phye dang bca' dang stob pa dang*//'dus dang dus min bsog 'jog dang*/ kha na mid dang gsod pa'o//

bcu tshan lnga pa ni/ srog chags bcas dang nyal sar 'dug /'grengs dang gcer bu dmag dang ni//zhag gnyis bsham dkrug 'gro ba dang*/ /brdeg dang gzas dang gnas ngan len// bcu tshan drug pa ni/ bde dang me dang 'dun pa dang*/ /bsnyen par ma rdzogs chos dang smra//dge tshul kha dog bsgyur ba dang*/ /rin po che dang tsha ba'i dus// bcu tshan bdun pa ni/ dud 'gro 'gyod pa sor mo dang*/ /rtse dang lhan cig dngangs byed dang*//sbed dang gdeng dang gzhi med dang*/ /skyes pa med par lam 'gro'o// bcu tshan brgyad pa ni/ rku dang nyi shu ma lon dang*/ /rko dang mgron dang bslab pa dang*//'thab dang mi smra 'gro ba dang*/ /ma gus chang 'thung dus min pa'o// bcu tshan dgu pa ni/ zas bcas skya rengs da gdod dang*/ /khab ral dang ni khri rkang dang*//brdal dang gding dang g.yen pa dang*/ /ras chen bde gshegs chos gos so// bzhi pa sor bshags kyi sde la bzhi yod de/ grong dang khyim gzhan nyid dang ni/ /bslab pa rnams dang dgon pa ni//sangs rgyas phan pa gsungs pa yis/ /so sor bshags par bya bar gsungs// lnga pa nyes byas kyi sde la brgya dang bcu gnyis te/ sham thabs la ni rnam pa bdun/ /stod g.yogs la yang rnam gsum dang*/ /shin tu bsdam la sogs pa lnga/ /mgo g.yogs la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /mchong ba la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /lus la sogs pa rnam pa lnga/ /'dug par bya ba dgu dag dang*/ /byin len bya ba brgyad rnams so/ /zas la legs par bya ba drug /tsug tsug la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /'bru nas tha dad byed pa lnga/ /lag pa ldag la sogs pa lnga/ /'phya ba la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ /lhung bzed la yang rnam pa bcu/ /'greng bar byed la sogs pa lnga/ /mgo g.yogs la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /do ker can la sogs pa lnga/ /glang chen la sogs gzhon pa lnga/ /lag na 'khar ba la sogs drug /na ba rnam pa bzhi rnams so// gnyis pa bsgrub pa'i bslab bya bshad pa ni/ rnam par byang ba'i yon tan ni/

/gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i phyir/ /bsgrub pa'i bslab bya bslab par bya/ /khyad par lhag pa'i sems dang ni/ /shes rab yongs su sbyang ba'i phyir/ /spong khang brtsig cing spong ba pa'i/ /zhal ta pa sogs dang bcas pas/ /zhi gnas gso sbyong bsgom par bya//de yang dge 'dun bsdu ba'i tshe/ /gaṇ+ḍi tshad ldan tshul bzhin brdung*/ /yang na 'khar sil dung dang rnga/ /de rnams skabs dang sbyar bas so/ /mthun pa'i gnas su mtshams bcad cing*/ /de nas mtshams la dbang ba kun/ /las rnams kun la thog mar ni/ /bshags shing bsdams pas dag pa'am/ /yang na ltung ba byin brlabs te/ /lus sam 'dun pa dag gis sam/ /yongs dag gis kyang gcig tu 'dug/ /gal te bcad pa'i mtshams min yang*/ /mtshams dang nye 'khor 'ga' shes bya//lhag pa'i tshul khrims rin po che/ /gso zhing sbyong bar bya ba'i phyir/ /zla ba phyed phyed mtshams rnams su/ /bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa'i/ /mthun pa'i gso sbyong nyid la 'bad/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das gyur kyang*/ /ston pa bla na med pa ni/ /so so thar pa lags pas na/ /gus pa mchog gis mnyan par bya/ /gzhan yang mthun pa'i gso sbyong ni/ /gnod pa bzlog par bya ba dang*/ /kun nas shis par bya sogs la// de dang de yi gso sbyong bya//srog chags gnod spangs la sogs phyir/ /dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya'am ni/ /yang na dbyar tha'i nya nas bzung*/ /zla ba gsum gyi bar dag tu/ /gnas gcig gnas pa'i cho gas gnas/ /gnas pa mi bde'i phyogs rnams dgag /de yi mtha' ma'i bco lnga'i mthar/ /dgag pa dbye ba'i cho ga bya/ /bcu drug nyin mo nas bzung ste/ /zla ba lnga yi bar du yang*/ /sra brkyang legs par bting ba la/ /phan yon rnam pa bcu thob bo//gos la 'tsho ba'i yo byad ni/ /snam sbyar la sogs bcu gsum ste/ /de bzhin zhwa dang ska rags rnams/ /'tsho ba'i yo byad phran tsheg go/ /theb gzhan lhag pa'i yo byad dang*/ /de yi phran tsheg nyid du bstan/

/de sogs 'tsho mkho lhag pa yi/ /gos sogs rung dang byin brlabs shing*/ /spyir ni ngan ngon chog shes bya/ /ko lpags kyi ni lham dang stan/ /phal cher mtha' 'khob 'dir rung la/ /mig nad sogs la phan pa'i phyir/ /dom gyi pags pa blang bar bya//dge slong bde la reg gnas dang*/ /sbyin po bsod nams thob pa'i phyir/ /log 'tsho spang zhing yang dag pa'i/ /'tsho ba kun nas bsgrub par bya/ /de yang dus su rung ba dang*/ /thun tshod rung dang zhag bdun pa/ /'tsho ba'i bar du bcang rung dag /rung dang brlab 'os byin brlab dang*/ /longs spyod tshe dang lag nya sogs/ kha na ma tho med par bya//gal te rdzogs pa'i dge slong dag /ltung ba nyid dang bcas gyur na/ /mthol dang bshags dang bsdom pa dang*/ /spo mgu dbyung sogs kyis dag bya/ /legs par bcos su mi 'dod na/ /bsdig smad bskrad sogs gang 'os sbyar/ /tshul khrims yongs su dag pa la/ /phan yon rnam pa mang thob cing*/ /mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyi/ / bde la reg par gnas par 'gyur/ /bslab pa phul ( bslab pa phul ba'i cho ga yod mchan/ ) dang shi 'phos dang*/ /dge rtsa chad dang mtshan ma gnyis/ /byung ba sogs kyis sdom pa gtang*/ /mdor na rung ba dang nye na/ /de ni kun nas blang bya zhing*/ /mi rung ba dang nye ba ni/ /kun du spyad par mi bya'o//de ltar nges par 'byung ba yi/ /tshul khrims dag pa la gnas shing*/ /bden pa mthong bar 'dod pa dag/ /thog mar thos pa'i don 'dzin bya/ /de nas thos don bsam bya zhing*/ /bsam don sgom la sbyor bar bya/ /mi sdug pa dang rlung la ni/ /dmigs nas zhi gnas bsgrub par bya/ /zhi gnas ting 'dzin rab grub kyang*/ /lhag mthong shes rab med na ni/ /nyon mongs drung nas mi 'byin phyir/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi bsgoms pas/ /tshogs kyi lam dang de nas ni/ /nges 'byed cha ( sbyor lam mo mchan/ ) mthun bzhi bsgrod nas/ /sems kyi skad cig bcu drug gis/

/bden pa mngon du rtogs par byed/ /mthong ba'i lam yang de la gas/ /mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /mi slob pa yi lam gsum ni/ /'phags pa'i gang zag ces bya ste/ /'di la skyes bu zung bzhi dang*/ /gang zag ya brgyad ces su grags//de yang rgyun du zhugs pa la/ /'bras bur zhugs dang 'bras gnas gnyis/ /de bzhin lan gcig phyir 'ong gnyis/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'ang zhugs gnas gnyis/ /dgra bcom zhugs gnas gnyis rnams te/ /zung du sgrong tshe zung bzhi dang*/ /so sor sgrong na ya brgyad do/ /dgra bcom 'bras gnas nyid la yang*/ /lhag bcas lhag ma med pa gnyis/ /yang na dbang po rno rtul gyis/ /nyan thos rigs ni rnam bdun dang*/ /rang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas te/ /rnam pa dgu yi dbye ba'ang bshad/ /sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang las/ so so thar pa'i skabs te le'u dang po'o// //sdom pa gnyis pa byang chub sems kyi sdom pa/ srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa mngon byed phyir/ /chen po bdun sogs kyis 'phags pa'i/ /theg pa la ni 'jug par bya/ /theg pa che de mdor bsdu na/ /thog mar byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /byang chub spyod pa rlabs po cher/ /kun nas bslab par bya ba'o/ /byang chub mchog dang 'dir bshad pa/ /rgyu dang ngo bo dbye ba dang*/ /cho ga bslab bya phan yon dang*/ /nyams pa'i nyes dmigs phyir bcos so/ / zhes don brgyad las/ skye ba'i rgyu ni/ rgyal bas byin brlabs rigs mang dang*/ /dad dang snying stobs phun tshogs ldan/ /byang chub sems rab skye ba'i rgyu/ /khyad par byams brtse bsgoms pas skye// gnyis pa byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ni/ 'gro kun 'dren phyir rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bdag gis thob par 'dod pa dang*/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo yin// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ dbye sgo sa mtshams dpe ngo bo/ /sa mtshams kyis phye mos sogs bzhi/

/dpe yis sa sogs nyi shu gnyis/ /ngo bo kun rdzob don dam gnyis/ /kun rdzob smon 'jug rnam gnyis so/ /sangs rgyas thob 'dod smon pa ste/ /sgrub par byed pa 'jug pa'o/ /rgyal sras bslab pa khas blangs nas/ /byang sems sdom pa ldan par brjod// bzhi pa cho ga ni/ kun rdzob byang sems cho ga ni/ /bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas/ /nus dang ldan las blang bar bya/ /med na rten nam dkon mchog las/ /len du rung la slob ma yang*/ /rigs sad skyabs song smon pa'i rten/ /so thar smon ldan 'jug pa'i rten/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gis/ /cho ga'i gtso bo rnam gnyis te/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis legs bstan pa/ /klu sgrub zhi lha'i gdams ngag ni/ /mchod pa skyabs 'gro sdig bshags dang*/ /yi rang bskul gsol bsngo ba ste/ /sbyor ba'i cho ga rnam pa bdun/ /dngos gzhi sems bskyed sdom bzung gnyis/ /rjes ni dbugs dbyung gzhan gzengs bstod// cho ga dngos la/ zab mo lta rgyud kyi lugs dang*/ rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi lugs gnyis las/ gnyis pa rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi lugs la/ smon pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa bzung ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rgyal ba byams pas nyer bstan pa'i/ /man ngag las byung cho ga ni/ /gsol gdab tshogs bsags skyabs 'gro'i mchog /smon pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa gsum/ /dngos gzhi byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /dga' bskyed bslab bya brjod pa rjes/ /'di ni smon pa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa 'jug pa'i sdom pa bzung ba ni/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa bzung ba'i phyir/ /gsol gdab thun mong bar chad dri/ /mchod dbul myur du sbyin par gsol/ /thun mong min pa'i bar chad dri/ /bslab pa khas blang dga' ba sgom/ /de ni sbyor ba'i chos bdun no/ /dngos gzhi byang sems sdom pa blang*/ /mjug chog mkhyen par gsol ba dang*/ /phan yon bstan dang gsang bar gdams/ /bslab bya gtang rag dang rnam lngas/

/'jug pa'i sdom pa sbyin pa'o// lnga pa bslab bya la/ smon pa'i bslab bya dang*/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya'o/ /dang po ni/ sems can gcig kyang blos mi spang*/ /rtag tu sems de'i phan yon bsam/ /tshogs gnyis bsags la brtson par bya/ /yang yang byang chub sems gnyis sbyang*/ /nag po'i chos bzhi spangs nas ni/ /dkar po'i chos bzhi bsten par bya// gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya la/ dgag pa'i bslab bya dang*/ sgrub pa'i bslab bya gnyis kyi/ dang po la gnyis las/ rgya chen spyod rgyud pa'i lugs/ byang sa'i don bsdus sdom pa nyi shu par gsungs pa ni/ rnyed dang bkur stir chags pa yi/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la/ /ser snas chos nor mi ster dang*/ /gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par/ /khros nas gzhan la 'tshog pa dang*/ /theg pa chen po spong byed cing*/ /dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o/ / zhes rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi/ de nas de nyid las gsungs pa'i nyes byas kyi sde ni/ dkon mchog gsum la gsum mi mchod/ /'dod pa'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug /rgan pa rnams la gus mi byed/ /dris pa la ni lan mi 'debs/ /mgron pos bdag gir mi byed cing*/ /gser la sogs pa len mi byed/ /chos 'dod pa la sbyin mi byed/ /tshul khrims 'chal rnams yal bar 'dor/ /pha rol dad phyir slob mi byed/ /sems can don la bya ba chung*/ /snying brtser bcas na mi dge med/ /'tsho ba log pa dang du len/ /'phyar nas rab tu rgod la sogs/ /'khor ba gcig pur bgrod par sems/ /grags pa ma yin mi spong ba/ /nyon mongs bcas kyang 'chos mi byed/ /gshe la lan du gshe la sogs/ /khros pa rnams ni yal bar 'dor/ /pha rol shad kyis 'chags pa spong*/ /khros pa'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug /rnyed bkur 'dod phyir 'khor rnams sdud/ /le lo la sogs sel mi byed/ /chags pas bre mo'i gtam la bsten/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi don mi 'tshol/

/bsam gtan sgrib pa spong mi byed/ /bsam gtan ro la yon tan blta/ /nyan thos theg pa spong bar byed/ /rang tshul yod bzhin de la brtsam/ /brtson min phyi rol bstan bcos brtson/ /brtson par byas kyang de la dga'/ /theg pa chen po spong bar byed/ /bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod/ /chos kyi don du 'gro mi byed/ /don la smod dang yi ger bsten/ /dgos pa'i grogs su 'gro mi byed/ /nad pa'i rim gro bya ba spong*/ /sdug bsngal sel bar mi byed dang*/ /bag med pa la rig mi ston/ /byas la lan du phan mi 'dog /gzhan gyi mya ngan sel mi byed/ /nor 'dod pa la sbyin mi byed/ /'khor rnams kyi ni don mi byed/ /gzhan gyi blo dang mthun mi 'jug /yon tan bsngags pa smrar mi byed/ /rkyen du mtshams par tshar mi gcod/ /rdzu 'phrul bsdigs la sogs mi byed/ /snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*/ /sems dge ba la nyes pa med/ / ces nyes byas bzhi bcu rtsa drug gnyis pa zab mo lta brgyud lugs ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog dang*/ /dam pa'i chos ni spong ba dang*/ /rtags can chad pas gcod pa dang*/ /mtshams med lnga yi las byed dang*/ /chad par lta ba 'dzin pa ste/ /byang sems rgyal po'i rtsa ltung lnga/ /grong dang ljongs dang grong khyer dang*/ /grong rdal yul 'khor 'joms pa dang*/ /byang sems blon po'i rtsa ltung lnga/ /ma sbyangs pa la stong nyid ston/ /theg chen la zhugs phyir bzlog dang*/ /so thar spangs te theg chen sbyor/ /slob pa'i theg pa la smod dang*/ /rnyed phyir bdag bstod gzhan smod dang*/ /zab mo bzod par brdzun smrar dang*/ /rngan par dkon mchog dkor sbyin len/ /spong rdzas kha ton par sbyin te/ /las dang po yi ltung ba brgyad// sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu dngos dmigs bsal du bshad pa ni/ skyabs 'gro btang dang smon sems log /bslab pa phul dang log lta skyes/ /nyan rang yid byed skyes pa dang*/

/sems can blo yis spangs pa rnams/ /byang sdom rtsad nas gtong ba'i rgyu/ /rtsa ba'i ltung bas nyams shing 'jig /nyes byas sogs kyis na smad do// gnyis pa bsgrub pa'i bslab bya bshad pa ni/ bsgrub pa'i bslab bya phar phyin drug/ /bsdu na tshul khrims rnam gsum spyad/ / pha rol du phyin pa drug bshad na/ tshul khrims gsum yang 'dus pas na de bshad par bya ste/ de la bsdus don rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ grangs nges go rim nges pa dang*/ /mtshan nyid dang ni nges tshig dang*/ /rab tu dbye dang bsdu ba ste/ /drug gis pha rol phyin pa bsdus/ / zhes pa ltar drug gnyis pa yan lag rgyas par bshad pa ni/ dang po sbyin pa la/ de la dang po sbyin pa ni/ zang zing chos dang mi 'jigs pa'i/ /sbyin pa rnam gsum sbyin par bya/ / gnyis pa tshul khrims ni/ tshul khrims sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ /dge ba chos sdud tshul khrims dang*/ /sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so/ / gsum pa bzod pa ni/ ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal dang len bzod pa dang*/ /chos la nges sems bzod pa'o/ / bzhi pa brtson 'grus ni/ go cha yi ni brtson 'grus dang*/ /de bzhin sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang*/ /chog par mi 'dzin brtson 'grus brtsom/ /

lnga pa bsam gtan ni/ mthong chos bder gnas bsam gtan dang*/ /yon tan sgrub pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ /sems can don dmigs bsam gtan bsgom/ / drug pa shes rab ni/ 'jig rten pa yi shes rab dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa dman pa dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa chen po'am/ /yang na thos bsam sgom byung ngo*// spyi don drug pa phan yon ni/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi nang du chud/ /bslab pa kun gyi rten du gyur/ /sdig pa'i phung po rtsad nas gcod/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rtsa ba tshugs/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur/ /sems can kun la phan pa mchog /myur du rdzogs 'tshang rgya ba ste/ /smon sems phan yon rnam pa brgyad/ /rang don bsod nams rgyun mi 'chad/ /gzhan don mtha' yas 'byung ba ste/ /khyad par 'jug pa'i phan yon gnyis/ /grangs su chad par bstan pa'o/ /mdor na gnas skabs mthar thug gi/ /phan bde thams cad 'byung ba ni/ /grangs su ma chad phan yon no// bdun pa nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ sems mchog de las nyams gyur na/ /rgyal kun mi mnyes 'gro kun bslus/ /rang gzhan don nyams ngan 'gror 'gro/ /de bas 'bad de sems 'di srungs// brgyad pa phyir bcos ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba chen po rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la bshags/ /sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ /zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags/ /gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams/ /gzhan yang rgyal sras nam snying gi/ /mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal na/ /rmi lam skal mtshams lus bstan te/ /de yis ltung ba las slong byed/ /ma grub na ni skya rengs la/ /gsol ba btab na de yis sbron/ /gzhan yang nyin mtshan thun drug tu/ /phung po gsum pa la sogs pas/ /'chags la nyes pa'i chus mi gos/ /chos kun gzod nas zhi ba ste/ /mkha' dang sgyu ma ltar shes nas/ /'gro la snying rje mi 'dor ba/ /de la nyes pa'i gnas mi dmigs//sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang zhes bya ba las/

sdom pa gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i skabs te le'u gnyis pa'o// //sdom pa gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa/ sdom pa gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa bshad par bya ba la/ rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag bsdus te bstan pas spyi'i khog dbub pa ni/ de nas rdo rje theg pa yi/ /dam tshig rnam par bzhag 'dod nas/ /spyi don cung zad 'dir bstan bya/ /gdul bya gang zag khyad par dang*/ /bgrod bya lam rim khyad par dang*/ /thob bya 'bras bu'i khyad rnams kyis/ /mdo las khyad par mang 'phags pa/ /gsang sngags theg pa'i khyad chos te/ /dbye na bya rgyud spyod rgyud dang*/ /rnal 'byor dang ni bla med do// de lta bu'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi so sor bshad pa la/ dang po bya ba'i rgyud ni/ phyi yi bya ba gtsor ston pas/ /bya ba'i rgyud ces grags de la/ /dbye na drug gam gsum mam gnyis/ /mngon rtogs lam gyi rim pa ni/ /'jug spyod dbang dang dam tshig dang*/ /sbyor spyod mtshan bcas mtshan med dang*/ /sgrub spyod dngos grub sgrub pa dang*/ /grub spyod 'bras bu'i dam tshig go/ gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud ni/ phyi dang nang gi bya ba gnyis/ /mnyam por spyod pa spyod rgyud de/ /dbye na rigs ni rnam pa gsum/ /mngon rtogs lam gyi rim pa ni/ /phyi yi 'jug spyod dbang dam tshig /nang 'jug mtshan bcas mtshan med do/ /sbyor spyod mtshan bcas bzlas brjod de/ /mtshan med ting 'dzin goms pa'i thabs/ /sgrub spyod phyi nang dngos grub bo// gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud ni/ nang gi rnal 'byor gtsor ston pas/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du rab grags pa/ /dbye na brjod bya rigs lnga ste/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i lam dag ni/ /'jug tu rung ba'i gang zag dang*/ /thabs la legs par 'jug pa'i sgo/ /'bras bu thob par byed pa'i thabs/ /'bras bu rnam par bzhag pas bsdus/ /'jug sgo dbang dang dam tshig dang*/ /thob thabs bzlas brjod bsgom pa ste/

/ting nge 'dzin ni rnam gsum dang*/ /rnal 'byor bzhi sogs brten nas so// bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtser gyur pas/ /rnal 'byor bla med grags de la/ /dbye na rjod byed thabs dang ni/ /shes rab dang ni gnyis med kyis/ /brjod par bya ba rigs drug ston/ /mngon rtogs rgyu thabs 'bras gsum ste/ /rgyu ni shes rab brtson ldan la/ /thabs ni smin byed dbang bzhi dang*/ /de yis thob pa'i sdom pa dang*/ /de mthar phyin pa'i spyod pa dang*/ /lam dngos nyams su len dang bzhi/ /sdom pa bsrung dang bza' ba dang*/ /spyod dang mi 'bral dam tshig bzhi/ /spyod pa thun mong thun min gnyis/ /lam dngos nyams su len pa la/ /dngos ni bskyed dang rdzogs rim ste/ /de grogs gtor ma sbyin sreg sogs/ /nye grogs gnas dus grogs rdzas sogs/ /'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen no// 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bstan bcos chen po dam tshig rgya mtsho 'chad par byed pa la gsum/1 mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/ bstan bcos dngos kyi don/ mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /sangs rgyas tshogs dang sems dpa' che/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo/ /mngon du ston la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ rgyal bas rgyud kun las gsungs pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i de nyid rnams bshad bya// gnyis pa bstan bcos dngos kyi don la gsum/ brtul zhugs dang sdom pa len yul bstan pa'i sgo nas mdor bstan/ brtul zhugs dang sdom pa nyes dmigs dang bcas pa rgyas par bshad/ nyes pa rnams bshags dgos par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje theg par 'jug pa rnams/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la/ /slob ma sangs rgyas mngon 'dod pas/ /smin byed dbang bzhi tshul bzhin zhu/ /thob nas brtul zhugs sdom pa dang*/

/dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag bcas/ /dang po bar ma mchog dang ni/ /phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid/ /rgyud rnams rim pas tshul bzhin zhu/ /rang gi srog bzhin legs par bsrung*// gnyis pa brtul zhugs dang sdom pa nyes dmigs dang bcas pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ brtul zhugs bshad/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa bshad/ de dag gi go rim/ nyes pa ltung ba rnams bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ rdo rje theg par gnas rnams kyi/ /brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ /srog gcod rdzun du smrar ba dang*/ /gzhan gyi bud med nor 'phrog dang*/ /chang 'thung smyos par byed pa ste/ /spang zhing bslab pa'i gzhi lnga'o/ /rgyan po kha na ma tho'i zas/ /ngan tshig bstan bcos smrar ba dang*/ /mu stegs kla klo'i chos spyod pa/ /rnam lnga bya ba min pa lnga/ /dud 'gro byis pa bud med dang*/ /skyes pa mchod rten bsnun mi bya/ /dge ba'i grogs dang rje bo dang*/ /dge 'dun rnams dang rgyal ba dang*/ /yid brtan rnams la 'khu mi bya/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la/ /mig sogs dbang po'i zhen mi bya/ / mjug bsdu ba ni/ 'di rnams dang po'i brtul zhugs so// gnyis pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa bshad pa la gnyis/ theg chen spyi dang thun mong ba'i sdom pa/ bla med thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thun mong spyi yi sdom pa ni/ /rnam pa lnga ru rgyal bas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /smon 'jug sems bskyed tshul khrims dang*/ /sdom dang dge ba chos sdud dang*/ /don byed rnam gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang*/ /bla ma'i dam tshig rdo rje'i rigs/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rin chen no/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg pa yi/ /dam pa'i chos 'dzin pad+ma'o/ /mchod bstod las kyi bya ba rnams/ /so sor 'dzin byed las kyi rigs// gnyis pa bla med thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa ni/

khyad par bla med sdom pa ni/ /rdo rje rigs la srog gcod de/ /zhing bcu rlung dang rtogs par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs la ma byin len/ /nor dang bud med theg pa che/ /gzhan dang rang don sgrub byed pa'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig mchog /las chos dam tshig phyag rgya che/ /bud med yin te bsten pa'o/ /las kyi rigs ni rdzun du smrar/ /bdag dang sems can mi dmigs par/ /mya ngan 'das la 'god par grags/ /'khor lo'i rigs la sha lnga dang*/ /chang dang yul kun bsten pa ste/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rim pa yi/ /ma nyams spyod pa bla na med// gsum pa de rnams kyi go rim bstan pa ni/ dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong dang*/ /ye shes kyis rgan rim pa bzhin/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /rnam grangs mkhas pas shes par bya// bzhi pa nyes pa ltung ba rnams bshad pa la/ de la rnam dbye'i dam tshig ni/ /rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag brgyad/ /gzhan yang dam tshig bco lnga dang*/ /yan lag rnam grangs bcas pa'o// zhes mdor bstan nas/ rgyas par bshad pa la lnga/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad/ phrin las sgrub pa la brten pa'i ltung ba bco lnga/ de las yan lag tu gyur pa bdun/ de rnams nyes pa che chung gi rim pa bstan pa'o//dang po ni/ de las rtsa ba bcu bzhi ni/ /bla ma dam pa mi brnyas dang*/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las mi 'da' zhing*/ /rdo rje'i spun la khro mi bya/ /sems can kun la byams mi spang*/ /byang chub sems ni nyams mi bya/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' la mi smad/ /gsang ba ma smin la mi bsgrag /phung po khams sogs mi brnyas dang*/ /dag pa'i chos la som nyi spang*/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan min/ /ming bral don la sgro 'dogs spang*/ /dad ldan sems can sun mi dbyung*/ /dam tshig rnyed pa spang mi bya/ /shes rab bud med mi smad pa'o/ /nyon mongs drag po la brten nas/ /'dir 'gal rtsa ltung zhes brjod do//

gnyis pa yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad ni/ de nas phyogs mthun yan lag ni/ /dam med rig ma bsten mi bya/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa spang*/ /ma gsungs pa yi rig ma las/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi blang mi bya/ /gsang chos dus ldan bstan par bya/ /chos dri bre mo'i gtam mi bya/ /nyan thos nang du zhag bdun min/ /rnal 'byor ye shes mi shes par/ /rdo rje 'dzin par khas mi blang*/ /dus min gsang chos bstan pa min/ /'dir 'gal yan lag ltung ba brgyad// gsum pa phrin las sgrub pa la brten pa'i ltung ba bco lnga bshad pa ni/ gzhan yang rnam pa bco lnga ste/ /mchod sogs dus las 'das pa dang*/ /rang lha blang dor byed pa gzhan/ /phyi rol 'jig rten lha dga' dang*/ /dngos po thar zug zhen cing sgom/ /dbang ma rdzogs par gzhan la bskur/ /tshe 'di'i don du bstan pa dang*/ /'og ma'i bslab pa khyad du gsod/ /rnying phyir rang tshul gong mar ston/ /nus med phrin las rtsom pa dang*/ /don med snyoms las kyis gnas byed/ /brtse sems spong bar byed pa dang*/ /dman pa'i spyod pa byed la dga'/ /'jig rten g.yeng bas dus 'da' zhing*/ /nyams pa yal bar 'dor byed cing*/ /rang gi spyod pa dor byed pa/ /'di rnams ltung bar gsungs pa yin// bzhi pa de las yan lag tu gyur pa bdun bshad pa ni/ dam pa nyer bsten gcig shos min/ /snod dang ldan pa rnam par brtag /'dod phyir gzhan la gnod pa spang*/ /dkon mchog la sogs nor la min/ /gzhan don skad cig yal mi dor/ /dge kun sems bskyed bsngo bas bzung*/ /rnam shes 'pho ba'i de nyid mkhas/ /'di yang yan lag nyes par bshad// lnga pa de rnams nyes pa che chung gi rim pa spyir bstan pa ni/ mdor na rgyud kyi rim pa bzhin/ /dbang bzhi'i tshul dang rjes 'brel bas/ /blo dang ldan pas legs par spyad/ /kham sogs dbye ba'i go rim yang*/ /nyon mongs kun bslang der shes ldan/ /lus ngag sbyor brten bar bcad cing*/

/ma 'khrul 'gyod med tshad las 'das/ /bdun ldan pham pa zhes brjod la/ /dngos gzhi med dang tshad las 'das/ /ltung ba zhes brjod lhag ma 'dra/ /de bas dman dang yan lag gi/ /gtso bo lci ste sbom po bzhin/ /yan lag gzhan dag ltung byed mtshungs/ /phyogs mthun phra mo nyes byas te/ /ltung ba'i gzugs brtan nyes med dag /legs shes gnyen po rab tu brten// da ni dam tshig thams cad bsdu na/ dkon mchog phyi nang byang chub sems/ /yul dang yul can phyi nang rkyen/ /tshar bcad rjes bzung phrin las su/ /dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa'o// gsum pa nyes pa rnams bshags dgos par bstan pa la gsum/ bshags tshul/ ma bshags na nyes pa 'byung tshul/ ma nyams pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ gal te nyams na bshags bya ste/ /dbang bskur sbyin sreg gsang sngags dang*/ / maṇ+ḍal gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ /nyams pa'i tshad du sbyar te spyad/ /lus ngag yid kyi rim pa yis/ /dka' spyad bsam gtan tshul bzhin bya// gnyis pa ma bshags na nyes pa 'byung tshul ni/ ma bshags rdo rje dmyal ba sogs/ /tshul min sdug bsngal bsam las 'das// gsum pa ma nyams pa'i phan yon ni/ ma nyams rab ni tshe gcig gis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid 'grub cing*/ /thun mong dngos grub thams cad kun/ /thogs med bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub// gsum pa mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /rgyud rnams kun du gsungs pa smin grol don bstan pa/ /de dag snying po dam tshig rtsa ltung yan lag bcas/ /rgyal sras mkhas grub rnams kyis rgya cher bstan gyur kyang*/ /snyigs dus dad ldan deng sogs theg mchog mos pa rnams/ /tshe thung sna tshogs g.yeng bas spyad par mi nus la/ /phan par bsam nas rang byung rol pa'i rdo rje yis/ /rgyal sras rgyud 'grel mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad ltar bris/ / zhes pas bsdus tshul bstan/ nyes pa'i tshogs rnams rdo rje 'dzin dang mkha' 'gro la/

/bzod par gsol cig sgrib pa thams cad sel bar shog /dge ba ci yod mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la/ /bsngos pas sgrib gsum bral ba'i rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /e waṃ mā yā rdo rje rol pa sems dpa'i thugs te gnyis med rol pa gang*/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor mar ldan rab tu dgyes pa'i lha tshogs gar bcas pa/ /spros med rang bzhin spros pa'i sgra dbyangs chos tshul rab sgrog mchog rab sems can rnams/ /srid pa 'dir ni zhi bar rol pas rgyu dang mi rgyu lhan cig gar byed shog/ ces pa rnams kyis bzod gsol dang bsngo ba sogs bstan pa'o// sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang ces bya ba mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ sdom pa gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi skabs te le'u gsum pa'o// // de nas de ltar du bshad pa'i sdom pa gsum po de/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ji ltar gnas pa dang*/ bsrung ba'i tshul ni/ ji ltar zhe na bshad pa/ de ltar so thar sdom pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dang rig pa 'dzin//rnam gsum gang zag gcig rgyud la/ /gnas tshe ngo bo tha dad ste//srung na'ang so sor chol par bsrung*/ /'dom thug 'gal ba byung na ni//gong ma'i bslab pa dang du len/ /skyon kun 'og ma zil gyis gnon//de bzhin yon tan yar ldan te/ /gtong dang thob pa tha dad te//sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang ces bya ba mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ sdom pa gsum gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ldan tshul gyi skabs te le'u bzhi pa ste mtha' ma'o// //de ltar sdom gsum rnam bzhag ni/ /nyer mkho'i bum pa zhes bya ba/ /thar 'dod skyes bu'i tshogs rnams la/ /nye bar mkho ba'i bum pa nyid/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i snying khu ni/ /sdom pa dam tshig lags pas na/ /nyams len snying por dril ba 'di/ /bye ba ring bsrel nyid du'ang 'gyur/ /des na mdo rgyud lung 'dren med/

/rang gis brtag pa'i mtha' dpyad med/ /'on kyang gong ma'i zhal gyi lung*/ /dri med yid rton 'os pa'i phul/ /snying rje'i bdud rtsi gsol gsol nas/ /mkhyen pa'i bzhin ras zla med pa/ /dpal ldan karma bka' brgyud kyi/ /gsung gi zer yang bdud rtsi nyid/ /rang blo'i rnam dpyod nyag phran ni/ /sngon med gnam ru la sbyar yang*/ /skyes thob sbyor byung rtsal zhan pas/ /zab mo'i don la phog pa dka'/ /'on kyang gzhung bshad 'ga' zhig gi/ /spyi dang tshig don mngar ba'i ro/ /cung zad myangs pa'i phun tshogs kyang*/ /mngon du byas pa'i tshul can yin/ /sdom pa dang ni dam tshig dag /snying gi thig ler mi 'dzin na/ /bskyed rdzogs las bzhi'i phrin las sogs/ /rtsa ba rul ba'i shing bzhin 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'di tshul mi ldan na/ /sku bsod rgyas pa'i bla ma yang*/ /mi gtsang phung po dar bzang gis/ /mdzes par byas pa'i ngang tshul 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho des ni rin chen 'dzin/ /sdom pa gsum 'dis bslab gzhi 'dzin/ /bslab pa'i gzhis ni 'jig rten dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal 'dzin 'gyur/ /so so thar pa'i rtsa ba brtan/ /byang chub sems kyi sdong po mtho/ /gsang ba sngags kyi 'bras lding na/ /rgyal bstan rdzogs pa'i shing gcig ste/ /gzhan gnod spangs pa'i lding khang rtser/ /gzhan phan 'gog pa med pa'i 'phrul/ /smin grol nor bu'i tog bkod na/ /bstan 'dzin mchog tu gus pas 'bod/ /bdag gi lhag bsam gyis bskrun pa'i/ /gzhung bzang ut+pal chun po 'di/ /ris med phyogs kyi bu mo yi/ /rna ba'i rgyan du byed gyur cig /lhag bsam dag pas byas pa dang*/ /smon lam btab pa'i bden pa yis/ /gzhung 'di'i tshul las mi 'da' ba'i/ /brtul zhugs sus kyang 'dzin gyur cig /sdom gsum ldan pa thams cad la/ /bdag gis snying nas dad 'phel bas/ /phyogs ris med pa de yi mthus/ /gsar rnying kun gyi gsos su shog/ /gyi nar byung rgyal ma yin par/

/dge sbyor gzhan yang blos dor te/ /lus sems zhag mang ngal byas pas/ /de tsam gzhan la phan thogs shog /kun kyang tshul 'dir zhugs pa la/ /gal srid bag med nyon mongs kyis/ /'gal ba'i spyod pa byung srid na/ /bshags bsdoms tshad dang ldan gyur cig /de lta'i spyod pa rlabs po ches/ /tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang 'grub nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god gyur cig /tshul dang mthun par spyod pa'i mthus/ /'jig rten kun kyang nad mug zhi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa sogs/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig/

ces pa 'di ni sngon nas sprul pa'i sku'i bkas kyang bskul zhing snyan ngag gis tshigs su bcad pa'i yi ge rten bcas kyis kyang bskul ba gnang ba dang*/ grwa pa gzhan 'ga' zhig la'ang nye bar mkho ba dang*/ nang chen pa blo gsar karma mtha' yas kyis kyang nan gyis bskul na'ang*/ re zhig lus pa la slad nas rgyal rong rgyal sras nang so chos mdzad kun dga' chos 'phel gyi nyams bzhes su'ang mkho ba bcas kyis/ 7sku zhabs rin po che si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi zhabs pad spyi bo'i rgyan du byed pa karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyis mdo smad dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du mgyogs par grub par bgyis pas nyes pa'i cha mchis na/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la snying nas bshags shing*/ dge ba'i cha mchis na sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba ji snyed mchis pa dag gi sna 'dren du gyur te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i go 'phang du 'jug pa dang*/ gnas skabs su'ang dge legs du ma'i dpal dang ldan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang zhes bya ba rang 'dra'i rgyud la 'tshams par 'khril ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so// bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid//skyabs gnas bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad+mo//spyi bor mchod nas sdom gsum rnam gzhag ni//gsung rab rgya mtsho'i snying po 'dir bstan bya//de ltar mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas 'dir bstan par bya ba ni/ de'ang sdom du brjod na/ sdom pa gsum ni so thar dang*/ /byang sdom sngags kyi sdom pa'o//de las so so thar pa ni/ /rang rkang theg dman 'dul ba'i don//'on kyang sdom pa thams cad dang*/ /bsam gtan la sogs yon tan tshogs//du ma'i rten du 'gyur bar bshad//byang sdom zhes bya theg chen ni/ /pha rol phyin pa'i sdom pa ste//sngags sdom dbang bskur las byung ba/

/rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig go//zhes bya ste/ de la sdom pa gsum ni/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o/ /de las so so thar pa ni/ rang rkang nyid du na theg dman 'dul ba'i brjod bya ste/ de'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes bya ba ni 'dul ba nyid gnas pa la rag las par 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan yang yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi yin par gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi rten du 'gyur ba dang*/ theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin na theg pa chen po'i so so thar pa zhes par gnas 'gyur bar yang bzhed pa zhig dang*/ mthar thug phyir mi ldog pa'i myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rgyu zhig go/ /rten du 'gyur ba zhes pa'i don la 'di'i rten med na gong ma gnyis gtan nas brten sa med pa lta bu ni ma yin te/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyang yod do/ /sdom pa gnyis pa ni/ theg pa chen po byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las gsungs pa ste byang chub mchog tu sems skyed par byed pa'i sdom pa'o/ /sngags sdom ni/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bskur las byung ba'i dam tshig go/ /de las phyi ma gnyis la theg chen zhes bya ba'i don ni/ theg pa zhes pa khur theg pa lta bu'i don yin pas rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don gyi khur chen po dang ldan pas de skad bya ba dang*/ snga ma ni rang don kho na'i khur chung ngu dang ldan pas theg dman no//yang 'di skad du/ de las sdom pa dang po ni/ /nges 'byung bsam pas blangs pa yi//spong bdun 'khor bcas tshul khrims dang*//gnyis pa nyes spyod kun spong gi/ /tshul khrims gzhan phan bdag nyid can//de steng thabs shes rtsis zin pa/ /gsang sngags sdom pa'i khyad chos yin//sdom pa gsum po 'di dag gi/ /bslab pa'i cha shas ma lus pa//rdzogs par slob pa'i nang du ni/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad 'dus//zhes bya ste/

de'ang sdom pa dang po ni/ mi dge ba bcu'i nang nas mi dge ba bdun 'khor dang bcas pa spong ba'i tshul khrims so/ /mi dge ba bdun ni/ lus kyi mi dge ba srog bcad pa/ ma byin par len pa/ mi tshangs spyod pa bcas gsum dang*/ ngag gi mi dge ba rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'chal bcas te/ de bdun spong bar byed pas spong bdun zhes dang*/ 'khor dang bcas pa zhes pa ni spang bya gzhan thams cad de bdun gyi yan lag gam 'khor yin pas te 'khor du ni yid kyi mi dge ba gsum yang 'du'o/ /yid kyi mi dge ba gsum ni/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta gsum ste lus ngag yid gsum ka'i mi dge ba thams cad spong ba'i tshul khrims ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'o//'di la sdom pa zhes pa'i sgra don/ nyes spyod spong ba nyid la 'jug pas na byang sdom gyi mtshan nyid nyes spyod kun spong nyid yin na'ang byang sdom gyi khyad chos la gzhan phan sgrub pa kho na gtso che bas de ma bsnan na de'i mtshan nyid mi tshang bar 'gyur zhes sku zhabs rin po che nas bka' stsal gnang ba ltar/ byang sdom gyi bslab bya thams cad bsdu na nyes spyod kun spong gi tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims te/ tshul khrims rnam pa gsum du nges pas de gsum byang sdom gyi mtshan nyid 'jog byed dang*/ de gsum gyi dang po ni/ theg chen so thar zhes pa'i mtshan nyid 'jog byed du 'gyur bar sems so//sdom pa gsum pa sngags sdom ni/ de'i steng du thabs shes zab mos zin pa'i tshul khrims so/ /sdom pa de gsum gyi bslab pa'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs par shes par byed pa la theg chen theg dman thams cad kyi lta sgom spyod gsum gzhi lam 'bras gsum rnams shes dgos pa yin pas/ 'dir yang gsung rab mtha' dag gi brjod pa kun kyang brjod du yod pa yin la/ ji ltar yang nyams len gyi gnad ni tshang ba kho na ste/

'on kyang gtso bor ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa dag gi spyod pa'i cha zhib par 'dis bstan pa yin no//de lta na'ang deng song gi dus 'di la gsung rab zab mo'i don rgyas par mnyan pa'i skal pa yod pa ni dkon par gyur pas/ gzhung bzang po tshig don phun sum tshogs pa rnams ni phyag dang mchod pa 'bul ba'i rten tsam du zad pa lta bur snang yang*/ da dung nyams len dam dum la 'bad pa'i rnam pa byed mkhan 'ga' zhig snang bas/ de lta la phan gdags pa'i phyir nyams len gyi gnad rnams nyung ngur bsdu zhing*/ brda' chad rnams kyang yul skad du byas pa zhig yod na dgos pa cher 'gro bar 'dug go/ /de bas na dus dang 'tshams par rang gzhan gyi don du 'gyur bsams nas yi ge 'di 'ang 'god par byed pa yin no//yang*/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni/ /ngo bo rnam par rig byed dang*//rig byed min ( 'di ni bye brag smra ba'i 'dod pa ste/ mdo sde pas sems byung sems par 'dod cing*/ sems tsam pas sems pa sa bon dang bcas par 'dod do mchan/ ) pa'i gzugs can te//mtshan nyid chos lugs 'di pa yi/ /'dod khams spyod pa'i tshul khrims so//de la dbye na bsnyen gnas dang*/ /dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis dang ni//de bzhin dge tshul pha ma gnyis/ /dge slob ma gcig dge slong gnyis//de phyir ming gi sgo nas brgyad/ /rdzas su dbye na bsnyen gnas dang*//dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong bzhi'o//so so thar pa'i sgra don ni/ /gang zag so so 'khor ba las//thar pa'i phyir na de skad brjod/ /tshul khrims dang ni legs spyad dang*//las dang sdom pa zhes kyang grags/ /bsnyen gnas zhag gcig sdom pa ste//bsrung bya yan lag brgyad nyid do/ /dge bsnyen ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar//bsrung bar bya ba'i sdom pa ste/ /sna gcig spyod dang phal cher spyod//yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen sogs/ /bsrung bya'i dbye bas sna tshogs yod//dge tshul gyi ni sdom pa dag

/ma thob thob par byed pa'i thabs//phal cher bsnyen par rdzogs dang mtshungs/ /bslab bya yan lag bcu ru 'dus//de yang pham 'dra'i nyes byas dang*/ /bshags bya'i nyes byas gnyis su 'dus//dge slong sdom pa thob byed rgyu/ /mngon du gyur pa bcu dgos te//rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bzhugs pa la/ /ston pa mngon gyur zhes su brjod//smrar ba ma nyams lung gi chos/ /sgrub pa ma nyams rtogs pa'i chos//'bras chos mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /bsgrub byas de shes chos mngon gyur//de bzhin mkhan po slob dpon dang*/ /gsang ston sogs kyang rang rang gi//mtshan nyid legs par tshang ba ste/ /kun kyang kha skong chos dang ldan//mi mthun gnyis dang bral ba dang*/ /mkhan po la ni khyad par du// brtan mkhas yan lag gnyis ldan dgos/ /bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod mngon gyur ni// gang zag tshogs su ma langs pa/ /tshigs gsum rim chags nges 'byung can//nges pa lnga dang bral ba sogs/ /lus bsam rnam par dag dgos so//chos gos gsum dang gding ba dang*/ /lhung bzed chu tshags rgyu rung zhing*//byin brlabs yo byad mngon gyur ro/ /skye gnas mdzes pa'i bar chad sogs//med na yongs dag mngon gyur te/ /thog mar las gral de nyid dam//yang na dge slong so so yi/ /gnas nas gsol ba btab pa ni//gsol ba mngon du gyur pa'o//las chog tshang zhing ma nor ba/ /de la las mngon gyur par smra//zhes bya ste/ sdom pa gsum las/ dang po so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni/ sngaun sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs dus gcig tu thob par byed pa'i cho ga yod kyang*/ de phyin nas de lta bu'i sngon chog tu grags pa de mi rung bas/ da ltar gyi cho ga la bsnyen gnas dang*/ dge bsnyen dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ dge slong dang bzhi'o/ /de las sngon ma gnyis ni khyim pas bsrung bya'i sdom pa yin la/ phyi ma gnyis ni rab byung gi yin no//de yang dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gsum po snga ma snga ma ma thob par phyi ma phyi ma len mi rung bas tshigs de gsum rim gyis nod pa la tshigs gsum rim nod zer ba yin/

bud med dge slong zhu ba la ni dge bsnyen ma/ dge tshul ma/ dge slob ma/ dge slong ma ste tshigs bzhi'am dge tshul du dge slob ma yang 'dus pas tshigs gsum nyid do/ /tshigs gsum po de'ang skyes pa lo nyi shu lon pa lta bu yin na gcig gi rjes thog tu gcig len rung la bud med kyis ni 'phral du len mi rung ngo*//de las dang po bsnyen gnas ni/ tshes brgyad dang nya stong rnams kyi nang par snga bar blang zhing*/ de nas song nyin nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du bsrung ba yin/ bsrung bya ni bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad ces srog bcad/ ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ rdzun smra ba/ chang 'thung ba/ phyi dro'i kha zas bcas drug dang*/ de steng gar sogs phreng sogs gcig tu bsdams pas bdun/ mal stan gnyis bsdoms pas brgyad do/ /de las gar sogs zhes pa ni glu gar dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ phreng sogs ni phreng ba dang*/ spos nyug pa dang*/ rgyan dang*/ kha dog 'chang ba'o/ /spos nyug pa zhes pa ni spos kyis gos sogs dri zhim par byed pa'o/ /mal stan che mtho zhes pa ni rin po che sogs rgyu bzang po las byas pa ni chen po dang mthon po ni mthon po nyid do//de ltar bshad pa'i yan lag brgyad po de'i thog ma bzhi ni tshul khrims kyi yan lag dang*/ de 'og gcig bag yod kyi yan lag dang*/ mtha' ma gsum brtul zhugs kyi yan lag ces so/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad kyi steng du jo bo rje'i phyag len gyis zas dkar gsum nyid brten pa dang*/ bag yod kyi slad du chab len pa gnyis bsnan no//de'ang nya stong sogs nam byung gi nang par zas ma zos pa'i gong du+u dge slong zhig gam de ma 'dzom na dge tshul lta bu zhig las len dgos la/ yang na thog mar gzhan las len dus nya stong sogs nam byung dus len par khas blangs nas de phyin nya stong sogs nam byung dus rang nyid kho nas blang yang chog par mdzad pa dang*/

yang 'ga' zhig gis ni rang nyid kho nas blangs pa de bar ma dge ba tsam las sdom par mi brtsi ba'ang yod do/ /de dag blang ba'i cho ga ni gzhan las shes par bya la/ de'ang dge bsnyen thob pa zhig gis 'di bsrungs na dge bsnyen gyi gso sbyong du 'gyur la/ dge bsnyen ma thob pas bsrungs na ni bsnyen gnas nyid dang dge tshul thob pa yan gyis ni 'di bsrung bya ma yin no/ /bsnyen gnas kyang blang yul dge slong nyid dgos pa dang*/ rten gling gsum gyi skyes pa bud med mtshan don byed nus pa dgos pa dang*/ dus nam yang rang nyid kho nas len mi rung ba rnams bye brag smra ba'i bzhed par yang bzhed do/ /mdo sde pa ltar na khyim pa las kyang blang rung ngo*//bsrungs pa'i phan yon ni/ bskal ba bye bar sangs rgyas bye ba mchod pa bas bstan pa 'jig tu nye ba'i tshe nyin mtshan tu bslab pa gcig spyod pa bsod nams che ba sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zla ba yar gyi tshes brgyad dang*/ /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la//bsnyen nas yan lag brgyad bsrungs na/ /de ni nga dang nga 'drar 'gyur// zhes sogs so//gnyis pa dge bsnyen ni/ byang gi sgra mi snyan pa'i mi dang*/ de bzhin du dud 'gro sogs rjes bshad kyi sdom pa skye ba'i bar chad sogs med pa'i rten dgos shing*/ blang ba'i yul dge slong nyid dgos la/ dus ni ma shi'i bar du bsrung ba yin/ 'on kyang cho ga shes tsam gyi dge slong sogs gang yang rung ba las blang chog pa mdo sde pa'i bzhed par 'dod de/ blang ba'i tshig ni bsnyen gnas dang cung zad kha bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro sngon du 'gro ba'i bdag dge bsnyen du btsun pa'am slob dpon gyis bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes ma'i dge bsnyen du zhes brjod pa'i tshe thob pa yin zhing*/ sdom pa gzhan rnams kyang thob mtshams 'di dang 'dra la/

de dag gi tshe'ang thob pa rang gis shes na skye ba yin no//de nas bsrung bya rnams khas len pa'i tshul gyis rjes zlos lan gcig brjod de/ de'ang srog gcod lta bu sna gcig nyid srung gzhan mi srung na sna gcig spyod pa'i dge bsnyen du zhes brjod pa dang*/ de'i bslab pa khas blangs pa la sna gcig spyod pa'i dge bsnyen zhes su grags pa dang*/ de steng ma byin len pa lta bu bcas spangs pa la sna 'ga' spyod pa dang*/ de steng rdzun spangs na phal cher spyod pa'i dge bsnyen dang*/ de gsum gyi steng du 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang chang bcas spangs na yongs rdzogs dge ( thog mar dge bsnyen nyid tsam du khas blangs nas phyis sna gcig spyod sogs rang gis gang srung*/ des khyad par phye chog pa bye brag smra ba'i 'dod par grags so mchan/ ) bsnyen te/ log g.yem zhes pa ni rang gi chung ma ma yin pa dang*/ yul dus yan lag ma yin pa la spyad pa'o/ /de bas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi bsrung bya ni/ srog gcod dang*/ rku dang*/ rdzun log g.yem bzhi rtsa ba dang*/ de steng de'i yan lag tu chang bcas lnga'o//yang deng song skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa mang du dar ba 'di lta ni skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du bzhed la/ de steng du bsnyen gnas tsam bsrungs na legs pa'ang yin no/ /yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi steng du mi tshangs spyod kyang spong ba ni tshangs spyod (

mdo sde pa bzhed zer mchan/ ) dge bsnyen dang*/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad ma shi'i bar srung ba ni go mi'i ( gnas brtan sde pa'i lugs yin zer ro mchan/ ) dge bsnyen zhes slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi sogs kyang 'di yin par bzhed de/ de ltar tshangs spyod dang go mi gnyis ni khyim pa'i sdom pa ma yin par rab byung gi phyogs dang 'brel ba'o//yang skyabs gsum 'dzin pa lta bu ni dge bsnyen nyid tsam yin pas de blang yul dge bsnyen gyi sdom ldan las kyang rung ba dang*/ rab byung gi rten du ni yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dge slong las blangs pa dgos zhes kar ṭīka las gsungs so//nyams na bcos pa'i tshul ni/ mi gsod pa sogs rtsa ltung bzhi po gang byung yang sdom pa gtan nas nyams pas slar yang blang dgos la/ chang 'thung ba sogs yan lag gi ltung ba byung na sdom ldan gcig gi mdun du bshags so//lar ni dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro sngon du ma song ba la sdom pa med pas bsnyen gnas nas bzung thams cad kyi thog mar skyabs 'gro'i rjes zlos yod pa yin la/ gong bshad skyabs sdom rkyang pa bzung ba'i skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi bsrung bya ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song na 'jig rten pa'i lha gzhan la phyag mi byed/ chos la skyabs su song na sems can la gnod 'tshe spong*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song na grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs pa ste/ dgag pa'i bslab bya gsum dang*/ sku rten sāts+tsha dum bu tsam dang*/ gsung rten yig 'bru tsam dang*/ dge 'dun thang sham dang ldan tsam yan la mchog gsum gyi ngo bor blta ba ste/ bsgrub pa'i bslab bya gsum dang*/ gzhan yang dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro 'don pa la brtson pa dang*/ skyes bu dam pa'i rjes su 'jug pa rnams la/ slob pa ste tshul 'di ni sdom pa thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba'o//skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/

spyir sngon bshad bzhin skyabs 'gro sngon du ma song bar sdom pa gzhan med pas sdom pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin la/ bye brag tu 'jigs pa dang*/ sdug bsngal las grol ba'i tshul yang du ma bshad cing*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi rgyu'i gtso bo gcig go/ /dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'i phan yon ni/ de'i steng du dge slong gi sdom pa'i phan yon phal cher dang bcas thob bo//gsum pa dge tshul gyi sdom pa ni/ spyir rjes nas bshad pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa bzhin mngon gyur bcu phal cher tshang dgos kyang*/ tshang dgos mi dgos dmigs bsal gyi bye brag yod pa rnams bsnyen rdzogs kyi skabs su phye bas der shes par bya la/ las chog gi go rim ni/ dang por mkhan pos bar chad yod med dri/ de nas dge bsnyen du bsgrubs nas mkhan pos gzhan gcig la rab tu byung chog par zhu bcug ste des zhu/ de nas mkhan po la mkhan po mdzad dgos par bsgrub byas gsol ( 'di'i gsol ba 'debs zin nas mkhan por gyur tshar ba yin no mchan/ ) ba 'debs/ de nas rab byung gi rtags skra dang kha spu bregs pa dang*/ chos gos dang*/ bla gos dang thang gos gnyis/ gding ba/ lhung bzed/ chu tshags rnams sbyin zhing ming gsar pa btags la/ bar ( sdom pa dang sdom min gang yang min pa'i bar ma ste/ 'di'i tshe thob pa'i bslang bya ni/ khyim pa'i rtags spong ba/ rab byung gi rtags len pa/ bla ma la gus pa rnams dang*/ rab tu byung ba tsam gyi phan yon yang khyim pa las khyad par du 'phags tshul du ma bshad pa dang*/ khyad par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rab byung gi rten kho na las thob bo mchan/ ) ma rab byung du bsgrub/ de nas slob dpon la gtad cing slob dpon gyis dge tshul du bsgrubs nas dus bsgo bas dus bsgo/ slar slob dpon gyis bslab pa brjod pa bcas kyis zin pa yin la/bslab pa ni spang bya yan lag bcu ste/ srog gcod dang*/ ma byin len dang*/

mi tshangs spyod dang*/ rdzun dang*/ chang dang*/ gar sogs dang*/ phreng sogs dang*/ mal stan che mtho dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas dang*/ gser dngul len pa bcas bcu ste/ de'i thog ma bzhi po ni pham 'dra'i nyes byas dang*/ rjes ma drug ni bshags bya'i nyes byas te rtsa ba dang yan lag go/ de'ang pham 'dra'i nyes byas 'chab bcas byung na dge tshul gyi sdom pa gtan nas nyams pa dang*/ 'chab med byung na gso rgyu yod tsam yin la/ 'chab ces pa ni nyes pa byung ba de gzhan la gsang ba'i ming yin no/ /bshags bya'i nyes byas byung na ni bshags pa tsam gyis dag par 'gyur ro/ /pham 'dra'i nyes byas 'di 'byung ba'i rgyu zhib par ni rjes bshad kyi pham pa bzhi dang 'dra la/ gar sogs zhes sogs kyi sogs khong ni bsnyen gnas su bshad pa nyid de 'di dang gong gi go mi'i dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas dang bcas pa la glu gar rol mo ni lha mchod pa la rung ba dang*/ phreng ba ni lus mdzes byed du 'chang mi rung ba dang*/ spos nyug pa ni dri bzang lus la 'phur mi rung ba dang*/ rgyan 'chang ba ni mgo rgyan sogs dang*/ kha dog 'chang ba ni gdong bkru nas rtsis byug pa sogs dang*/ khri stan chen po ni rin chen dang dar zab stag sogs kyi khri stan dang*/ mthon po ni khru gang bas mtho ba rnams so//yan lag bcu po 'di zhib tu srung na dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu po phal cher tshang ba yin te/ dge slong gi khrims kyi nang nas sa brko ba dang*/ rin po che dang*/ me la reg pa/ shing gcod pa/ byin len ma byas par za ba/ sa bon 'joms pa sogs bcu drug ni 'di'i skabs su nyes pa med par nges pa dang*/ 'dir bshad pa'i bcu po ni nyes pa che ba dang de ma gtogs pa'i 'dul khrims gzhan thams cad 'dir phyogs mthun te yid kyis bsdam par bya ba'i nyes pa'o/ /nyams su blang bya 'jug pa'i tshul khrims rnams kyang phal cher dge slong gi skabs bzhin dgos kyang de dag phal cher dge slong gi de dag bshad pa'i zhar du byung ba tsam las ma bkod do//bzhi pa dge slong gi sdom pa la/

ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang*/ thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'o/ /dang po thob byed kyi cho ga ni/ mngon gyur bcu po nyid yin te/ mngon gyur bcu po tshang na bsnyen par rdzogs pa legs par thob pa yin pas mngon du gyur pa bcu ni/ sangs rgyas mngon gyur/ chos mngon gyur/ dge 'dun mngon gyur/ mkhan po mngon gyur/ slob dpon mngon gyur te blang ba'i yul mthun pa'i rkyen lnga dang*/ len pa po'i gang zag la bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod mngon gyur/ yo byad mngon gyur/ yongs dag mngon gyur te gsum dang*/ cho ga la gsol ba mngon gyur/ las mngon gyur te mthun rkyen de bcu tshang dgos pa yin/ de las dang po sangs rgyas mngon gyur ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku byin rlabs can bshams pas go chod la/ phyag len la nyer spyod kyi mchod pa dang bcas te shom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa chos mngon gyur ni/ spyir lung rtogs kyi chos zhes pa lung gi chos glegs bam dang dge 'dun pa'i zhal 'don dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos la rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i thugs rgyud kyi ye shes yin yang 'dul ba'i skabs 'di la ni las chog ma nor bar blo thog nas thon pa dang*/ las byed bzhin pa ni lung gi chos dang dge slong gi bslab pa la gces spras byas pa rtogs pa'i chos yin par 'dod do// gsum pa dge 'dun mngon gyur ni/ yul dbus su dge slong bcu tshang dgos kyang bod yul 'di mtha' 'khob yin pas mtha' 'khob la mkhan slob gnyis ka bgrangs pa'i dge slong lnga tshang na chog pa dang*/ de las mang du ni sngar bla ma rnams las gral brgyad cu skor tshogs pa'i lo rgyus yod pa bzhin dang*/ yang bzhi tshang na chog pa'i lung zhig yod kyang de ni las slob ma gtogs pa'i bzhi yin gyi lnga nges par dgos zhes bu ston gyis gsungs pa bzhin bzhed/ dge slong bzhi yan chad tshogs pa la ni dge 'dun nam tshogs zhes zer ba yin te/

deng sang dge 'dun bzhi sde zhes khyim pa rnams la'ang grags pa ltar dang*/ dge slong gsum dang gnyis dang gcig lta bu la ni dge slong ngam gang zag ces zer ba yin no//dge 'dun de la'ang mtshan nyid kha skong gi chos dang ldan pa mi mthun pa gnyis dang bral ba dgos shing*/ dgos pa de'ang bsnyen rdzogs sogs las thams cad la 'dra ste/ kha skong gi chos ni mi 'dug par 'greng ba ma yin/ gang la bya ba ma yin/ 'dun pa dang yongs dag phul ( rjes bshad kyi 'dun pa dang yongs dag phul ba las gral du mi rung ste lus dngos su mi 'dus pas so// ) ba ma yin/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa ma yin/ nyams ( pham pa 'chab bcas kyi ltung ba can/ ) pa ma yin/ mtshams med byas pa ma yin/ sdig ( mu stegs kyi lta ba can no// ) lta can ma yin/ sa gzhan na gnas pa ma yin/ ( rjes bshad kyi sa gzhan na gnas pa nyer gnyis so mchan/ ) 'khrul bcas ma yin/ ( byin rlabs pa sogs kyi nyes byas tsam yang dag par byed dgos so mchan/ ) mtshams gzhan na gnas pa ma yin/ ( rjes bshad kyi mtshams gcig pa dgos so mchan/ ) dkon mchog gzhan ma yin/ ( sangs rgyas gcig pa dgos so mchan/ ) rang bzhin du mi gnas pa ma yin/ ( ltung ba phyir mi bcos pa'o mchan/ ) mtshan mi mthun pa ma yin pa ste bcu gsum ( skyes pa bsnyen rdzogs la dge slong mas mi rung ngo mchan/ ) mo//de'i thog ma mi 'dug par 'greng ba ma yin zhes pa'i don ni thams cad gral bsgrigs nas bzhugs dgos pa yin/ gang la bya ba zhes pa ni dper na dge slong zhig las gzhan zhig la sko na bsko bya de sko bar byed pa po'i las gral du rtsi mi rung ba bzhin te/ de sogs 'ga' re go dka' ba yod kyang 'di tshang ma bklags zin nas phal cher shes 'ong ba yin no//mi mthun pa gnyis med pa zhes pa ni ma 'dus pa'i mi mthun pa dang*/ 'dus pa phyir zlog gi mi mthun pa ste/ dang po ni/ mtshams gcig tu ( rjes bshad kyi mtshams chen sogs mchan/
