tad+ya thā/ su mṛ sha su mṛ sha su mṛ sha kā ru ṇi ka /tsa ra tsa ra bi tsa ra sa tsa ra/ kā ru ṇi ka /mu ra mu ra/ be ga dha ri ma tsa me/ bhu dza sā da kā ru ṇi ka /tsin+dha ma ṇi pū ra ya kā ru ṇi ka /sarba sha me s+thā pā ya adzñā dha ri/ s+phu gung s+phu gung*/ ru ti bi be ka gung dṛṣ+ti bi be ka gung pū ra ya kā ru ṇi ka pū ra yan+tu ma ma a sha/ sarba pany+tha tsa a sho ka ga ri swā hwa/ zhes 'di nyal khar bzlas na lung bstan par gsungs shing*/ bshags pa'i tshe'ang 'di 'don na legs pa 'dra zhes dpa' bos gsungs so//yang bshags yul ma rnyed na sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yid kyis dmigs te/ phung po gsum pa sogs pas bshags shing sdom par dam bcas nas slar blangs pas kyang thams cad sor chud par byed de/ theg pa chen po 'di ni sems kyi las kho na gtso ba'i phyir ro//'dir smras pa/ pha rol phyin pa drug gi grur/ /zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dag/ /khyad par bsam gtan shes rab kyi/ /nyams len rgyud la sbyar ba la/ /zhi lhag zung du chud pa yis/ /don dam sems de skye thabs bya/ /don dam rgyud la ma skyes na/ /sbyin pa la sogs yan lag gzhan/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas lam las ring*/ / don dam sems mchog rin chen la/ /yun ring dus nas ma sbyangs na/ /nam zhig lhag ger mthong ngo zhes/ /bsgugs nas sdod la 'bras bu med/ /tshul gnas 'dod chung chog shes pas/ /thos don bsam zhing bsgom bya ste/ /mthun pa'i gnas su rab gnas pas/ /sems ni las su rung ba yi/ /zhi gnas ting 'dzin bsgom par bya/ rtog pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo ba'i/ /zhi gnas snum dang bral gyur na/ /lhag mthong mar me'i 'od mi 'byung*/ /lhag mthong sgron me'i 'od kyis ni/ /mi shes mun pa sel bas na// 'jig rten pa dang thun mong du/ /bsam gtan yan lag bcas pa bzhi/ /byang chub dam pa'i rgyu yin gsungs/ /'dir ni bden gnyis gnas tshul gang*/

/ji bzhin rtogs pa lhag mthong ngo*/ /thog mar bdag med rnam pa gnyis/ /gtan la dbab pa'i sgo nas brtsam/ /tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i gnad/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /theg chen lam gyi gzhung shing yin/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang ni/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi dang ni/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam bzhi bcas/ /tshogs kyi lam du ldan ( 'di ni byang chub tu sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste / drod kyi ye shes ma skyes bar gyi thos bsam sgom gsum mo// ) pa ste/ /'di la thar pa cha mthun dang*/ /las dang po yi sa yang zer/ /bsam gtan gyi ni dngos gzhi dang*/ /chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin yang skye/ /dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga ni/ /sbyor lam nges 'byed yan lag bzhir/ /ldan cing sa ni mos spyod do/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po ni/ /mthong ba'i lam dang nges ldan te/ /de dus sa ni dang po thob// sa 'di bskal pa grangs med ni/ /gcig gis yang dag 'grub par 'gyur/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /bsgom pa'i lam du ldan pa ste/ /lam 'di sa bcu'i bar du bgrod/ /bskal pa grangs med gnyis pa yis/ /sa brgyad thob par nus pa ste/ /grangs med gsum pa dag gis ni/ /sa bcu'i bar du rnam par 'gro/ /de mtha' rdo rje lta bu yi/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rjes su ni/ /zad dang mi skye shes pa yi/ /mtha' ru phyin pa'i lam rnyed do/ /rgyu dang lam gyi chos rnams ni/ /lcags kyi khams dang 'dra ba la/ /rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gser 'gyur rtsis/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi gser du byed/ /de la sku dang ye shes dang*/ /phrin las mkha' ltar tha gru yas/ /kun mkhyen nyid kyi spyod yul nyid/ /ces so//de ltar 'di ni gtso bor dpa' bo rin po che'i spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa'i spyi don dang*/ thar rgyan gnyis las btus shing*/ nye bar rtogs bya'i cha lags mod/ rgya bod kyi rnam bzhag du ma la brten nas goms par ma byas pa'i gyi na mkhan po kho na yang min no/

/sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang zhes bya ba las/ sdom pa gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i skabs te le'u gnyis pa'o// //sdom pa gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa/ de nas sdom pa gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa bshad par bya ba ni/ spyir sngags kyi theg pa la rgyud sde chen po bzhi yod pa las de rnams kyi dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ rje karma pa rang byung zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dam tshig rgya mtsho'i snying po nyid shes na legs par tshang ba dang*/ khyad par rang re bod yul ba rnams ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kho na la bsnyegs par byed pas na/ bla med nas bshad pa'i dam tshig bsrung thabs kyi rnam bzhag la dam tshig rgya mtsho 'di lta bu'i gzhung gzhan du med pa nyid yin pas/ 'dir yang dam tshig rgya mtsho gzhung 'grel gyi don bsdus nyid bkod par byed la/ de dag gi sngon du rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag phyogs tsam zhig kyang shes dgos par snang bas 'dir ni/ rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag bsdus te bstan pas/ spyi'i khog dbub pa dang*/ dam tshig bsrung thabs rgyas par bstan pas nyams su len par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di skad du/ de nas rdo rje theg pa yi/ /dam tshig rnam par bzhag 'dod nas//spyi don cung zad 'dir bstan bya/ /gdul bya gang zag khyad par dang*//bgrod bya lam rim khyad par dang*/ /thob bya 'bras bu'i khyad rnams kyis//mdo las khyad par mang 'phags pa/ /gsang sngags theg pa'i khyad chos te//dbye na bya rgyud spyod rgyud dang*/ /rnal 'byor dang ni bla med do//zhes bya ste/ de yang gsang sngags zhes sam/ rdo rje'i theg pa'am/ 'bras bu'i theg pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod dam/ rgyud sde'am/ sngags kyi theg pa/ gsang ba'i theg pa rnams su grags pa 'di rnams don gcig yin la/ de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam las kyang khyad par du mas 'phags pa zhig ste/

gang zag dbang po rno zhing rgyud smin pa la ltung bas ma gos pa ste mtshan nyid gsum ldan dang*/ lam thabs mang ba/ thabs la ma rmongs pa/ dka' ba med pa gsum dang*/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos/ sngags kyis thob dgos pa sogs kyis khyad par byed par karma shing rta las bshad la/ 'di la rgya gar gyi slob dpon rnams kyis ni khyad par du 'phags chos bcu gcig dang*/ bdun dang*/ bzhi sogs so sor bzhed cing*/ rje tsong kha pas ni gzugs sku'i sa bon theb pa'i phyir du gzugs sku dang rnam pa 'dra ba'i lha bsgom pa yod med kyis mdo sngags 'byed par bzhed (

sngags rim las mchan/ ) la/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas cho ga'i bya ba yod med yin zhes ( sdom gsum rab dbye las mchan/ ) bzhed mod/ de 'dra re res ni dbye mi thub bo/ /tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*//dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags//zhes gsungs shing*/ de la'ang 'grel lugs mang ngo*/ /de lta bus khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyud sde de la dbye ba sna tshogs yod kyang yongs su grags pa la/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud de rgyud sde bzhi yin no//de ltar bzhir dbye ba'i sgo ni mi rigs bzhi ( sam+bu ṭi las/ ) dang*/ 'dod chags rigs bzhi dang*/ dbang po rno rtul bzhi ( rdo gur las so// ) dang*/ gnas skabs bzhi ( dus 'khor las so// ) sogs kyi gnyen po dang*/ de dag gi sgo nas bshad do/ /bram ze sogs mi rigs bzhi rjes su bzung ba'i don du rgyud bzhir bzhag par bshad pa la bu ston gyis brtag go zhes gsungs shing*/ rje tsong kha pas shin tu bkag kyang rgyud du gsal bar snang ngo*//de lta bu'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi so sor bshad pa la/ dang po bya ba'i rgyud ni/ phyi yi bya ba gtsor ston pas/ /bya ba'i rgyud ces grags de la//dbye na drug gam gsum mam gnyis/ /mngon rtogs lam gyi rim pa ni//'jug spyod dbang dang dam tshig dang*/ /sbyor spyod mtshan bcas mtshan med dang*//sgrub spyod dngos grub sgrub pa dang*/ /grub spyod 'bras bu'i dam tshig go/zhes bya ste/ bya ba'i rgyud ces pa'i nges tshig ni/ khrus dang*/ gtsang sbra/ bsnyung gnas dang*/ gos/ dus gsum du brje ba la sogs phyi'i bya ba gtso bor ston pas de skad bya ste/ sngags kyi sgor ni 'jug 'os la mnyam bzhag kho nar ni gnas mi nus par bya ba mang po la mos pa dag 'jug pa'i lam mo/

/dbye na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs ( dam tshig gsum bkod dang 'jam dpal sogs mchan/ ) dang*/ pad+ma ( tshe dpag dang spyan ras gzigs sogs mchan/ ) dang*/ rdo rje ( mi 'khrugs pa sogs mchan/ )dang*/ nor can dang*/ lngas rtsen dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs te rigs drug dang*/ de'i thog ma gsum la rigs kyi gtso bo bdag po yum khro bo khro mo yum pho nya pho nya mo sogs kyi dbye ba bcas yod pa dang*/ rigs drug po de bsdu na dang po gsum du 'dus la/ de'ang thabs shes gnyis sam/ gnyis med du 'du'o//de la 'jug tshul lam mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ni/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i spyod pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa dang*/ 'grub pa'i spyod pa ste bzhi'o/ /dang po 'jug spyod ni/ dbang dang*/ dam tshig ste/ de la dbang ni/ 'dir chu dang cod pan gyi dbang gnyis las ma bstan la/ de'i cod pan gyi dbang yang phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag pa nyid yin no/ /'on kyang slob dpon la las chu dbang tsam dang*/ la las rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin sogs ci rigs mdzad do zhes bu ston gyis gsungs kyang*/ de bya rgyud rang rkang min par 'chad do/ /spyir bya rgyud la yongs grags su chu dang*/ cod pan gyi dbang gnyis gtso bo'i dbang du bzhag cing*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yin la/ de'i 'khor ram rdo rje slob ma'i dbang ni bzlas lung dang*/ byab khrus srung gsum dang*/ rdzas brgyad kyi dbang rnams yod la/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ bzlas lung tsam rjes su dran par byed pa'i rigs gtad kyang yod do//'o na dbang dngos la chu cod pan gnyis las med par bshad don ci zhe na/ de gnyis rdo rje slob dpon du 'gyur byed kyi dbang yin pas te/ spyir dbang zhes pa rigs gang gi sgo nas dbang thob na de'i bya ba mtha' dag la dbang byed pa ste/ 'di la rdo rje'i rigs kyi dbang thob pas rigs de'i rgyud bshad pa'i slob dpon du 'gyur la/

pad+ma'i rigs kyis rigs de gnyis ka dang*/ de bzhin gshegs rigs kyis rigs de gsum char gyi slob dpon du 'gyur ro//gnyis pa dam tshig ni/ spyir gsang sngags la zhugs pa thams cad kyis dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub chen por sems skyed pa/ dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba rnams ni dgos pa gzhir bcas la/ 'dir bya ba'i rgyud la dam tshig gi rim pa grangs su chad pa dang*/ ma chad pa ci rigs gsungs pa las mkhas pa rnams kyis rnam gzhag sna tshogs smrar na'ang bu ston gyis spyi rnam du/ jo bo'i dam tshig bsdus par bya rgyud la rtsa ltung sum cu gsungs pas de legs grub las gsungs pa'i mkhas pas zhe sdang mi bya'o/ /zhes sogs 'di yin nam dpyad ces 'byung ba dang*/ dus 'khor las/ rgyud bzhi ka la rtsa ltung bcu bzhi re gsungs pa de ngos 'dzin tshe gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi 'di la byed pa dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rtsa ltung lnga bshad pa rnams grags che bas de rnams shes par bya zhing*/ yan lag gi ltung ba yang ci rigs te byams pa gling pa'i sngags 'dul nang du lta bde bar bkod snang ngo*//de dag las spyi rgyud kyi bcu bzhi ni/ dkon mchog la dad pa/ 1 sngags la dad pa/ 2 theg chen la mos pa/ 3 zhing mchog ( bla ma sogs mchan/ ) la gus pa/ 4 lha rnams la mi sdang ba/ 5 dus mtshams su mchod pa/ 6 gzhan gzhung mi mchod pa/ 7 blo bur ba ( mgron/ ) mchod pa/ 8 byams pa mi btang ba/ 9 bsod nams la 'bad pa dang*/ 10 gsang sngags la brtson pa/ 11 dam tshig gzhan bsrung ba/ 12 dam med la sngags rgya mi sbyin pa/ 13 rgyud gsang zhing rtogs par bya ba'o// 14 'brug pa pad dkar gyi dam tshig rnam par bzhag pa'i rtsa ba'ang der snang ngo*//dam tshig de las gal te nyams na rang rigs kyi snying po 'bum bzla ba dang*/ yang na mes rmongs par byed pa'i snying po stong bzlas pa ste/ gzungs de yang rdo rje mi pham (

lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba las gsungs so mchan/ ) pa me ltar rab tu rmongs par byed pa'i gzungs yin par bshad do/ /yang na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gam/ dbang gsar du len pa'am/ bdag 'jug len pa rnams bya'o//gnyis pa sbyor ba'i spyod pa la/ kun rdzob kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams bcas la sbyor ba dang*/ don dam gyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis su med pa la sbyor ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khrus dang*/ gtsang sbra bya ba dang*/ gnas dang bdag bsrung ba/ mdun gyi bris sku la lha spyan drangs la mchod pa sogs grub nas dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi de kho na nyid/ lha'i de kho na nyid/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid gsum nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de'i dang po ni/ don dam byang chub kyi sems spros pa dang bral ba bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha sgom pa ste/ 'di la bla ma ( sa skya pa sogs/ ) 'ga' zhig bdag bskyed med par bzhed pas mdun du ye shes pa nyid spyan drangs pa la dmigs nas mchod bstod dang*/ sngags zla ba sogs byed la/ bla ma ( tsong ga pa sogs mchan/ ) 'ga' zhig bdag bskyed yod par bzhed nas bdag mdun gnyis la dam ye gnyis ka yod med ci rigs so sor bzhed/ rang lugs bya rgyud tsam po ba la bdag bskyed med pa dang*/ khyad par ba la bdag bskyed yod par bzhed pa 'di don la'ang gnas shing*/ spyir bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud ltar gyi nyams len zhes lha ngo bo gcig la nyams su len lugs de ltar mdzad do//lha bskyed tshul dngos ni/ stong pa'i lha zhes sngon bshad pa bdag gi de kho na nyid de nyid dang*/ de nas yi ge'i lha zhes nam mkhar zla ba'i steng du lha gang yin de'i sngags phreng bsam pa dang*/ de nas sgra'i lha zhes de las sngags sgra grags par bsam pa dang*/ de nas gzugs kyi lha ni de las 'od zer spro bsdu byas te lha gang yin pa'i gzugs su bsam pa dang*/ phyag rgya'i lha ni de las phyag rgyas byin rlob pa dang*/

de ltar ma yengs par bsgom pa ni mtshan ma'i lha zhes te/ de ltar lha drug gi sgo nas bsgom pa ni rgyud gzhan nas mngon byang lngas lha bskyed pa'i dod do//gsum pa sngags kyi de kho na nyid ni/ sngags bzla ste/ de'ang yan lag bzhi ldan khyad par gyi bzlas pa ni/ gzhi bdag mdun gyi thugs kar sems zla dkyil du sgra sngags phreng ste/ de'ang me long nang du shar ba bzhin bsams nas bsnyen tshad stan thog gcig la 'gro dgos la/ sngags bzla tshe sbrid pa/ 'og rlung*/ gad mo/ glal ba sogs shor na 'phral du nye reg byed cing phreng ba'i 'go nas grangs bzung dgos pa sogs dang*/ yid zlas sam shub bu zhes rang gi thos tsam du bzla ba sogs dgos la/ bsnyen tshad ni yig 'bru bco lnga man la 'bru 'bum dang*/ so gnyis man la sum 'bum dang*/ de bas mang la khri bzlas pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i tshe ni grub pa'i nges pa rnyed kyi bar du bzla dgos la/ las phran la sngon du bsnyen pa 'gro mi dgos par yang bshad do//gnyis pa don dam ting nge 'dzin la/ me gnas/ sgra gnas/ sgra mtha' bsam gtan te gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ bdag gi de kho na nyid sngon du 'gro bas/ snying gar mar me'i me lce lta bu dang sngags kyi sgra la sems bzung ba'o/ /sgra gnas ni/ sgra 'ba' zhig la sems bzung ba'o/ /sgra mtha'i ni/ don dam stong pa nyid do/ /mtshan bcas sngon du song bas mtshan med kyi ting 'dzin bya zhing de'ang me gnas sgra gnas gnyis ni zhi gnas dang sgra mtha' ni lhag mthong ngo*//gsum pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa ni/ bsnyen pa sngon du song nas ral gri dang*/ mig sman sogs rdzas dang*/ lus dang*/ longs spyod rnams 'dod lha dang skal mnyam gyi rig 'dzin mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub pa ste/ 'di la rig 'dzin sogs dngos grub rab dang*/ bcud len sogs 'bring dang*/ tha ma dbang du 'du ba sogs zhes 'byung*/ bzhi pa grub pa'i spyod pa ni/

dngos grub grub nas rang gzhan gyi don byed nas byang chub chen por gyur pa'i bar te 'bras bu'i spyod pa'o//gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud ni/ phyi dang nang gi bya ba gnyis/ /mnyam por spyod pa spyod rgyud de//dbye na rigs ni rnam pa gsum/ /mngon rtogs lam gyi rim pa ni//phyi yi 'jug spyod dbang dam tshig /nang 'jug mtshan bcas mtshan med do//sbyor spyod mtshan bcas bzlas brjod de/ /mtshan med ting 'dzin goms pa'i thabs/ /sgrub spyod phyi nang dngos grub bo//zhes bya ste/ spyod pa'i rgyud ces pa phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang*/ nang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis ka mnyam par spyod pas de skad bya la/ bya ba mang po yang mi mos par de kho na nyid la mos pa dag 'jug pa'i lam mo/ /dbye na/ de bzhin gshegs rigs ( rnam snang mngon byang dang mi g.yo ba'i rtogs pa sogs/ ) dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs ( phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud sogs mchan/ ) so//'jug tshul mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa ni/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa/ sbyor ba'i spyod pa/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa'o/ /dang po la/ phyi 'jug gi spyod pa dang*/ nang 'jug gi spyod pa gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ dbang dang*/ dam tshig ste dbang ni snga ma de'i steng du rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang dang bcas pa'o/ /dam tshig ni/ dus gsum du nod pa yin te sta gon gyi skabs lus phul nas kun rdzob sems bskyed bzung ba ste bya rgyud dang 'dra ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skabs su don dam sems bskyed 'bog pa'i sgo nas dang*/ dbang bskur rdzogs pa'i skabs nas ( khas blang pa rnams/ ) so//bsrung bya dngos ni/ mi dge bcu dang*/ dam pa'i chos spang ba/ byang chub kyi sems spang ba/ ser sna byed pa/ sems can la gnod pa byed pa ste rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'o/ /bya spyod kyi rtsa ltung byang sdom gyi ltung ba dang mtshungs pa ltar gyur na'ang smin grol gyis zin pa'i sdom pa yin pas de dag dang mi mtshungs shing lhag par 'gyur ro//

gnyis pa nang 'jug la/ mtshan bcas lha sgom pa dang*/ mtshan med don dam stong pa nyid sgom pa'o/ /lha sgom tshul yang bdag mdun lhar bskyed nas mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i zla ba sngags phreng dang bcas pa la sems bzung ste/ de'ang bdag dang*/ gnas dang*/ rnal 'byor bsrung ba sngon du 'gro bas yi ge dang po zla dkyil bsam pa/ yi ge gnyis pa de steng du sngags bsam pa gzhi dang po bdag lhar bsam pa/ gzhi gnyis pa mdun du lha bsams pa ste yi ge dang*/ yi ge gzhi dang*/ gzhi'i rim pas bsgom mo//gnyis pa sbyor ba'i spyod pa mtshan bcas ni/ snga ma de nyid la dmigs nas bzlas brjod 'bum phrag tu byed pa phyi'i bzlas brjod dang*/ nang gi bzlas brjod ni rang thub par gsal ba'i thugs kar rnam snang de'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags bkod nas bzla ba dang*/ mtshan med ni de lta bu'i lha yang rang bzhin med par brtag ste mnyam par bzhag nas yid bzlas byed pa'o//gsum pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa ni/ phyi'i dngos grub ral gri sogs sgrub pa dang*/ nang gi dngos grub mngon shes lnga sogs so/ /de ltar rnam snang mngon byang ltar gyi khog phub bu ston gyis gsungs pa ltar ro//gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud ni/ nang gi rnal 'byor gtsor ston pas/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du rab grags pa//dbye na brjod bya rigs lnga ste/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i lam dag ni//'jug tu rung ba'i gang zag dang*/ /thabs la legs par 'jug pa'i sgo//'bras bu thob par byed pa'i thabs/ /'bras bu rnam par bzhag pas bsdus//'jug sgo dbang dang dam tshig dang*/ /thob thabs bzlas brjod bsgom pa ste//ting nge 'dzin ni rnam gsum dang*/ /rnal 'byor bzhi sogs brten nas so//zhes bya ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud ces pa ni nang thabs shes kyi rnal 'byor bsgom par gtso bor gyur pas rnal 'byor rgyud de/ dbye na/ brjod bya rigs du ma'am bsdu na de bzhin gshegs pa/

rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ las te rigs lnga dang*/ bzhi dang*/ gnyis dang*/ de'ang gcig tu bsdu ba'i bar yod la/ brjod byed la rtsa rgyud/ ( de nyid bsdus pa sogs/ ) bshad rgyud/ ( rdo rje rtse mo sogs/ ) phyi ma rgyud/ ( gtsug dgu sogs/ ) cha mthun gyi ( ngan song sbyong rgyal sogs/ ) rgyud rnams yod cing*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i lam ni/ 'jug rung gi gang zag /thabs la 'jug pa'i sgo/ 'bras bu thob par byed pa'i thabs/ 'bras bu nyid rnam par bzhag pa dang bzhi'i/ dang po bya ba mang po g.yeng ba'i rgyur shes nas gtso bor bsgom pa nyid la mos pa dang*/ dad pa che ba/ dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung nus pa/ chos la yid ches pa/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang ldan pa ni 'jug rung gi gang zag go/gnyis pa thabs la 'jug pa'i sgo ni/ dbang dang dam tshig ste/ dbang ni snga ma de lnga rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ de'i steng du phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba'i dbang*/ rjes gnang*/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung*/ gzengs bstod de slob dpon gyi dbang drug dang bcas pa'i dbang bcu gcig yin la/ de'ang me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs de'i phyag mtshan ming bum pas dbang bskur ba yin no/ /slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs su slob ma rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa ni rigs kun gyi khyab bdag yin pas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi slob dpon du 'gyur la/ me tog phog pa'i lha tsam bskyed na ni de nyid kyi rgyud ston pa por 'gyur ro/ /'di'i gsang ba'i dbang zhes pa bla med kyi gsang dbang dang mtshungs pa ni ma yin no//gnyis pa dam tshig la/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ste/ bod kha cig gis rdo rje rtse mo'i/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /zhes sogs la ngos 'dzin kyang*/ dngos ni sgrub phyogs nas bcu bzhi/ dgag phyogs nas bcu bzhi yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba dag yin pas rigs lnga'i dam tshig dngos ni rjes nas bshad la/

bcu bzhi'i rkang grangs ni/ sangs rgyas rigs kyi dam tshig dkon mchog gsum dor ba dang*/ de nas rim par/ rdor dril phyag rgya slob dpon bzhi/ sbyin pa rnam bzhi/ phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ sdom pa dang mchod pa'i las gnyis te bcu bzhi po dor ba'o//dgag phyogs nas bcu bzhi ni/ rtse mo las/ de la dam tshig gang zhe na/ /zhes sogs ltar/ dkon mchog gsum spangs pa/

1 byang sems dor ba/ 2 lha rnams smad pa/ 3 sngags rgya smad pa/ 4 slob dpon brnyas pa/ 5 bla ma'i bzhon pa dang mtshon cha phyag mtshan sogs 'gong ba/ 6 bza' bya min pa bza' ba/ 7 gsang ba bsgrag pa/ 8 sngags rgya'i bslab pa dor ba/ 9 gnod 'tshe bya ba/ 10 theg dman bsam pa/ 11 sems can don dang 'khor ba la skyo ba/ 12 phar phyin drug gi spyod pa dor ba/ 13 bya min bya ba bcas bcu bzhi ste/ dgag phyogs kyi bcu bzhi 'di karma shing rta las so//de las gzhan rnal 'byor rgyud las ltung ba'i bye brag bshad pa rnams ni yan lag gi ltung ba'i grar brtsi ste mang bas 'dir ni 'bri ma thub bo/ /'on kyang deng sang thams cad kyi kha 'don du rlung ltar grags pa'i/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /zhes sogs kyi don tsam yang shes par bya'o/ /nyams na 'chos tshul snga ma dang mtshungs shing phyi nas kyang gsal lo//gsum pa 'bras bu thob par byed pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo ni/ ting 'dzin gsum dang rnal 'byor bzhi ste/ ting 'dzin gsum ni/ dang po'i sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog /las rgyal mchog gsum ste/ dang po ni/ tshogs bsags pa'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor skyed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab phrin las bcol ba'i bar ro/ /bla med ltar na rten bskyed pa nas gtso bo yab yum gyi bar dang po'o/ /de gnyis las sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rdzogs pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /de nas lhas zhing sbyong ba sogs kyi mdzad pa ni gsum pa'o/ /gsang 'dus 'phags lugs pa sogs ni gzhan no/ /rnal 'byor bzhi ni/ rnal 'byor/ rjes su rnal 'byor/ shin tu rnal 'byor/ thams cad rnal 'byor/ dang po ni/ bdag lhar bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ye shes pa dang dbyer med pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag dang brtan g.yo dbyer med par bsgom pa'o/ /de thams cad kyis sems rtse gcig tu gyur pa ni thams cad rnal 'byor ro/

/ting nge 'dzin gsum sgom mi nus pas ni rnal 'byor bzhi bsgom par bshad do//de nas de dag gi yan lag bsnyen pa la/ tshig dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa gnyis te/ dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sgra med/ rdo rje'i rigs la 'brug sgra lta bu/ pad+ma dang rin chen la phra zhing gsal ba'o/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa la/ dmigs bcas dang*/ dmigs med gnyis bshad do/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi yan lag tu bzlas brjod bzhag pa 'di lta na yang deng sang nyams su len pa'i srol la brtag na bzlas brjod nyid dngos gzhi lta bur snang mod kyang dbang po dman pa'i lugs la de nyid yin shas kha'o/ /de dag ni phyogs mtshon tsam ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mngon rtogs kyi chings gzhan du na bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ rags pa lha dang*/ phra ba phyag mtshan la dmigs pa gnyis kyi/ lha la dmigs pa la/ dbang rnon gyi ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum dang*/ dbang brtul rnal 'byor rnam bzhi la sgom pa dang*/ de nas de gnyis gang yin kyang phra ba phyag mtshan la dmigs pa ni/ rang lha'i mdog dang mthun pa'i rdo rje til 'bru tsam zhig lte ba nas sna rtser spros te de la sems bzung ba dang*/ gnyis pa bsgrub pa la/ bsam gtan la dang*/ bzlas brjod la brten pa gnyis/ dang po la/ phyag rgya dang mngon shes sgrub pa dag grub nas lha grangs dang mthun pa'i sgrub pa po rnams kyis lha so so'i kha dog dang cha lugs dbyibs lta bur byas la/ rang gi lha dbang du gyur pa'i tshul gyis 'grub par 'gyur ba ste/ lan gcig gis ma 'grub na bdun gyi bar bskyar ba dang*/ ma 'grub na lha bsad pa'i sbyor ba zhes spog chog bya ba rnams dbang rnon gyi lugs dang*/ gnyis pa bzlas brjod la brten pa la/ dbang rnon rdor bzlas la brten pa dang*/ dbang brtul tshig zlas la brten pa gnyis kyi/ rdor zlas rlung la brten pa dang tshig zlas sngar bshad bzhin no/

/de grub nas dngos grub sgrub tshul la'ang*/ bsam gtan gyi dngos grub mchog thun sgrub tshul rnams dang*/ bzlas brjod kyi dngos grub lha'i spyan sngar mtshan thog thag tu bzla ba sogs dang*/ sbyin sreg gi dngos grub sgrub tshul rnams so//yang de nyid bcu'i sgo nas brjod na/ de nyid bcu ni/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ sngags dang*/ phyag rgya ( rgyas 'debs so// ) dang*/ bdag dang gnas sogs bsrung ( bsrung 'khor sogs/ ) ba dang*/ spyan drangs pa'i cho ga dang*/ bzlas brjod dang*/ bsgom pa ( ting 'dzin gsum dang rnal 'byor bzhi/ )dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ nyer bsdu ( phyag rgya dgrol ba/ ) dang*/ mchod nas gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /bzhi pa 'bras bu ni/ don gnyis mthar thug pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can du 'grub bo//bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtser gyur pas/ /rnal 'byor bla med grags de la//dbye na rjod byed thabs dang ni/ /shes rab dang ni gnyis med kyis//brjod par bya ba rigs drug ston/ /mngon rtogs rgyu thabs 'bras gsum ste//rgyu ni shes rab brtson ldan la/ /thabs ni smin byed dbang bzhi dang*//de yis thob pa'i sdom pa dang*/ /de mthar phyin pa'i spyod pa dang*//lam dngos nyams su len dang bzhi/ /sdom pa bsrung dang bza' ba dang*//spyod dang mi 'bral dam tshig bzhi/ /spyod pa thun mong thun min gnyis//lam dngos nyams su len pa la/ /dngos ni bskyed dang rdzogs rim ste//de grogs gtor ma sbyin sreg sogs/ /nye grogs gnas dus grogs rdzas sogs//'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen no//zhes bya ste/ thabs shes dbyer med du sbyor bas rnal 'byor dang*/ de'i gong na gzhan med pas bla med rgyud de/ de la dbye na thabs kyi rgyud ( pha rgyud mchan/ ) dang*/ shes rab kyi rgyud ( ma rgyud/ ) dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud gsum gyi/ dang po ni/

gsang 'dus gshed skor sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bde dgyes sangs rgyas thod pa bden bzhi sogs so/ /gnyis med rgyud ni dus kyi 'khor lo'o/ /'on kyang 'di la rang rang gis rtsis che ba re gnyis med rgyud yin par byed pa yang snang mod dpyad bya mang ngo*/ /brjod bya rigs drug ste mi bskyod/ ( gsang 'dus phyag rdor bde dgyes thod/ ) rnam snang*/ ( sgyu dra gshed skor gdan bzhi/ ) rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub ( ral gcig ) dang lnga dang*/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang ( zla gsang thig le/ )ngo*//lam la/ smin byed kyi dbang*/ des thob pa'i sdom pa/ mthar phyin pa'i spyod pa/ lam dngos nyams su len pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ slob ma gang la'ang ma chags shing tshe gcig gis rdo rje 'chang sgrub pa la brtson pa shes rab dang ldan pa zhig gis mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon las sku bzhi mngon du byed pa'i dbang bzhi zhu ste/ de'ang bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes bzhi pa bcas bzhi'i/ dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud nas bshad pa'i dbang bcu gcig dang cha 'dra ba dang*/ gsang dbang ni/ slob dpon yab yum snyom 'jug mdzad pa las byung ba'i thig le dkar dmar ster ba dang*/ sher dbang ni/ slob dpon gyis gtad pa'i shes rab ma dang sbyor ba'i bde ba yang dag rig pa dang*/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po las skyes pa'i bde chen stong pa dang zung du 'jug pa'o//gnyis pa sdom pa ni/ de'ang dag pa rdo rje'i lus dang dri bral gyi rdo rje'i thugs la spros tshogs bde chen lhan skyes la sgrib byed rnams sdom pa ste/ de'ang thog mar rgyun bshags kyi dus nas mthar dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar ci rigs par thob pa dag ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa zhes bya zhing*/ khyad par du bla med ces pa ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs su thob bo//de'ang dang po bum pa'i dbang gi sdom pas thob pa ni/

bsrung ba'i dam tshig ste/ rigs lnga spyi dang*/ so so'i dam tshig dang*/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang*/ yan lag brgyad rnams yin la/ de las rigs lnga'i dam tshig la mtshon na thog mar 'jug pa'i skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum byas pa'i tshe thob par 'ga' zhig bzhed kyang*/ lan gsum bzlas pa de ni rjes nas cho gas bskyed cing thob pa'i tshe bsrung bar da lta nas khas len pa yin la/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga'i cho ga'i skabs su rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs su thob pa'i rigs pa'i dbang lnga dang mtshungs par thob cing*/ bla med kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs lnga'i dam tshig rnams kyi tshab kyang so sor rim bzhin thob la yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ mngon sum ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs su thob pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang de'ang bla med kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ dbang bzhi ka rdzogs pa'i rjes su bskur dgos par bzhed de/ bum dbang gi mthar slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba ni yo ga dang bstun par bzhed pa'ang yod do/ /gsang dbang gi sdom pas thob pa ni/ bza' ba'i dam tshig ste sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa'o/ /sher dbang gis thob pa ni/ spyad pa'i dam tshig ste srog chags bsad pa sogs khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams so/ /dbang bzhi pa'i sdom pas thob pa ni/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig ste he ru ka'i cha lugs dang shes rab ma bsten pa'o/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig rgyas par dang*/ phyir bcos bcas rjes nas dam tshig rgya mtshos 'chad la/ mdor bsdus su bstan pa de dag ni rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis gsungs las so//gsum pa spyod pa ni/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong min pa gnyis las/ thun mong ni/ las dang po ba'i spyod pa zhes dbang gis rgyud smin pas bskyed rdzogs mos pas sgrub pa ste tshogs lam gyi skabs so/ /thun mong min pa la/

kun bzang spyod pa/ gsang spyod/ rig pa brtul zhugs/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ tshogs spyod bcas lnga'o/ /de'i dang po gnyis pa gsum pa gsum ni rim bzhin sbyor lam gyi skabs su sbyang pa ste dang po rtse gcig tu brtson pa dang*/ gnyis pa 'jigs pa'i sar sbas te spyod ( zla gcig go/ ) pa dang*/ gsum pa la spros bcas he ru ka'i cha lugs rig ma dang bcas kyis gnas sogs nyul ( zla ba drug mchan/ ) ba dang*/ spros med dben par dngos rig yod med gang rung dang*/ shin tu spros med mu to ba'i tshul du skyong ( lkug pa smyon pa'i tshul/ ) ste gsum dang*/ phyogs las rnam rgyal dang tshogs spyod gnyis ni sa thob nas sangs rgyas pa'i bar du zung 'brel du snga ma rang don dang phyi ma gzhan don du gtso bor spyod pa'o/ /'on kyang de rnams go rim gcig tu nges pa rang yang ma yin no/ /'dir spyod pa skyong ba'i gnas nyer bzhi sogs bod dang rgya nag sogs su ci rigs yod par dus 'khor las gsal bar gsungs pa'ang shes dgos so//bzhi pa lam dngos nyams su len pa la/ spyir bum dbang gi nyams len gtso cher bskyed rim yin la/ gsang dbang gi nyams len steng sgo rnam grol gyi chos te gtum mo/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ 'pho ba/ bar do'i gdams pa rnams dang*/ sher dbang gi lam dga' bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myong ba dang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam gnyis med rang byung gi ye shes nyams su myong ba ste dang po'i lam dag ni rags par bskyed rim dang*/ phyi ma gsum gyi lam rags par rdzogs rim du 'dus pas/ rnal 'byor chen po'i lam kun bskyed rdzogs gnyis su 'dus par bskyed pa'i rim pa las/ bcos ma'i rnal 'byor/ bzos pa'i rim pa/ rjes dpag gi lam zhes sogs ming gi rnam grangs su 'gyur la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ ma bcos pa'i rnal 'byor/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rim pa/ de kho na nyid kyi rim pa/ rnal ma'i rnal 'byor/

mngon sum gyi lam zhes pa rnams rim pa phyi ma'i ming gi rnam grangs su 'gyur ro//gzhan yang karma shing rtar gsungs pa skyed rdzogs kyi khyad par la/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas lha'i sgrub thabs dang ye shes kyi sgrub thabs zhes dang*/ dngos grub kyi sgo nas 'jig rten pa'i sgrub thabs dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub thabs zhes dang*/ yid byed kyi sgo nas rnam par rtog pa'i dang de kho na nyid kyi sgrub thabs zhes dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa'am/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi sgo nas sngags kyi sku dang ye shes kyi sku'am/ rgya che ba'i sku dang zab pa'i sku'am/ btags pa dang ma btags pa'i lam sogs kyis 'byed dgos par bshad de/ de las bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba ni/ tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyong bar byed pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor te/ 'di la dbye na/ sems can skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba'i phyir bskyed tshul dngos rnam pa bzhir nges pas/ de'ang rdzus skyes sbyong byed skad cig dran rdzogs dang*/ drod gsher skyes sbyong byed ( drod gsher/ ) pad zla la sa ( rnams/ ) bon tsam las bskyed pa dang*/ sgong skyes sbyong byed mngon byang lngas bskyed pa dang*/ mngal skyes sbyong byed mngon byang lngas bskyed pa'i gtso bo yab yum 'od du zhu ba slar 'khor gyi lha mo'i glus bskul bas bzhengs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'khor lha rnams spro ba dang bcas pa ste/ de ltar mkhas dbang 'ga' zhig bzhed la/ yang gzhan 'dra bar drod gsher skyes sbyong byed mngon byang lnga bskyed dang*/ sgong skyes sbyong byed sa bon phyag mtshan gong bu tsam las bskyed pa zhes kyang bzhed do//mdor na bskyed pa'i chings kyi rim pa phyogs mtshon 'di tsam zhig yod de/ de yang mngon byang lnga bskyed ces pa ni/ ā li las zla ba/ kā li las ( mnyam nyid/

) nyi ma/ de'i bar ram steng du sa bon las ( sor rtogs/ ) phyag mtshan/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres ( bya grub/ ) pa/ de las sku yongs su ( chos dbyings ye shes/ ) rdzogs pa bcas de lnga la ye shes lnga zhes sam mngon par byang chub pa lnga zhes rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med la mang du grags shing nang gses me long lta bu bshad tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ci rigs can no//yang cho ga gsum bskyed ces sa bon gyis ngag sbyong la/ de phyag mtshan du gyur pas yid sbyong ba/ lhar rdzogs pas lus sbyong ba ste bskyed tshul gcig dang*/ rdo rje bzhi bskyed ces/ dang por stong nyid/ gnyis pa sa bon dgod pa/ gsum pa gzugs rdzogs pa/ bzhi pa der yig 'bru dgod pa bcas dang*/ mngon byang lnga skyed bzhin stong nyid las byang chub pa/ zla ba las/ yig 'bru las/ phyag mtshan las/ sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa zhes te bskyed tshul lo//gzhan yang ma rgyud ( gur las ) / las cho ga'i chings yan lag drug tu bzhag ste/ pho brang dang gtso bo ( rgyu rdor 'dzin/ ) bskyed pa rnam snang gi yan lag /de nas gzung dbang gi bar rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ( rjes chags zhes gtso bos rjes chags kyis 'khor gyi lha spro ba'o mchan/ ) dbang skur mi bskyod pa/ bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med/ bstod pa rin 'byung*/ mchod pa don grub kyi bar ro/ /pha rgyud 'dus pa las yan lag bzhir bzhag ste/ dam tshig pa skyed pa bsnyen pa/ skye mched byin rlob pa nyer sgrub/ sku gsung thugs byin rlob pa sgrub pa/ dbang bskur nas rgyas gdab par sgrub chen te yan lag 'di bzhi gong bshad kyi rdo rje bzhi dang sbyor ba'ang yod pa dang*/ bshad tshul mi 'dra ba gzhan yang mang ngo*//pha rgyud gshin rje'i gshed rgyud las/ rnal 'byor bzhi ste/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa rnal 'byor/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor/ de las spros pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ni shin tu rnal 'byor/

de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar rnal 'byor chen por dpal 'dzin gyis bshad pa las 'byung ba dang*/ gzhan yang rgyud rnams las rnal 'byor bzhi ci rigs bshad do/ /dus kyi 'khor lo las/ bsnyen dang nye sgrub sgrub dang sgrub chen gyi yan lag bzhi la/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog thig le'i rnal 'byor phra mo'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pas te/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor ba rdzogs par spros pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'khor gyi lha bsdus te bskyed nas 'byin pa'o/ /phyi ma gnyis ni de dang de'i sems 'dzin no//gzhan yang skad cig gis byang chub pa/ rnam pa lngas byang chub pa/ (

dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ) rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/ ( las rgyal mchog ) sgyu 'phrul dra bas byang chub pa ( phra thig gnyis/ ) zhes dang*/ dkyil 'khor dbyibs kyi ( rgyal mchog ) rnal 'byor/ sngags kyi ( las rgyal mchog ) rnal 'byor/ chos kyi ( phra thig gnyis/ ) rnal 'byor/ rnam par dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa dang*/ gzhan yang yan lag bcu gnyis kyi chings sogs kyang dus kyi 'khor lo las 'byung ngo*/ /ting 'dzin gsum ni sngon du rnal 'byor rgyud du bshad pa ltar te/ de'i dang po'i sbyor ba kho na la'ang rnal 'byor bzhi bsdu ba yod cing*/ de'i tshe ( phreng ba nas bshad brgyud kun gyi chings yin mchan/ ) rnal 'byor drug tu grags pa dang*/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor bzhi bsdu ( gsang 'dus 'phags lugs pa mchan/ ) ba dang*/ de sogs brgyud dang slob dpon rnams kyis bzhag pa'i chings rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa ste che long tsam mo//bskyed rim lha sgom pa la skyo na sngags bzla ba nyid la 'jug pa gang zhig bod du deng bzlas pa nyid nyams len gyi mthil por yod pas/ gal che ba'i dbang gis karma shing rta las byung ba'i bzla dus dmigs pa'i rnam gzhag gi rkang grangs tsam bkod de/ de'ang lha'i rnam pa tsam dran bzhin bzla ba la gzugs kyi bzlas pa zhes dang*/ sngags brjod pa tsam ngag gi bzlas pa dang*/ de la'ang skad gsang bstod de bzla ba rig byed bklag pa lta bu'i bzlas pa dang*/ gong bas thos tsam du bzla ba shub bu'i bzlas pa ste gnyis su dbye ba dang*/ mi brjod par yid kyis bzla ba la yid bzlas dang*/ drag tu brjod pa khro bo'i bzlas pa dang*/ sngags phreng rang gi rdo rje nas yum gyi pad+mar brgyud de de ltar yab yum gyi sku'i dbyibs brgyud de 'khor ba khyogs kyi bzlas pa dang*/ de la'ang zhi ba la sngags phreng ngam 'od phreng mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bu/ rgyas pa la sgro'i chun po lta bu/

dbang la lcags sgrog sbrel ba lta bu/ drag po la thag mdung 'phen pa'am thag gu sgril ba lta bu ste kha dog kyang zhi ba la dkar po sogs so//yang sngags phreng sngar las go bzlog ste rang gi kha nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs nas 'khor ba ni khyogs kyi bzlas pa las drag po'i bzlas pa'o/ /khyogs kyi bzlas pa do la'i bzlas pa 'khor ba'i bzlas pa rnams don gcig go/ /lha'am 'od zer spro zhing bsdu ba ni spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'am dam tshig gi bzlas pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyis sngags bzla bar bsam pa ni dam tshig gi bzlas par bshad pa'ang yod do/ /sngags bkod pa la bzlas te bzla ba ni bkod pa'i bzlas pa'am gong bu'i bzlas pa'o/ /sngags yid kyis bzlas te rlung 'jug gnas 'byung gsum la dmigs pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste dbye na rlung gsum brjod pa'i yi ge gsum gyi sgra gdangs su dran pa brjed pa rdor bzlas dang*/ rlung gsum dkar dmar sngo ba la dmigs pa sogs dmigs pa rdor zlas dang*/ rlung gsum oṃ āḥ hūm̐ gsum du shes pa brda' gyur rdor zlas dang*/ rlung gsum de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du 'jog pa don dam rdor zlas so/ /spros med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzla ba ni 'gog bzlas chen po dang*/ srog rtsol gyi rlung bsdams te bzla ba 'gog zlas chung ngu'o//gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ pha rgyud la gsang 'dus kyi rdzogs rim rim lnga ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa/ ( lus dben/ ) sems la dmigs pa/ ( sems dben/ ) bdag byin rlob pa'i rim pa/( sgyu lus/ ) mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa/ ( 'od gsal/ ) zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa bcas lngar mdzad kyang 'di la dbye bsdu'i bzhed pa mang ba dang*/ gzhan yang pha rgyud gshed skor sogs kyi rdzogs rim skor dang*/ ma rgyud la bde mchog gi rdzogs rim gtso bo dril bu rim lnga zhes bdag byin rlob pa'i rim ( sems brtan byed/ ) pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i (

rlung*/ ) rim pa/ nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim ( dam rgya las rgya chos rgya phyag chen bcas/ ) pa/ dzā lan dha ra'i rim pa/ ( gtum mo/ ) bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa bcas ( gnyis med ye shes/ ) dang*/ gzhan yang lū nag gi rdzogs rim dang*/ kyai rdor la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa zhes/ snang gsum/ rgyud gsum/ tshad ma bzhi/ snyan rgyud bzhi/ rten 'brel lnga'i lam dang*/ man ngag gi gnad bdun sogs kyis 'chad pa dang*/ gzhan yang ma rgyud mā yā sogs kyi rdzogs rim skor ro//gnyis med rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim la/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug ces/ sor sdud/ bsam gtan/ srog rtsol/ 'dzin pa/ rjes dran/ ting 'dzin bcas drug tu gsungs pa'i dang po tha mal gyi dbang shes las ldog ste stong gzugs mthong byed/ gnyis pa de brtan byed/ gsum pa las rlung dbu mar gzhug thabs rlung gi sbyor ba/ bzhi pa de brtan byed/ lnga pa gtum mo kun rtog gi phyag rgya dang*/ las rgya dang*/ phyag chen te phyag rgya gsum dran pa/ drug pa bde stong ting 'dzin dngos so//pha rgyud ma rgyud thams cad kyi rdzogs rim skor 'dus pa ni/ nā ro chos drug ste/ gtum mo lam gyi gzhung shing*/ sgyu lus lam gyi bogs 'don/ rmi lam lam gyi tshod 'dzin/ 'od gsal lam gyi snying po/ zhes rtsa ba'i chos bzhi dang*/ bar do lam gyi blo tshod/ 'pho ba lam gyi skyel ma ste yan lag gi chos gnyis bsnan pa'o//de ltar bum dbang gi lam rim pa dang por bzhag cing rim pa gnyis pa'i skor 'di dbang gong ma gsum gyi lam du bzhag pa ni rags pa'i lugs su bzhag pa yin gyi/ zhib par nā ro chos drug lta bu'i chos tshan re la dbang bzhi ka'i lam tshang ba dang*/ de las kyang zhib na gtum mo lta bu'i chos re la'ang dbang bzhi'i lam tshang ba brtsir rung ba dang*/ bskyed rim gyi rdzogs rim zhes pa sogs du ma zhig gi dbye bsdu yod pa yin no//spyir rdzogs rim gyi sgra don dngos ma bcos pa'i rnal 'byor du nges pas ma bcos pa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam gnyis med rang byung gi ye shes phyag rgya chen po nyams su myong ba nyid las gzhan med la/

'di la ltos na rdzogs rim gyi ming can gzhan thams cad kyang bcos ( nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin yin/ /zhes pas bsal/ mchan/ ) ma'i lam rim pa dang po'i grangs su bshad do//de'ang gnyis med ces pa ni bde stong gnyis su med pa ste/ 'gyur ba de las 'das pa'i 'gyur med kyi bde ba dang*/ dpyad stong ( rje tsong kha pa'i dpyad stong dang 'gyur bde bsal mchan/ ) las 'das pa'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'o/ /bde stong de gnyis ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum la gnyis su med pas gnyis med rang byung gi ye shes zhes par grub bo/ /'on kyang lam gyi skabs 'dir thun mong min pa'i stong pa rgyu dang de'i bde ba 'bras bu'i tshul gyis mngon du gyur te/ rgyud rnams las snying po'i stong nyid la/ lhan cig skyes dga' skyed par byed pa ( mchog mi 'gyur las mchan/ ) zhes dang*/ 'bras bu ni 'gyur med bde ba'i ye shes kyi sems ( rnam par bsdu ba las/ ) so/ /zhes sogs 'byung ba lta bu'o/ /stong nyid de'i ngo bo yang*/ pra phab pa ltar rang gi sems kyis ma brtag pa'i snang ba/ khams gsum pa'i rnam pa can/ rdul phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das pa'i rang gi ngo bo rang bzhin med cing rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba/ mngon sum gyi rig pa/ 'od gsal ba'i ye shes kyi sgyu ma bde ba chen po'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa zhig tu bshad do//'dir dpyad stong gi bde ba chen po'i ye shes mi bskyed dam zhe na/ phung po rnam dpyad stong pa nyid/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /ces sogs mang du 'byung bas shes so/ /yang 'di ltar na las kyi phyag rgya sogs bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa don med par 'gyur ro zhe na/ dbang po'i bye brag gis don med pa'ang ma yin no//'o na dwags po bka' brgyud pa la yongs su grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po 'di gong bshad nyid dam zhe na/

spyir dwags po bka' brgyud pa la gang zag dbang po'i rim pas thabs kyi bye brag gis/ mdo sngags snying po'i phyag chen gsum du grags pa ltar na/ dang po ni/ don phar phyin la phyag chen gyi ming gis bstan pa/ gsang sngags dang rjes su mthun pa zhes sogs bshad pa bzhin dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ gong bshad nyid dang*/ gsum pa ni/ byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bskur gyis smin grol dus gcig byed pa ste de tsam zhig gis gnad tshang bar byed pa'i khrid rgyun no//'o na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa la bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka nges par tshang mi dgos sam zhe na/ 'di la karma shing rta nas bshad pa ltar te/ gdul bya thun mong ba dang*/ dbang rnon gnyis kyi/ dang po la bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel dgos pa dang*/ de'ang klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa dang*/ dril bu pa dang*/ lwa ba pa'i bde mchog sgrub thabs las dang*/ mar me mdzad dang*/ bod sngags 'gos rjes 'brang dang bcas pas ni bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas rdzogs rim la 'jug par bshad pa dang*/ mar 'brog brgyud pa'i sa skya bka' brgyud bying ni thun stod la bskyed rim/ thun smad la rdzogs rim bsgom pa dang*/ dbang rnon gyis ni zung 'jug tu bsgom par bzhed pa dang*/ dbang po shin tu rnon po'i gang zag la bskyed rim sngon du nges par 'gro dgos pa ma yin no//de lta bu'i bskyed rdzogs de dag gi yan lag las dbye na/ lam rgyud la bskyed pa/ de'i yul/ spang bya/ spong thabs/ spangs 'bras dang lnga'i dang po la/ lam dngos dang*/ de'i grogs dang*/ nye ba'i grogs gsum gyi/ dang po bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ gnyis pa de'i grogs la gtor ma/ sbyin sreg /rab gnas/ sāts+tsha/ bum chog bcas lnga/ gsum pa nye grogs la gnas dus grogs rdzas yo byad bcas lnga/ gnyis pa de'i yul la 'jug yul sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa la/ dmigs yul bskyed rim lha sngags dang rdzogs rim stong nyid la/

gsum pa spang bya rnam rtog tha mal gyi rtog pa ngan pa dang*/ lha sogs bzang por zhen pa'i rtog pa gnyis so//bzhi pa spang thabs ngan rtog bskyed rim gyis spong la/ bzang rtog rdzogs rim gyi spong ngo*/ /lnga pa spangs 'bras thun mong mngon shes la sogs pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa phyag chen gyi dngos grub thob pa'o//gnyis pa dam tshig rgya mtsho'i gzhung 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i don bsdus pa dgod pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /sangs rgyas tshogs dang sems dpa' che// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo/ /mngon du ston la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes mchod phyag mdzad nas/ rgyal bas rgyud kun las gsungs pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i de nyid rnams bshad bya//zhes sangs rgyas kyis bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud bla med thams cad du/ sngags kyi rtsa ba smin byed dbang zhus nas grol lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis sgrub pa gal che la/ de'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom par gsungs pas na sngags lam myur du bgrod cing*/ bdud kyis bar du mi gcod pa'i phyir de bshad par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don no//rdo rje theg par 'jug pa rnams/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la//slob ma sangs rgyas mngon 'dod pas/ /smin byed dbang bzhi tshul bzhin zhu//thob nas brtul zhugs sdom pa dang*/ /dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag bcas//dang po bar ma mchog dang ni/ /phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid//rgyud rnams rim pas tshul bzhin zhu/ /rang gi srog bzhin legs par bsrung*//zhes gsungs te/ rdo rje theg par 'jug pa la bla ma gal che bas/ bla ma'ang nyon mongs zhi ba/ sgo gsum dul ba/ mkhas shing snying brtse dang ldan pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig la gnas shing don sgom pa/ skyo ngal dang g.yo sgyu med pa sogs kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dgos la/ de ma yin pa ni spang bar bya ste/ de'ang nga rgyal dang*/ khro ba dang*/ dam tshig dang bral ba dang*/ rdzas nyid la zhe gnag pa dang*/

bdag ma smin pa slob ma bslu ba nyid sogs so//de'ang sa dang po'i ye shes mthong ba'i 'phags pa ni mchog yin la/ ye shes ma mthong ba'i so skye yang dge slong yin na mchog dang*/ 'bring dge tshul dang*/ tha ma khyim pa ste/ ye shes ma mthong ba'i khyim pa dge slong gi bla mar bsten dgos byung na rab byung gi chas dge 'dun la phul nas gzod bsten par gsungs so/ /de ni bstan pa la che ba bya ba'i ched du yin mod nges par mtha' gcig tu de dgos par yang ma nges so/ /bla ma mtshan nyid dang ji lta bar ldan pa snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dka' bar gyur pas skyon yon 'dres pa las yon tan shas che ba tsam ni the tshom med par bsten par bya'o/ /bla ma de rnyed nas ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul ni bla ma lnga bcu pa'i gzhung 'di cis kyang shes par mdzad 'tshal ba las 'dir brir mi lang la/ mdor bsdu na bla ma mchog rnams kyi bka' ni tshig gcig ci gsungs thams cad de bzhin du mi sgrub mi rung la/ de tsam gyi mchog gi bla ma rang min na'ang chos dang mthun pa'i bka' thams cad bsgrub pa dang gzhan ni btang snyoms su bya'o/ /slob ma'ang rgyud snod du rung bas longs spyod yod na dbang yon stobs bskyed de ma phul na dbang mi thob la/ longs spyod med pa la dbang ma sbyin na'ang slob dpon gyi skyon yin pas lam don gnyer de lta bu dag dbang yon med pa la'ang legs par thob pas dbang gi rim pa zhu zhing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams kyang slob dpon gyis brda' sprad pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /dang po bar pa mchog ces pa ni 'og nas bshad pa ltar dam tshig dang lam sbyar ba ste dang po tshogs sbyor bar ma ma dag sa bdun mchog dag pa'i sa'o/ /phyi nang gsang ces pa ni rim bzhin bshad pa bzhin re re la'ang dbye ba yod pa'o//da ni dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshul dngos la/ brtul zhugs bshad pa dang*/ sdom pa bshad pa dang*/ de dag gi go rim dang*/

ltung ba'i tshul rnam par dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rdo rje theg par gnas rnams kyi/ /brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga ste//srog gcod rdzun du smrar ba dang*/ /gzhan gyi bud med nor 'phrog dang*//chang 'thung smyos par byed pa ste/ /spang zhing bslab pa'i gzhi lnga'o//rgyan po kha na ma tho'i zas/ /ngan tshig bstan bcos smrar ba dang*//mu stegs kla klo'i chos spyod pa/ /rnam lnga bya ba min pa lnga//dud 'gro byis pa bud med dang*/ /skyes pa mchod rten bsnun mi bya//dge ba'i grogs dang rje bo dang*/ /dge 'dun rnams dang rgyal ba dang*//yid brtan rnams la 'khu mi bya/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la//mig sogs dbang po'i zhen mi bya/ /'di rnams dang po'i brtul zhugs so//zhes gsungs te/ bsrung bya lnga/ mi bya ba lnga/ mi bsnun pa lnga/ mi 'khu ba lnga/ mi zhen pa lnga ste lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga po de rnams ni las dang po pa dag gi bslab byar dus 'khor las gsungs pa ste dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sngon du bla mas sbyin zhing slob mas khas blang bar bya ba'o/ /de las dang po srog gcod sogs lnga ni/ nyan thos la yang yod pa'i gtan khrims lnga ste 'di'i skabs su de dag gi rgyu shin tu phra zhing phra ba tsam yang mi rung bas khyad par du byas pa tsam las gzhan 'dra bas go sla'o/ /de nas rgyan po ni cho lo mig mang rgyal blon rtse ba sogs so/ /kha na ma tho'i zas ni bsngos sha sogs so/ /ngan tshig (

rgyud 'grel las tshig ngan klog pa dang zhes byung mchan/ ) bstan bcos ni thar lam dang 'gal ba'i bstan bcos ( dmag dang rgyal po sogs kyi gtam zhes byung mchan/ ) so/ /mu stegs pa'i chos ni phyi rol pa'i chos so/ /kla klo'i chos ni kha che'i chos lugs te mgo dkar du grags pa 'di'i 'o/ /de rnams ni mi bya ba lnga'o/ /dud 'gro sogs lnga ni bsad par mi bya ste de las mchod rten dang sku gzugs sogs ni bshig mi rung ba'o/ /'khu bar mi bya ba ni rang gi grogs dang*/ dpon ( rgan rabs sogs zhes kyang snang mchan/ ) dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ rang la yid brten pa ( bla ma zhes 'byung mchan/ ) rnams la sdang bar mi bya'o/ /gzugs sogs lnga la ni zhen chags mi bya ba la sogs pa'o//gnyis pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa la/ theg chen spyi dang thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa bla med kyi sdom pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ thun mong spyi yi sdom pa ni/ /rnam pa lnga ru rgyal bas gsungs//sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /smon 'jug sems bskyed tshul khrims dang*//sdom dang dge ba chos sdud dang*/ /don byed rnam gsum 'dzin pa'o//rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang*/ /bla ma'i dam tshig rdo rje'i rigs//zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rin chen no//phyi nang gsang gsum theg pa yi/ /dam pa'i chos 'dzin pad+ma'o//mchod bstod las kyi bya ba rnams/ /so sor 'dzin byed las kyi rigs//zhes gsungs te/ thun mong zhes pa ni theg chen gyi gzhung thams cad las gsungs pas thun mong ste/ de'ang gsang sngags kyi skabs 'dir rigs lnga'i sdom pa zhes bya bar gsungs zhes tshig gnyis kyis spyir bstan pa yin la/ de yang dbang gi cho ga phal cher tshig mthun par/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes sogs kyis sdom pa 'bog par byed pa des bstan pa'i don te/ dang po sangs rgyas 'khor lo'i rigs kyi sdom pa ni/

smon 'jug gi sems bskyed nas/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims te tshul khrims gsum 'dzin pa ste/ sngon byang sdom gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar ro/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi sdom pa la/ phyi rdzas kyi rdor dril tshad ldan dang*/ lag pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa dang*/ nang rtsa rlung thig le dang*/ gsang ba bde stong gnyis su med par 'dzin pa dang*/ bla ma bkur ba rnams te sor gdub la rdor dril gyi dbyibs byed pa byung ba'ang 'di'i phyi'i dam tshig gi rnam pa'o/ /rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu zang zing gi sbyin pa sogs sbyin pa bzhi po nyin re'ang sbyin par bya dgos pas/ zang zing ni longs spyod dang*/ skyabs ni 'jigs pa skyabs pa dang*/ chos ni chos bshad pa/ byams pa ni sems can thams cad bde ba thob par shog bsam pa ste rjes ma 'di do gal che'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi ni/ phyi nyan rang gi theg pa'i chos dang mthun pa/ nang byang sems dang mthun pa/ gsang ba sngags dang mthun par de gsum ma 'dres rdzogs par 'dzin pa'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi ni/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir mchod pa dang gtor ma dang sbyin sreg las rab 'byams sgrub pa'o/ /de thams cad kyang bsdu na byang chub du sems bskyed pa kho na la 'du'o//'o na pha rol du phyin pa dang khyad med do snyam na/ 'di ni thabs shes dang*/ kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i bdag nyid can dbang las rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'o/ /de la phyi ni smon 'jug byang chub sems dang*/ de la brten pa'i don dam byang chub sems sngar byang sdom du bshad pa nyid dang*/ nang du ni rten kun rdzob khams byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de la brten pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ tshul 'di snga ma la ma grags pas na snga ma la yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /rgyu mtshan des na phyi sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/

nang lus la thig le sdom pa dang*/ gsang ba bde stong dbyer med kyi sdom pa dang*/ de kho na nyid mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'i tshul rig par bya ba ni rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa'o/ /'di'i cho ga ni zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed ces pa de byung ngo*// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa bla med kyi sdom pa ni/ khyad par bla med sdom pa ni/ /rdo rje rigs la srog gcod de//zhing bcu rlung dang rtogs par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs la ma byin len//nor dang bud med theg pa che/ /gzhan dang rang don sgrub byed pa'o//pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig mchog /las chos dam tshig phyag rgya che//bud med yin te bsten pa'o/ /las kyi rigs ni rdzun du smrar//bdag dang sems can mi dmigs par/ /mya ngan 'das la 'god par grags//'khor lo'i rigs la sha lnga dang*/ /chang dang yul kun bsten pa ste//phyi nang gsang ba'i rim pa yi/ /ma nyams spyod pa bla na med//ces gsungs te/ khyad par rnal 'byor bla med la ni/ rdo rje'i rigs la srog bcad par bya ste srog bcad pa la'ang phyi nang gsum las/ phyi'i srog gcod ni zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bsgral pa dang*/ nang du ni rlung bsad pa dang*/ de kho na nyid du rtog pa bsad pa gsum mo/ /de'i dang po ni/ bsgral ba'i zhing bcu zhes sngags snga 'gyur du/ dkon mchog slob dpon sku dgra dang*/ /dam nyams log lta 'khus pa dang*//'du bar 'os min yongs la gnod/ /ngan song gsum dang bcu po ni//rnal 'byor kun gyis dang du blang*/ /zhes pa'o//de'ang bsam pa ni snying rje chen pos bsgral la/ bsad pa gso nus pa'i gang zag yin na ting 'dzin tsam gyis bsad par nus mod/ de lta bu min na rang don min pa dang lha'am bla mas bkas gnang ba dang*/ des 'dul nges dang*/ gzhan ma dad pa med pa dang*/ log par sbyor bar mi 'gyur na phan yon chen po thob cing de ltar min na mi rung ngo*/ /gnyis pa nang du rlung bsad pa ni/

rlung la srog ces bya ste de bcad pa ni bum pa can sogs kyis dgag pa'o/ /gsum pa de kho na nyid du ni/ yid dang rnam par shes pa'i gzung 'dzin bcad pa'o/ /de gsum na rang gzhan gyi don sgrub byed do//rin chen rigs kyi sdom pa la ni/ ma byin pa blang ste/ de'ang nor dang*/ bud med dang*/ theg chen gsum blang bar bya'o/ /de yi dang po ni/ snying rje chen pos ser sna can las nor sbyin pa la 'god pa dang*/ sems can gyi don du gsang sngags bsgrub nas nor rdzas thams cad bkug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phan sems kyis chags pa can las bud med 'phrog ste nyon mongs dang ngan 'gro las bzlog pa dang*/ bde chen ye shes kyi don du lha mi gnod sbyin sogs kyi bu mo dgug pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ theg chen ye shes de rang rig gi rtogs pas ma byin pa blang bar bya'o//pad+ma rigs kyi sdom pa ni/ phyi'i bud med las rgya/ nang chos rgya/ gsang ba dam rgya/ de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po ste phyi nang gi bud med bsten par bya ba'i/ dang po ni/ bud med bsten pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gtum mo'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i rang zhal blta ba'o/ /de'i dang po phyi'i bud med bsten pa'i don ni/ bde chen ye shes kyi don du khyim pa rdor 'dzin nam/ dbang gi rten nam/ rjes dran gyi skabs sam/ rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa'i skabs lta bur lha dang bla mas lung bstan pa'i tshe lha sngags ting 'dzin gsum dang ldan pas gsang zhing skye bo ma dad pa med par bsten te/ sngags skyes zhes mi'i bu mo dge la mos pa sogs sam/ zhing skyes ces yul so gnyis kyi bu mo'am/ rigs skyes ces rang rang gi rigs de dang ldan pa dag go/ las kyi rigs kyi sdom pa la ni/ rdzun smrar te rdzun ni spyir 'khor 'das thams cad don dam par ma grub bzhin du sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol nas mya ngan 'das pa'i sar bzhag ces pa ni rdzun chen po'o/

/dbye na gsum ste phyi ltar na gzhan la phan phyir brdzun smrar ba dang*/ nang ltar na mthar sangs rgyas kyi sar 'jog pa'i phyir du gnas skabs su de dang de'i drod pa la nyan rang gi theg pa ston pa brdzun no/ /gsang ba ltar na brjod med nyid brjod pa kun gyi rgyu'o//'khor lo rnam snang gi rigs kyi sdom pa la/ phyi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga chang bsten pa dang*/ nang du na rtsa rlung byang chub sems la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir dbang shes lnga yul la mi 'phro ba dang lus rigs lngar dag pa dang*/ gtum mo'i 'bar 'dzag las bdud rtsi myong ba dang*/ gsang ba rnam par mi rtog pas rnam rtog bza' ba'o/ /de las sha lnga ni rgya gar gyi yul dbus su bza' mi rung ba'i sha yin phyir de gsod mkhan yang med pas dam tshig gi rdzas su rung*/ yul bod lta bu la ba lang gi sha lta bu mi ( dri med 'od las bshad/ ) rung ba'i tshod yin la/ 'on kyang las kyis shi ba yin na skyon med do// de yang lus stobs bskyed pa'i phyir dang*/ ro mnyam pa'i phyir dang chang yang myos pa'i skyon med na 'thung la/ bdud rtsi lnga nga rgyal gzhom pa'i phyir dang*/ rang bzhin grub pa'i sman yin pas bsten cing*/ bsten tshul yang las dang po pas gsang ba'i tshul gyis cung zad bsten la/ dri ro bsgyur thub pa'i nus pa thob nas gang 'dod bza' ba las gzhan du dri nga ba dang nad sogs su 'gyur ba dang*/ des gzhan ma dad par byed na ni dmyal bar 'gro'o/ /'on kyang bdud rtsi zhes rnam grangs gcig kho na'ang ma yin te/ dngos kyi bdud rtsi ye shes lnga/ snyigs kyi bdud rtsi lus kyi lnga/ ro bcud kyi bdud rtsi dngul chu/ ( khu ba/ ) lha tsher/ ( khrag ) mu zi/ ( bshang ba/ ) bh+ri ga ra tsa ( tshab ra mo shag yin zer te gcin/ ) 'bras bu ( rkang*/ ) gsum mo/ /rlung gi bdud rtsi rlung lnga'o/ /ming gis btags pa'i bdud rtsi lnga ni/ ga pur si la a ru ra gla rtsi tsan+dan no/

/'di rnams gnas skabs dang mthun par bsten no//gsum pa de rnams kyi go rim bstan pa ni/ dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong dang*/ /ye shes kyis rgan rim pa bzhin//'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /rnam grangs mkhas pas shes par bya//zhes gsungs te/ de ltar gong du bshad pa brtul zhugs dang*/ sdom pa thun mong ba dang*/ khyad par ba bcas gsum po de ni rim bzhin dge bsnyen dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ dge slong dang mthun pa'i rim par gnas te/ spyir dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gsum la'ang cho ga'i rim pas phye ba'i dge bsnyen sogs gsum dang*/ brdar btags pa'i gsum dang*/ lam la zhugs zhing 'bras bu thob pa dang sbyar ba'i gsum yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ de ltar brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dzin pa ni dge bsnyen no/ /rigs lnga'i sdom pa thun mong ba 'dzin pa ni dge tshul lo/ /khyad par ba 'dzin pa ni dge slong ngo*//de yang dus 'khor las gsungs pas/ dus 'khor la byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhes thog mar bskur ba yin la/ de thob nas sngags kyi dge bsnyen du brjod pa des rgyud nyan pa dang lta ba la dbang ba dang*/ de nas bum dbang thob nas dge tshul dang*/ gsang dbang thob nas dge slong ste des khyad par gyi sdom pa thob cing*/ rgyud gzhan la ston pa dang*/ lung 'bog pa la dbang zhing*/ de nas dbang gsum pas gnas brtan zhes bya la/ 'jig rten pa'i bzhi pa thob nas rgyal tshab ces pa ste 'jig rten pa'i bzhi pa phyin ni 'jig rten pa'i dbang yin la/ bdag po chen po'i dbang gis 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /las thams cad bya ba ni dbang de ma thob bar du mi dbang ngo*//gnyis pa brdar btags pa'i dge bsnyen sogs ni/ nyan thos kyi theg par dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gsum dang de nas byang chub sems dpa' dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i bar thob pa nyid do//gsum pa lam dang sbyar ba ni/ tshogs lam dang sbyor lam du gnas pa ni khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/

/de nas ma dag pa bdun gyi bar ni dge bsnyen no/ /brgyad pa ni dge tshul lo/ /dgu pa ni dge slong ngo*/ /bcu pa ni gnas brtan no/ /'od zer chen po'i dbang ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ /go rim de ltar du byas pas na/ de la so so skye bo rnams ni bslab pa gzhon pas rgan pa la bkur sti bya la/ yon tan gyis rgan pa la'ang de bzhin no/ /ye shes kyis rgan pa ( nga dang mngon shes thob pa'o mchan/ ) ni thams cad kyis bkur ro/ /'di rnams tshul bzhin mi spyod na bstan pa la smad par 'gyur bas byang chub 'dod pas legs par slob bo//bzhi pa ltung ba'i tshul rnam par dbye ba ni/ de la rnam dbye'i dam tshig ni/ /rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag brgyad//gzhan yang dam tshig bco lnga dang*/ /yan lag rnam grangs bcas pa'o//zhes mdor bstan nas/ rgyas par bshad pa la/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad/ phrin las sgrub pa la brten pa'i ltung ba bco lnga/ de las yan lag tu gyur pa bdun/ de rnams nyes pa che chung gi rim pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de las rtsa ba bcu bzhi ni/ /bla ma dam pa mi brnyas dang*//rgyal ba'i bka' las mi 'da' zhing*/ /rdo rje'i spun la khro mi bya//sems can kun la byams mi spang*/ /byang chub sems ni nyams mi bya//rang gzhan grub mtha' la mi smad/ /gsang ba ma smin la mi bsgrag/phung po khams sogs mi brnyas dang*/ /dag pa'i chos la som nyi spang*//gdug la rtag tu byams ldan min/ /ming bral don la sgro 'dogs spang*//dad ldan sems can sun mi dbyung*/ /dam tshig rnyed pa spang mi bya//shes rab bud med mi smad pa'o/ /nyon mongs drag po la brten nas//'dir 'gal rtsa ltung zhes brjod do//zhes slob dpon klu sgrub kyis cho ga nyi shu par gsungs pa ltar te/ de ltar rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi po de rnams spyir du ni sngar bshad pa bzhin bum pa'i dbang gis thob pa'i sdom par bzhag mod/

bye brag tu ni gang dang gang du 'brel 'gal che ba de dang des thob cing de dag gi ltung bar 'gyur te bcu gsum pa dang lnga pa gsang dbang gi bcu bzhi pa sher dbang gi dgu pa dang bcu gcig pa dbang bzhi pa'i gzhan dgu bum dbang gi'o zhes dpa' bo rin po ches gsungs so//de dag gi lci yang gi rim pa'ang dang po nyid thams cad las lci la/ de nas rim bzhin yang ba'i rnam pa dang*/ 'on kyang 'dir bshad pa'i bcu bzhi las lci ba'i ltung ba gzhan sngags la med pas rtsa ltung bcu bzhi zhes sngags la zhugs pa dag gis cung zad gcig kyang spyad du mi phod pa dag las/ dang po ni/ bla ma'i thugs dkrug pa ste/ de'ang mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad ni slob dpon las thob la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo'ang slob dpon nyid yin pas mchod na bsod nams dpag med thob la/ brnyas na sdug bsngal dpag med thob pas/ de'ang dbang thob pa dang*/ rgyud bshad pa dang*/ gdams ngag sbyin pa ste gsum ldan dang*/ de bzhin du gnyis ldan dang*/ gcig ldan te ltung ba 'byung ba'i yul lci yang gsum/ thugs 'khrugs par byed pa la'ang lus kyis brdeg pa/ ngag gis smod pa/ yid kyis brnab sems gnod sems log lta ste de rnams la'ang dbye ba du ma dang*/ yang na smod pa dang*/ brnyas pa dang*/ thugs dkrug pa gsum ste slob ma rang nyid kyis mi dge sogs spyad nas thugs 'khrugs na bla ma dam pa yin pa'i rtags yin pas lci la bla ma nyid kyi sku don la thugs 'khrugs na dam pa dngos tsam min no//mdor na tshigs bcad gcig tsam thos na'ang bla mar ni bzung dgos la/ pham pa ste rtsa ltung dngos su 'gyur ba'i tshad ni rjes bshad kyi sbyor ba bdun tshang na'o/ /de mi 'byung ba'i phyir mos gus dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun bzhi sogs la bya ba dang gong du bshad pa ltar bla ma lnga bcu pa'i gzhung yang shes par bya dgos so//gnyis pa ni/

rgyal ba'i bka' 'am bla mas chos bzhin du gsungs pa'i bka' bcag pa ste/ de'ang rgyal ba'i bka' la mtha' drug /tshul bzhi/ dgongs pa can bzhi/ ldem dgongs bzhi sogs kyis bcings te yod pas las dang po pas rang nyid kyi blos 'jug dka' na'ang bla ma'i gsungs las thos pas de dang mi 'gal bar bya la/ de las theg chen gyi chos spangs na pham pa dang*/ bka'i tshig gcig la zhen nas bka'i tshig de dang mi mtshungs pa'i rnam pa can gzhan la sdang na sbom (

stong pa sogs la ma zhen par bya'o// )po'o// bka' la sgro bkur chung ngu byed pa ni nyes byas so/ /rjes bshad kyi sbyor ba bdun tshang na rtsa ltung du 'gyur ba ni thams cad la shes dgos so/ /gzhan gyi mngon zhen bzlog pa'i phyir smras pa sogs ni nyes med do//rtsa ltung gsum pa ni/ rdo rje'i spun la khros pa ste/ de'ang spun dang*/ rdo rje'i spun dang*/ nye ba'i spun dang*/ khyad par gyi spun dang*/ bye brag gi spun te lnga las/ dang po spun ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa thams cad yin la/ gnyis pa rdo rje'i spun ni/ sngags dang khyad par bla med la zhugs pa thams cad dang*/ gsum pa nye ba'i spun ni/ dper na bde mchog lta bu yi dam gcig gi dbang thob pa thams cad de de thob phyin sa kar rnying med pa thams cad dang*/ bzhi pa khyad par gyi spun ni/ slob dpon gcig pa dang*/ lnga pa bye brag gi spun ni/ dus gcig tu bla ma dang dkyil 'khor bcas gcig las dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs pa'o/ /de bzhin du bud med la ni sring mo dang nye ba'i sring mo sogs sbyar ro/ /de ni slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis bzhed pa ste dus 'khor las ni spyir sems can thams cad ma spun dang dkyil 'khor gcig tu zhugs pa ni rdo rje'i spun dang*/ sngags la zhugs pa thams cad ni nye ba'i spun dang*/ bsten pa gcig la gnas pa thams cad mdzes pa'i spun dang*/ slob dpon gcig pa khyad par rdo rje spun dang*/ bye brag tu thob pa ni bye brag rdo rje spun dang*/ spun gyi dbye ba gzhan yang du ma 'dug kyang 'dir ma bris la/ spun rnams la de ltar lci yang ni che mod kyang spun gong ma la sbyor ba bdun thal na rtsa ltung du 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan ni de'i rim pas shes la phan sems dang bag med zlog pa sogs nyes med do//rtsa ltung bzhi pa sems can thams cad la byams pa mi spang ba ni/ sems can yin tshad las gang rung gcig kyang blos spangs pa ste byang sdom las bshad pa nyid do/

/sems bskyed pa dang ma bral bar bya ste tshad med bzhi dang ldan par bya'o/ /de'ang mnar sems dgu dang ldan na ltung ba dang*/ sems khong nas 'khrugs na sbom po ste/ dus 'das na lci ba'am sbyor ba tsam nyes byas so/ /'dir nyan thos theg par ni zhe sdang las 'dod chags nyes pa lci bar bshad la/ theg chen du ni 'dod chags ri rab tsam las zhe sdang skad cig tsam yang lci bar bshad do//rtsa ltung lnga pa ni/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid dang*/ de'i brten pa khu ba nyams pa gsum yin la/ de la sngon ( snga ma sngon du 'chad la/ don dam stong nyid bcu gcig par 'chad do mchan/ ) ma gnyis ni snga phyir gzhan du 'chad la/ 'dir ni khu ba nyams pa nyid de/ 'di la rgyu mtshan med do snyam pas spangs na bka' 'das pa'ang yin pas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang na rtsa ltung*/ rjes ma tshang na sbom po/ /rang dbang ma thub par nyams shing de ma thag/ 'gyod pa lta bu ni nyes byas so/ /snying rje chen po dang slob ma smin par byed pa'i skabs sogs su nyes med du 'gyur ro//rtsa ltung drug pa ni/ rnyed bkur 'dod pas grub mtha' gzhan la smod pa ste/ theg chen gyi rgyud sde la bsam sbyor bdun gyis smad na ltung ba'o/ /theg chen gyi mdo la smad na sbom po'o/ /theg dman la nyes byas so/ /phyi rol pa la phra mo'i nyes byas so/ /theg chen la gzhug pa dang*/ lta ngan sun phyung ba dang*/ de 'dul ba'i bsam pas smad na nyes med du ma zad bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob bo/ /'di dang 'og ma gnyis ka ltung ba gnyis pa'i yan lag yin no//rtsa ltung bdun pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi chos slob ma ma smin pa la mi bshad pa ste/ ma smin pa la dbye na bzhi ste/ chos la khong khro ba'i log lta can ni rgyud ma smin pa dang*/ bdag tu lta ba dang*/ 'khor ba la skyo ba dang*/ sems can gyi don mi byed pa gsum ni rkyen gyis ma smin pa ste de bzhi la rgyud bla ma nas rim bzhin 'dod chen mu stegs nyan rang bzhis sgrib pa'i sgrib pa bzhir gsungs so/

/de ltar ma smin pa la rim pa ltar gong ma rnams gsang dgos te rim gyis thabs mkhas pas bsgrag par bya'o/ /dbye ba ni gong ma dang mtshungs so/ /chos zab mo la log lta skyes na lta ci smos sha lnga bsten pa la log lta skyes na mthong ba de phyi'i skye ba brgya len pa dang*/ bris sku sogs skal med kyis mthong na rang nyid bstan pa po de la tshe 'dir dngos grub med par bshad do//brgyad pa ni/ rang gzhan gyi phung po khams skye mched thams cad mi brnyas pa ste gzugs sku dri bcas yin pas so/ /gal te rang gi gzugs la bsad pa dang*/ spyug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ rang la zhe sdang zhing yi mug pa dang*/ bka' spyad kyis nyon mongs par byed pa dang*/ lus mi gtsang bar bsgom zhing yan lag sogs ma rung bar byed pa ste/ de ltar shes bzhin du brnyas pa ni ltung ba dngos so/ /de dag las lus brnyas pa dngos ni/ mu stegs pa'i dka' spyad dang*/ yan lag zha bor byed pa dang*/ nad kyis gzir ba la khro ba la sogs pa yin gyi bka' las gsungs pa'i smyung gnas sogs ni de lta ma yin no/ /ltung ba dngos kyi yan lag ma tshang na sbom po'o/ /don gzhan med par zas gcod pa sogs nyes byas so/ /don chen chos ldan ni nyes med do//dgu pa ni/ rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la the tshom byed pa ste/ dag pa'i chos ni chos thams cad chu nang gi zla ba ltar rang bzhin med par snang tsam pa 'di kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin la don dam bden pa ni stong pa nyid yin mod kyang de las don dam bden par som nyi za ba'i ltung ba ni bcu gcig par bshad pas 'dir snga ma bzung ngo*//de yang rten 'brel bcu gnyis sogs dang sems can sangs rgyas su gnas 'gyur ba'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag 'di rnams de tsam du 'gal lo snyam pa las ltung ba 'di 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas la rtog pa med pa dang*/ gzhan sems mkhyen pa'i mngon shes mnga' ba gnyis las gang rung gcig mi bden te 'gal snyam pa ltung ba dngos gzhi ste gzhan rtsa ltung drug pa bzhin no//bcu pa ni/

gdug pa can la byams pa ltar byed pa ste/ gdug pa ni bdud mu stegs dregs pa can snying rje med pa dang yang dag pa'i bkas mi 'dul ba sogs yin cing*/ byams pa zhes par log spyod de dag bzang po yin pa ltar de la dga' bar byed cing rang gar 'jog pa'o/ /de de ltar du dor na ngan song du ltung bas/ bsdu dngos bzhi dang drag shul sogs kyis mi 'dul bar mthun par byed na ltung ba'o/ /'dul nus kyang snyoms las kyis lus na sbom po'o/ /mi nus kyang snying rjes ( 'dul nus par gyur cig bsam pa sogs mchan/ ) mi 'dzin na nyes byas so//bcu gcig pa ni/ tha snyad las 'das pa'i yul la sgro skur byed pa ste/ tha snyad las 'das pa'i yul ni/ chos dbyings dang chos nyid dang de bzhin nyid ces pa'i rang bzhin 'di dang 'di'o zhes brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa ste dbu ma'i gzhung sogs las rgyas par bstan to/ /de la yod pa dang*/ med pa dang*/ gnyis yin dang*/ gnyis min dang*/ blos sgro 'dogs shing so so skye bo'i blo yul dang sbyor na ltung ba'o/ /phra rags ni drug par grub mtha'i skabs bzhin no/ /dad pas mos nas rtogs pa ni skyon ma yin no//bcu gnyis pa ni/ dad ldan sems can sun mi 'byin pa ste/ theg pa la gsar du 'jug pa'i las dang po ba la dad pa nyid gal che bas dad ldan la/ khyod kyis brtson pas ci zhig bya/ sangs rgyas ni sgrub dka' 'o zhes brjod nas sun phyung ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi gsang spyod mthong bas ma dad pa sogs kyis/ rdo rje theg pa las log na ltung ba dngos dang*/ mdo dang nyan thos las log na sbom po'o/ /re zhig sgyid lug na nyes byas so/ /de phyir dad pa bskyed par bya'o//bcu gsum pa ni/ dam tshig rnyed pa spangs pa ste/ dam tshig gi sgra ni sngar bshad pa'i sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ chang la sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i don du bstan pa de rnams dang*/ gzhan yang yan lag 'og nas 'byung ba dang*/

sku'i dam tshig lha bsgom pa dang*/ gsung gi dam tshig sngags bzlas pa dang*/ thugs kyi mi rtog par bsdu ba sogs yin zhes gsungs pas 'dir dang po rnams so/ /spangs pa ni rnal 'byor gyi go rim gyis mi spyod par khyad du gsod pa'o/ /de la'ang tshogs rdzas min par chang la bag med byed pa dang*/ shi sha min pa'i sha za ba sogs 'dir yang shes par bya'o//mdor na tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas sogs la'ang brda'i ming gis ma brjod na ltung ba'o/ /shes bzhin nyon mongs dang bcas pas khyad du gsod na dngos gzhi'o/ /gong ma'i bya ba dor nas 'og ma'i dam tshig ltar byed pa sbom po'o/ /mi shes pa dang snyoms las kyis lus pa ni nyes byas so/ /gzhan gyi don dang mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas ni nyes pa med do//bcu bzhi pa ni/ shes rab kyi rang bzhin bud med la smod pa ste/ shes rab ni chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de'i rang bzhin ni sngar bshad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'o/ /de'i bye brag ni bud med dngos so/ /smod pa ni mi gus shing yid mi ches pa'o/ /phyag rgya bzhi ka la smod na dngos gzhi'o/ /bud med la ngag gis nyes pa brjod pa'ang nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs drag po zhes sogs tshig gnyis ni bcu bzhi po thams cad kyi bsdu ba'o//gnyis pa yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad ni/ de nas phyogs mthun yan lag ni/ /dam med rig ma bsten mi bya//tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa spang*/ /ma gsungs pa yi rig ma las//dam tshig bdud rtsi blang mi bya/ /gsang chos dus ldan bstan par bya//chos dri bre mo'i gtam mi bya/ /nyan thos nang du zhag bdun min//rnal 'byor ye shes mi shes par/ /rdo rje 'dzin par khas mi blang*//dus min gsang chos bstan pa min/ /'dir 'gal yan lag ltung ba brgyad//ces gsungs pa ni/ rtsa ba bcu bzhi dang*/ rjes su mthun pa'i yan lag ste pham pa med par sbom po dang mtshungs pas yan lag yin la/

yang na dang po gsum rang rgyud smin par bya ba dang*/ 'og ma lnga gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa'i yan lag yin no/ /dang po ni/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs la rig ma bsten par gsungs pa thos nas dam tshig dang mi ldan pa bsten na nyes pa'o/ /dam tshig dang mi ldan pa ni dbang ma thob pa dang gsang mi thub pa dang*/ sngags pa bdag nyid la mi dad pa dang mtshan nyid bshad pa dang mi ldan pa'o/ /mtshan ldan yang 'dod sems kyis bsten na nyes byas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshogs 'khor gyi skabs su gral dang bza' btung sogs la rtsod pa'o/ /rtsod pa gral la gyes gong du zhi na nyes byas dang de las 'das na sbom po'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyud nas ma gsungs shing smad pa'i rig ma la phyi nang gi dam tshig bdud rtsi blang bar mi bya zhing blangs nas dus las ma 'das gong bshags na nyes byas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gsang ba'i chos shes shing dus dang ldan par phan ( snod du dang mchan/ ) par 'dod pa la bshad par bya ste/ gzhan du 'dod pas longs spyod med par mi ston pa'am rang gi ched dam dpe mkhyud byed na nyes pa ste/ 'dod pas mi ston na sbom po'o/ /rung ngam mi rung zhes the tshom nas ma bstan na nyes byas so/ /lnga pa ni/ gzhan ( snod rung gis mchan/ ) gyis chos kyi dri ba dris pa la lan du bre mo'i gtam zhes ku re lta bus de rlung la bkur bar ( dor ba mchan/ ) mi bya'o/ /theg chen chos la sbom po'o/ /theg dman gyi chos la nyes byas so/ /drug pa ni/ theg chen la mi 'dod pa'i nyan thos kyi nang du zhag bdun gnas pa ste/ de'ang rang tshul dor nas gnas na sbom po dang*/ rkyen dbang gis gnas na nyes byas so/ /bdun pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi tshul phyi nang gzhan gsum dang zung 'jug rnal 'byor mi shes pas phyi'i bya ba skyed rim sogs kyi phyogs tsam shes pas nga ni sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa'o zhes khas mi blang la/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis byas na sbom po dang*/

nga rgyal med pas brjod na nyes byas so/ /brgyad pa ni/ nang gi snod dang mi ldan pa'i slob ma la tshogs bshad bstan rgyu la shin tu gsang ba'i don bstan na nyes pa ste/ slob ma'ang rin po che lta bu dang*/ tsan+dan lta bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma dkar po dang*/ ut+pal lta bu'i gang zag lnga las rin po che lta bu la slob bshad dang*/ gzhan la tshogs bshad bstan pa'i snod do/ /snod shes bzhin bshad na sbom po dang ma shes na nyes byas so/ /brgyad po 'di rnams ni yan lag gi gtso bo dus 'das na rtsa ba dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro//'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa ni chos kyi gtam sogs la rtsod pa ste khros nas rtsod na rdo rje'i spun la khro ba dang 'di gnyis kar 'gyur ro/ /brgyad pa 'di yang gsang sgrog tu mi 'gyur te rgyud nyan pa la dbang ba'i slob ma yin pas so/ /de sogs zhib cha du ma yod do/ /'di'i yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad 'di'i ngos 'dzin 'dra min mang bas 'dir ni 'jam dpal grags pa'i gzhung bzhin bkod par mdzad cing*/ gzhung de tshad ldan du mdzad ( la la dag gis 'di 'jam dpal grags pa'i gzhung min par yang byed do mchan/ ) do//gsum pa phrin las sgrub pa la brten pa'i ltung ba bco lnga pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon dpa' bos phyung ste ston pa dang mthun par gsungs pa ni/ gzhan yang rnam pa bco lnga ste/ /mchod sogs dus las 'das pa dang*//rang lha blang dor byed pa gzhan/ /phyi rol 'jig rten lha dga' dang*//dngos po thar zug zhen cing sgom/ /dbang ma rdzogs par gzhan la bskur//tshe 'di'i don du bstan pa dang*/ /'og ma'i bslab pa khyad du gsod//rnying phyir rang tshul gong mar ston/ /nus med phrin las rtsom pa dang*//don med snyoms las kyis gnas byed/ /brtse sems spong bar byed pa dang*//dman pa'i spyod pa byed la dga'/ /'jig rten g.yeng bas dus 'da' zhing*//nyams pa yal bar 'dor byed cing*/

/rang gi spyod pa dor byed pa//'di rnams ltung bar gsungs pa yin//zhes pa'i/ dang po ni/ bskyed rdzogs la gnas par dam bcas nas nyin dang mtshan du lus ngag yid kyis mchod bstod dang bzlas pa dang*/ tha na mos pa yang dran par mi byed na dus las 'das nas ltung bar 'gyur bas slar gnyis pa ldabs su brtson par bya'o/ /don gzhan gong ma dang na ba dang bla ma'i bya ba sogs las chag na nyes pa med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi yi dam du bzung ba de las lha gzhan bzang ba'i rtog pa blang dor ( snga ma dor ba'o mchan/ ) byed na ltung ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ phyi rol pa dang 'jig rten pa'i lha la mchod pa sogs byed cing mchog tu 'dzin pa ste gzhan phan dang don chen gzhan dang dbang med la nyes med do/ /bzhi pa ni/ skyed rim sgyu ma lta bu'am/ yang na thun bsdu ba la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim gyis rgyas mi 'debs par lha sku sogs gdos bcas ther zug tu bsgoms na ltung ba ste/ dmigs pa 'dzin pa dang nus mthu brtan par byed pa la nyes pa med do//lnga pa ni/ dbang ma rdzogs par gzhan la bskur ba ste lung bstan thob na rung ngo*/ /drug pa ni/ zab mo'i don tshe 'di kho na'i don du bstan pa ste/ gtso bor tshe phyi ma dran na rung ngo*/ /bdun pa ni/ bslab pa 'og ma brnyas pa ste gong ma yar ldan du mthong na rung ngo*/ /brgyad pa ni/ 'dod pas longs spyod snyan grags bsgrub phyir rang la med pa'i yon tan yod par ston cing tshul 'chos byed pa ste don chen gzhan phan dang 'khrul na nyes med do/ /dgu pa ni/ nus pa med par zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i las sbyor byed pa ste des gzhan ma mos pa dang log par byed pa'i rkyen byed na'o/ /rang dag gi mthu brtas par byed pa dang grogs byed pa la rung ngo*//bcu pa ni/ don med par snyoms las kyis gnas par byed cing rang gzhan gyi rgyud smin par mi byed pa sten pa dang rkyen gyis yin na rung ngo*/

/bcu gcig pa ni/ phan gdags yul gyi sems can nad kyis zin pa lta bu dman pa dag gi skyabs nus bzhin mi byed pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ theg pa 'og ma'i spyod pa la dga' bar spyod pa ste gzhan 'dul bar bya ba sogs la rung ngo*/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam g.yeng gis dus 'da' bas gzhan dang mthun par byed pa ste des 'dul ba la rung ngo*/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ dam tshig nyams pa sogs 'dul bar nus bzhin du mi 'dul ba ste/ dus shes pas re zhig bzhag rung zhing gzhan gyis 'dul na bzhag go /bco lnga pa ni/ theg pa dang rgyud bzhi po dang*/ las dang po nas rnal 'byor mchog gi bar du go rim ltar gsungs pa'i spyod pa mi byed par gzhan byed pa'o//'dir rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas spyod pa'i skabs su spyod pa bzhi gsungs te/ las dang po bas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bya la/ rgyud gzhan nas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa gnas skabs gzhan du bstan te de ni dgongs pa gzhan yin no/ /cung zad brtan pa thob nas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya ste gsang spyod zla ba drug la sogs par bya bar bshad do/ /brtan pa thob pa rnams kyis mgon po kun du spyod pa la gnas par bya'o/ /zhes bshad pa'i rgyud chen po las 'byung ngo*/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de rnams dgos pa chen po dang 'brel na ltung ba med do//bzhi pa de las yan lag tu gyur pa bdun bshad pa ni/ dam pa nyer bsten gcig shos min/ /snod dang ldan pa rnam par brtag/'dod phyir gzhan la gnod pa spang*/ /dkon mchog la sogs nor la min//gzhan don skad cig yal mi dor/ /dge kun sems bskyed bsngo bas bzung*//rnam shes 'pho ba'i de nyid mkhas/ /'di yang yan lag nyes par bshad//ces te/ dang po bla ma dam pa brten cing dam pa min pa spong ba dang*/ gnyis pa slob ma snod rung sdud cing snod dang mi ldan pa mi sdud pa dang*/

gsum pa 'dod pas sngags la sogs pa'i don chung ba la sems can la sha dang rus pa la sogs pa'i phyir 'tshe ba sogs dang*/ bzhi pa dkon mchog gi rdzas sogs lci ba'i rdzas longs mi spyod de 'dod pas spos dri yang mi snom pa dang*/ lnga pa gzhan don bya ba dang*/ drug pa dge ba thams cad sems bskyed pa dang bsngo bas zin par bya ste dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par bya ba dang*/ bdun pa rnam shes 'pho ba'i de nyid mkhas pa ste dus su ma babs bar du mi 'pho ba dang*/ 'od gsal las snying rje'i ldang ba'i tshul shes par bya'o/ /de thams cad la phra rag gi rim pa'i bye brag shes par bya'o//lnga pa de rnams nyes pa che chung gi rim pa spyir bstan pa ni/ mdor na rgyud kyi rim pa bzhin/ /dbang bzhi'i tshul dang rjes 'brel bas//blo dang ldan pas legs par spyad/ /kham sogs dbye ba'i go rim yang*//nyon mongs kun bslang der shes ldan/ /lus ngag sbyor brten bar bcad cing*//ma 'khrul 'gyod med tshad las 'das/ /bdun ldan pham pa zhes brjod la//dngos gzhi med dang tshad las 'das/ /ltung ba zhes brjod lhag ma 'dra//de bas dman dang yan lag gi/ /gtso bo lci ste sbom po bzhin//yan lag gzhan dag ltung byed mtshungs/ /phyogs mthun phra mo nyes byas te//ltung ba'i gzugs brtan nyes med dag /legs shes gnyen po rab tu brten//zhes te/ rgyud bzhi'i rim pas bsrung dgos pa ni bya spyod la do gal che ba smon 'jug dang*/ bla ma'i dam tshig dang*/ bskyed rdzogs/ bzlas brjod/ mchod bstod rnams dang*/ bla med dang rnal 'byor rgyud la bzhi ka dang ldan pa'i phyir thams cad bzung ba dang dbang bzhi dang 'brel che ba ni rtsa ltung nyid kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /de yang sngar rtsa ltung nyid kyi skabs su bshad pa'i sbyor bdun tshang na pham par 'gyur ro zhes bcu bzhi po thams cad la shes dgos pa ni/ bsam pa nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa/
