de la de yin par shes pa dang*/ lus ngag gi sbyor ba gang gis nyes pa bskyed pa de brtan pa dang*/ bar bcad ces pa ni ltung ba so so'i dngos gzhi dang*/ 'gyod pa med par yi rang ba dang*/ sems ma 'khrul ba dang*/ bla ma bzhugs na bla ma la lo gcig gam gsum tshun du ma bshags na tshad las 'das pa (

bla ma ma bzhugs na bshags sdom legs par byas pas don tshang ngo*// ) ste bdun tshang na pham pa dang*/ tshad las ma 'das pa'i yan lag drug tshang na ltung ba zhes so thar gyi lhag ma dang 'dra ba dang*/ yan lag gzhan med pa'i dngos gzhi ni sbom po dang*/ de bas kyang dman na ltung byed dang*/ yan lag gzhan med pa'i lus ngag gi sbyor ba gcig ni nyes byas dang 'dra la dran pa nyams te byas pa'i dngos gzhi'ang nyes byas so//ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan zhes pa ni/ gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ba mthong ba sogs don chen po dang*/ bar chad du 'gro ba dang*/ gnang ba thob pa dang*/ na zhing mi nus pa la nyes pa med par gsungs so//da ni dam tshig thams cad bsdu na/ dkon mchog phyi nang byang chub sems/ /yul dang yul can phyi nang rkyen//tshar bcad rjes bzung phrin las su/ /dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa'o//zhes dkon mchog gsum dang*/ phyi nang byang chub sems mi spang ba dang*/ yul dang yul can gyi dag pa la the tshom mi za ba dang*/ phyi nang gi mthun rkyen nye bar brten pa dang*/ tshar gcod rjes bzung gi phrin las dus las mi 'da' bas bsdus zhes dpa' bos 'grel lo//de nas de ltar bshad pa'i ltung ba de dag las nyams na bshags tshul ni/ gal te nyams na bshags bya ste/ /dbang bskur sbyin sreg gsang sngags dang*//maṇ+ḍal gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ /nyams pa'i tshad du sbyar te spyad//lus ngag yid kyi rim pa yis/ /dka' spyad bsam gtan tshul bzhin bya//zhes te/ rtsa ltung gi gnyen por slob dpon la ci 'byor bas mchod de dbang bskur slar len pa'am/ yang na rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug len pa dang bla ma bsten pa'i tshul la nan tan byed pa dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa bskyar ba dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya 'bum 'don pa'am/ rtsa ltung byang ba'i rtags ma thob kyi bar 'don pa dang*/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa rnams yin la/ gzhan yang phyag skor tshwa tshwa smyung gnas tshogs gtor ma maṇ+ḍal sogs gang la gang 'os sbyar zhing*/

de yang rtsa ltung dang po'i gsum ldan gyi bla ma la sbyor ba bdun thal na dka' spyad dang*/ dngos po kun phul ba dang*/ bka' bsgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur len bdun zhu ba dang*/ tshogs 'khor nyer gcig /sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bdun/ sngags bye ba lnga/ maṇ+ḍal nyis 'bum/ srog chags bye ba'i tshe skyabs pa rnams sgrub dgos par gsungs la/ 'di'i sbyor ba bdun gyi dngos gzhi bar bcad ces pa de ni go tshul gzhan yang yod kyang*/ mdor na nyon mongs drag pos kun slong gis bla ma la smod pa'am brnyas pa'am rang gi mi dge spyad pas thugs 'khrugs pa'am mtshon sogs bsnun pa gang rung gis dngos gzhir 'gyur la/ de la sbyor ba gzhan rnams kyang tshogs ngan rtsa ltung dang por 'gyur nges so//gzhan yang rtsa ltung gnyis pa la yi dam lha'i phra thig sgom pa/ gsum pa la spyod pa/ phyag maṇ+ḍal sngags tshogs 'khor skye med sgom pa dang*/ bzhi pa la slar blang ba ( byang sdom du bshad pa bzhin/ ) dang*/ gang zag la bshags pa dang*/ lnga pa la bskyed rim dang*/ bdag byin rlob pa'i rim pa dang*/ kun rdzob dang don dam gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ drug pa la chos kun mnyam pa nyid du shes pa dang*/ bdun pa la dbang dang tshogs dang snying rje bskyed pa dang*/ brgyad pa la dbang dang tshogs dang nang gi tshul rtogs pa dang*/ dgu pa la bsam gyis mi khyab pa rtogs pa dang*/ bcu pa phrin las rnams bsgrub cing snying rje bskyed pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa rnam par mi rtog pa bsgom pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa tshogs maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas bshags shing gzhan phan bsgrub pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa gnas skabs shes pas dang tshogs maṇ+ḍal dbang*/ bcu bzhi pa'ang dbang tshogs kyis so//rgyu mtshan de bas na lus ngag yid gsum blo dang ldan pas zhib tu brtag la/ nyin gcig bzhin du bslab pa gsum la bsam mno btang zhing bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/

bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi bka' bsgrub cing thams cad la dag snang bskyed la/ sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom zhing*/ ci nus la phan par bya ba dang*/ gnod byed rnams kyang nus pa dang sbyar te bzlog la bstan pa la bkod cing*/ rang gi yon tan la rlom sems spang la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don la mos par byas nas/ gal te nyes pa byung ba mthong na de ma thag tu gnyen pos bzlog la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod na ltung bas mi gos par rig par bya'o//da ni nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ ma bshags rdo rje dmyal ba sogs/ /tshul min sdug bsngal bsam las 'das//zhes te/ rdo rje dmyal ba ni/ sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa dag ltung ba'i gnas te/ dmyal ba gzhan las sdug bsngal du ma 'gyur du che ba dang*/ gzhan yang yi dwags su skye ba sogs nyes dmigs du ma gsungs shing*/ mdor na nyes pa chung ngus kyang gnod pa chen por 'gyur bas myur du bshags par bya'o//ma nyams pa'i phan yon ni/ ma nyams rab ni tshe gcig gis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid 'grub cing*//thun mong dngos grub thams cad kun/ /thogs med bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub//ces gsungs te/ de'ang rdo rje theg pa thos pa dang*/ de la dad pa tsam yang skye ba du ma'i sngon nas sangs rgyas nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus yin la/ thos pa dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang sdig pa dag pa dang*/ longs spyod thob pa sogs te phan yon mtha' yas pa bshad pa las/ 'dir 'jam dpal grags pas cung zhig bsdus pa ni/ bde gshegs rnams kyis bu bzhin rab dgongs nas//sku gsum ye shes sgrib med mngon du gyur//nad med nor dang rkang 'gro mang po 'phel//'bad pa med par 'dod pa kun 'grub cing*//rgyal po la sogs gsong por smra ba dang*//skye bo mang pos rtag tu bkur bar 'gyur//'khor dang longs spyod mang pos rnam par mdzes//rims gdon gnod pa kun las myur du thar//rin thang med pa'i rin chen rnams kyang thob//gdon dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis 'bar bar mthong*//rdo rje 'chang ba mang pos rjes su 'brang*//byang chub sems dpa' mang pos spun bzhin dgongs//sngags dang zhing skyes mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub ster//'jig rten skyong ba kun gyis rtag tu skyong*//gdug pa can rnams mthong na dga' bar byed//'bad pa med par gsungs pa'i las rnams 'grub//zhing gzhan bskal mang sdom la gnas pa bas//skad cig 'dir gnas 'bras bu rdzogs par byed//thabs kyi bsod nams tshogs ni rab rdzogs byed//bden pa'i ngag can de ni lung bstan te//brtag pa rnam ldog bden pa'i don mthong nas//sa nas sar 'phags mi mthun phyogs spangs te//sgyu ma lta bur rtogs med mnyam par byas//kha sbyor bde ba mtshan gyis rnam par brgyan//stobs sogs sangs rgyas chos rnams yongs rdzogs nas//'bad rtsol med par yid bzhin nor bu ltar//dus las yol med dwangs pa'i chu zla bzhin//de dag sdom ldan rnams la mngon sum bzhin//zhes te/

mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku de lta bu'ang tshe 'di nyid la mngon du byed pa'i phan yon de ldan nyams su len pa la rnam pa kun du 'bad par bya'o//de nas mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa sangs rgyas kun gyi lam//rgyud rnams kun du gsungs pa smin grol don bstan pa//de dag snying po dam tshig rtsa ltung yan lag bcas//rgyal sras mkhas grub rnams kyis rgya cher bstan gyur kyang*//snyigs dus dad ldan deng sogs theg mchog mos pa rnams//tshe thung sna tshogs g.yeng bas spyad par mi nus la//phan par bsam nas rang byung rol pa'i rdo rje yis//rgyal sras rgyud 'grel mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad ltar bris//nyes pa'i tshogs rnams rdo rje 'dzin dang mkha' 'gro la//bzod par gsol cig sgrib pa thams cad sel bar shog/dge ba ci yod mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la//bsngos pas sgrib gsum bral ba'i rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig/e waṃ mā yā rdo rje rol pa sems dpa'i thugs te gnyis med rol pa gang*/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor mar ldan rab tu dgyes pa'i lha tshogs gar bcas pa/ /spros med rang bzhin spros pa'i sgra dbyangs chos tshul rab sgrog mchog rab sems can rnams/ / srid pa 'dir ni zhi bar rol pas rgyu dang mi rgyu lhan cig gar byed shog/ ces brtsoms pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bsdus tshul/ bsngo ba sogs dang bcas rdzogs par bstan par mdzad do/ /gzhung 'di byed pa'i tshe bla ma dang he ru kas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags dang nam mkha' la'ang 'ja' dang 'od du 'khyil zhing snang bas thams cad kyis bris shing nyams su longs shig /zhes kyang gsungs so//'dir gong du rtsa ltung bcu gsum pas bstan pa'i dam tshig tu yo byad bcang bar bya ba la/ sku'i dam tshig tu bris sku lha'i chags tshad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig tshad/ gsung gi bgrang 'phreng dang*/

glegs bam gyi de nyid/ thugs kyi ḍā ma ru thod pa kha ṭāṃ ga /yon tan dang*/ phrin las kyi he ru ka'i rgyan drug /gzhan yang dgang blugs las bzhi'i thab thig tsam yan chad kyang rgyud las bstan pa bzhin gyi tshad dang mtshan nyid tshang bar shes dgos rgyur 'dug pa las lha'i chags tshad ni lha bris pa'i las su bab 'dug mod kyang gzhan ni sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su bab 'dug pa'ang shes par bya dgos so//yang skabs 'dir gsang sngags rnying ma ba la grags pa'i tshul yang zur tsam bshad na/ de yang theg pa rim pa dgu zhes te/ nyan rang byang sems gsum/ kri ya u pa yo ga gsum/ ma hā a nu a ti gsum ste dgu'o/ /de las nyan rang gnyis ni 'di'i le'u dang po la bshad pa nyid dang*/ byang sems ni le'u gnyis pa la bshad pa nyid dang*/ kri ya ni bya rgyud dang*/ u pa ni spyod rgyud dang*/ yo ge ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ ma hā a nu a ti gsum ni bla med kyi nyams len gyi sgo nas dbye ba'am pha ma gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum la dbye ba'o/ /de'i phyir de dag gi rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig yan lag gi dam tshig dang bcas pa ji snyed gcig gsungs pa thams cad kyang dam tshig rgya mtsho 'dir mi 'du ba ma yin mod 'on kyang rnam dbye de dag gzhan las shes par bya'o//rnying ma ba phal cher la grags pa ltar na ma hā yo ga ni/ gsar ma'i rgyud dang mthun pa yin/ a nu a ti gnyis gsar ma'i rgyud las gong du 'phags pa yin par 'dod kyang*/ de ni rgyud don zab mo thos ma myong ba'i skad cha yin gyi/ ma hā zhes sogs ni rnal 'byor chen po/ rjes su rnal 'byor/ shin tu rnal 'byor zer rgyu yin pas de tsam ni gsar ma'i rgyud la'ang med pa ma yin la/ spyod pa gtso che ba ma hā/ ting 'dzin gtso che ba a nu/ lta ba gtso che ba a ti'am/ yang na bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ zung 'jug gtso gang che'i ngos nas btags par bshad pas gong bshad nyid las ma 'das so/

/de'i phyir na rgyud re re la chos skad re re yod pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas chos lugs re re byed na mang ngo*/ /'on kyang bstan pa snga dar dang*/ phyi dar gnyis la chos skad khyad che ba gnyis yod pa dang*/ de'i sgra dang mthun pa'i rgyud kyang gnyis su gyes pa yin 'dra ba bdag snyam mo//de ltar rgyud sde bzhis bstan pa'i/ /smin grol dam tshig brtson gyur na//zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa dang*/ /bsad bskrad rmongs dang rengs rnams dang*//grub pa'i ral gri bcud kyi len/ /bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu reg pa dang*//ril bu ro tsa na nyid dang*/ /mig sman rkang byug shing gi lham//rig pa 'dzin dang mkha' la spyod/ /dus ni thung ngur 'grub byed cing*//las rlung nyi khri chig stong dang*/ /drug brgya 'gag pa'i bye brag las//sa bcu lam lnga legs bgrod de/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang phyug brgyad//mngon byed rdo rje sems dpa' 'ang*/ /bya spyod tshul gyis thabs mkhas tsam//ldan yang mi tshe drug cu ste/ /rnal 'byor mi tshe bcu drug yin//bla na med pa tshe gcig gis/ /brtson ldan nges par 'grub par 'gyur//zhes bya'o//sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang ces bya ba mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ sdom pa gsum pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi skabs te le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas de ltar du bshad pa'i sdom pa gsum po de/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ji ltar gnas pa dang*/ bsrung ba'i tshul ni/ ji ltar zhe na bshad pa/ de ltar so thar sdom pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dang rig pa 'dzin//rnam gsum gang zag gcig rgyud la/ /gnas tshe ngo bo tha dad ste//srung na'ang so sor chol par bsrung*/ /'dom thug 'gal ba byung na ni//gong ma'i bslab pa dang du len/ /skyon kun 'og ma zil gyis gnon//de bzhin yon tan yar ldan te/ /gtong dang thob pa tha dad te//zhes bya ste/ de'ang sdom gsum gang zag gcig gi rgyud la gnas tshul la mi mtshungs pa'i bshad pa 'ga' yod de/

'phags yul du'ang dbang gi lde mig las gsungs pa ltar na/ sngags sdom gyi rten byang sdom dang*/ de'i rten so thar du bshad pa rten can dang*/ gong ma thob ( rjes ma mchan/ ) pa na 'og ma ( sngon ma mchan/ ) 'phel zhing dag par 'dod pa dang*/ sdom pa gcig nyid phyi so thar nang byang sdom gsang ba sngags su 'dod pa dang*/ gong ma gong ma la 'og ma 'og ma tshang bar 'dod pa ste yar ldan dang*/ gong ma thob pas 'og ma'ang gnas 'gyur ba ste rim pa can du 'dod pa dang*/ gcig dang gcig ma 'dres pa ste ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su 'dod pa dang drug go/ deng sang bod 'dir grags che ba ni slob dpon a bh+ya kā ras gser gyi rgyan gser yin par rigs gcig kyang mgo rgyan dang rkang rgyan lag gdub du tha dad pa bzhin du/ sdom gsum spong sems su gcig kyang gsum du tha dad par bzhed pa dang*/ paṇa chen bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra ni/ skar ma zla ba nyi ma gsum bzhin phyi mas snga ma zil gyis mnan nas bag la zha bar 'gyur ba dang*/ ngo bo tha dad par 'dod pa dang*/ dpal ldan sa skya pa ni/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong dang*/ sdom gsum rab dbye'i dgongs pa 'grel nas sdom gsum gnas 'gyur ngo bo gcig ldog pa tha dad par 'dod pa dang*/ dge ldan pa ni/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba'i sdom gsum rnam bzhag tu li sder dang*/ der chu blug pa dang*/ der in+d+ra nī la bzhag pa bzhin du tha dad dang 'og ma gong ma'i yan lag dang rten can du 'dod pa dang*/ dwags po bka' brgyud pa rnams ni rje sgam po pa'i gsungs las/ ngo bo tha dad dang*/ srung na chol par srung*/ 'dom thug na gong ma gtso/ 'og ma'i skyon zil gyis gnon/ yon tan yar ldan yin zhes 'byung ba ltar 'dod pa dang*/ gsang sngags rnying ma pa rnams rje klong chen pa'i gsungs las/ rang ldog ma 'dres/ dgag dgos yongs rdzogs sogs 'dod pa rnams te ( gong ma thob nas 'og gtang bar 'dod pa'ang yod snang mchan/

) de'i 'dod pa phyi ma drug po yang snga ma drug tu ci rigs tshang yod pa 'dra'o//de dag las mi 'thad pa'i rnam pa gzhan lugs su bzhag pa dang*/ yid yul du bab pa rang lugs su bzhag pa ni gang zhe na/ gzhan ni gzhan du sna tshogs yod mod/ 'dir karma pa rang byung mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa ltar rnam par bzhag pa la/ dgag sgrub kyi cha ni des mdzad pa'i rnam bzhag tu lta bar bya la/ sdom pa gsum gyi so so thar pa theg dman gyi sdom pa nyid dang*/ byang sdom nyid dang*/ sngags sdom gsum gyi len yul dus bsam pa rten sogs mi gcig pas ngo bo tha dad pa dang*/ so so nas bshad pa bzhin tshang bar bsrung bas so sor chol par bsrung ces pa dang*/ 'dom thug ces byang sdom srung ba'i phyir snying rjes ma byin len dgos pa dang blangs na so thar nyams par 'gyur ba gnyis thug na gong ma byang sdom gtso che ba sogs mang po shes pa dang*/ de'i phyir na de dag 'og ma'i skyon zil gyis non pa yin pa dang yon tan yar ldan yang yin no//'di rnams la cung zad dpyad na/ sdom gsum ngo bo gcig ces pa ni cung zad bshad mi bde ste/ dper na dmigs gcig la bkar na/ nad med kyi nor bus bud med kyi rma'i kha shun las 'das par rol zhing*/ de'i bde ba myangs pa tsam gyis sdom pa gtan nas nyams par gyur pa'i sdom pa de dang*/ de'i bde ba de nyid lam du byed pa'i sdom pa de gnyis ngo bo gcig pa dang*/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi dag rgyu byas pa'i gzugs can gyi sdom pa zhig dang*/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngor bzhugs pa'i sdom pa gnyis gcig tu 'gyur ba sogs blos gzhig mi bde ba mang ngo*//dngos su de ltar na'ang brgyud pa'i tshul gyis don 'gal med pas gcig zer na ni ha cang thal lo/ /rnying ma ba'i rang ldog ma 'dres zhes pa ni ldog pa tha dad zer rgyu yin 'dra bas ldog pa tha dad pa tsam gyis ni ngo bo dbye mi nus pas gong bshad nyid do/

/rang ldog ma 'dre zhes pa'i ma 'dres zer ba la brtags na ngo bo tha dad du'ang bzhed 'dra'o/ /rten can du'ang bshad dka' ste khyab che chung dus rten sogs dpe dang dpe can mi mtshungs pa sogs du ma zhig bshad su dran kyang mi spro'o//sdom gsum rnam par bstan pa nyer mkho'i bum bzang ces bya ba mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ sdom pa gsum gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ldan tshul gyi skabs te le'u bzhi pa ste mtha' ma'o// //de ltar sdom gsum rnam bzhag ni/ /nyer mkho'i bum pa zhes bya ba//thar 'dod skyes bu'i tshogs rnams la/ /nye bar mkho ba'i bum pa nyid//mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i snying khu ni/ /sdom pa dam tshig lags pas na//nyams len snying por dril ba 'di/ /bye ba ring bsrel nyid du'ang 'gyur//des na mdo rgyud lung 'dren med/ /rang gis brtag pa'i mtha' dpyad med//'on kyang gong ma'i zhal gyi lung*/ /dri med yid rton 'os pa'i phul//snying rje'i bdud rtsi gsol gsol nas/ /mkhyen pa'i bzhin ras zla med pa//dpal ldan karma bka' brgyud kyi/ /gsung gi zer yang bdud rtsi nyid//rang blo'i rnam dpyod nyag phran ni/ /sngon med gnam ru la sbyar yang*//skyes thob sbyor byung rtsal zhan pas/ /zab mo'i don la phog pa dka'//'on kyang gzhung bshad 'ga' zhig gi/ /spyi dang tshig don mngar ba'i ro//cung zad myangs pa'i phun tshogs kyang*/ /mngon du byas pa'i tshul can yin//sdom pa dang ni dam tshig dag /snying gi thig ler mi 'dzin na//bskyed rdzogs las bzhi'i phrin las sogs/ /rtsa ba rul ba'i shing bzhin 'gyur//de bzhin 'di tshul mi ldan na/ /sku bsod rgyas pa'i bla ma yang*//mi gtsang phung po dar bzang gis/ /mdzes par byas pa'i ngang tshul 'gyur//rgya mtsho des ni rin chen 'dzin/ /sdom pa gsum 'dis bslab gzhi 'dzin//

bslab pa'i gzhis ni 'jig rten dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal 'dzin 'gyur// so so thar pa'i rtsa ba brtan/ /byang chub sems kyi sdong po mtho//gsang ba sngags kyi 'bras lding na/ /rgyal bstan rdzogs pa'i shing gcig ste//gzhan gnod spangs pa'i lding khang rtser/ /gzhan phan 'gog pa med pa'i 'phrul//smin grol nor bu'i tog bkod na/ /bstan 'dzin mchog tu gus pas 'bod//bdag gi lhag bsam gyis bskrun pa'i/ /gzhung bzang ut+pal chun po 'di//ris med phyogs kyi bu mo yi/ /rna ba'i rgyan du byed gyur cig/lhag bsam dag pas byas pa dang*/ /smon lam btab pa'i bden pa yis//gzhung 'di'i tshul las mi 'da' ba'i/ /brtul zhugs sus kyang 'dzin gyur cig/sdom gsum ldan pa thams cad la/ /bdag gis snying nas dad 'phel bas//phyogs ris med pa de yi mthus/ /gsar rnying kun gyi gsos su shog//gyi nar byung rgyal ma yin par/ /dge sbyor gzhan yang blos dor te//lus sems zhag mang ngal byas pas/ /de tsam gzhan la phan thogs shog/kun kyang tshul 'dir zhugs pa la/ /gal srid bag med nyon mongs kyis//'gal ba'i spyod pa byung srid na/ /bshags bsdoms tshad dang ldan gyur cig/de lta'i spyod pa rlabs po ches/ /tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang 'grub nas//'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god gyur cig/tshul dang mthun par spyod pa'i mthus/ /'jig rten kun kyang nad mug zhi//tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa sogs/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ ces pa 'di ni sngon nas sprul pa'i sku'i bkas kyang bskul zhing snyan ngag gis tshigs su bcad pa'i yi ge rten bcas kyis kyang bskul ba gnang ba dang*/ grwa pa gzhan 'ga' zhig la'ang nye bar mkho ba dang*/ nang chen pa blo gsar karma mtha' yas kyis kyang nan gyis bskul na'ang*/ re zhig lus pa la slad nas rgyal rong rgyal sras nang so chos mdzad kun dga' chos 'phel gyi nyams bzhes su'ang mkho ba bcas kyis/

7sku zhabs rin po che si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi zhabs pad spyi bo'i rgyan du byed pa karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyis mdo smad dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du mgyogs par grub par bgyis pas nyes pa'i cha mchis na/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la snying nas bshags shing*/ dge ba'i cha mchis na sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba ji snyed mchis pa dag gi sna 'dren du gyur te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i go 'phang du 'jug pa dang*/ gnas skabs su'ang dge legs du ma'i dpal dang ldan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/nyes par spyod gang spong ba yi/ /'khor ba'i gzhi las nges thar byed/ /du ma'i rten du nyer gyur pa/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom par grags/ /mya ngan 'das pa rab thob med/ /gzhan gnod gzhir bcas kyis dben pa/ /rnam bdun chen pos nyer 'phags gang*/ /byang chub sems kyi theg par 'dod/ /khyad par du mas nyer mdzes zhing*/ /gdod ma'i de nyid ye shes nyid/ /skad cig gcig rdzogs thabs tshul can/ /gsang chen gsang ba'i sdom par bsngags/ /de tshul rnam gsum don gyi gzhung*/ /legs rtogs chub shing sems byed nyid/ /bstan 'dzin zhes su nyer 'bod pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'ang de las byung*/ /des na thar 'dod yongs kyi gsos/ /nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung bzang 'di/ /lus can du ma'i dpal gyur phyir/ /yi ge'i phyi mo 'phel bya'i ched/ /par yig 'phrul gyi ngo mtshar bskrun/ /'dir 'bad legs byas 'od snang gis/ /ris med rgyal bstan pad tshal rgyas/ /'gro kun nges legs lam bzang du/ /'jug pa'i sman lon nyid thob shog /zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i gzhung bzang 'di nyid sde bzhi dge bcu'i rgyal khab dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du par du sgrubs skabs karma rat+nas smras pa dge'o//sdom gsum nyer mkho'i bum bzang gi sa bcad/le'u dang po so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i skabs/

sdom pa gsum/so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ 27 byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ 28 rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o// 28 sdom pa gsum las/ dang po so so thar pa'i sdom pa la bzhi/ dang po bsnyen gnas/ 32 bsrungs pa'i phan yon/ 33 gnyis pa dge bsnyen/ 33 nyams na bcos pa'i tshul/ 35 skyabs su song ba'i phan yon/ 35 dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'i phan yon/ 36 gsum pa dge tshul gyi sdom pa/ 36 las chog gi go rim/ 36 spang bya yan lag bcu/ 36 bzhi pa dge slong gi sdom pa la gnyis/ ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang*/ 37 thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'o// 45 dang po thob byed kyi cho ga mngon gyur bcu/dang po sangs rgyas mngon gyur/ 38 gnyis pa chos mngon gyur/ 38 gsum pa dge 'dun mngon gyur/ 38 bzhi pa mkhan po mngon du gyur pa/ 40 lnga pa slob dpon mngon gyur/ 40 drug pa bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod mngon du gyur pa/ 41 bdun pa yo byad mngon gyur/ 43 brgyad pa yongs dag mngon gyur/ 43 dgu pa gsol ba mngon gyur/ 44 bcu pa las mngon gyur ro// 44 gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i thabs la gnyis/ spyir gnas kyi bla ma brten tshul sogs dang*/ 45 dgag sgrub bye brag tu bshad pa'o// 55 spyir gnas kyi bla ma brten tshul sogs la gsum/slob ma'i bya ba dang*/ 45 bla ma'i bya ba dang*/ 48 bla slob gnyis ka'i bya ba'o// 49 gnyis pa dgag sgrub bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis/ dgag pa'i bslab bya bshad pa dang*/ 55 bsgrub pa'i bslab bya bshad pa'o// 97 dang po la ltung ba sde lnga ste/ pham pa'i sde/ 55 lhag ma'i sde/ 58 ltung byed/ 62 sor bshags/ 91 nyes byas so// 92dang po pham pa'i sde la bzhi ste/ dang po mi tshangs spyod kyi pham pa/ 55 gnyis pa ma byin len gyi pham pa/ 56 gsum pa srog gcod kyi pham pa/ 57 bzhi pa mi chos bla ma'i rdzun gyi pham pa/ 58 gnyis pa lhag ma bcu gsum ste/ dang po khu ba 'byin pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma/
